## v0.222.2 — 2026-02-04

This week's release includes support for [multiple edit prediction providers](https://zed.dev/blog/edit-prediction-providers) (GitHub Copilot's Next Edit Suggestions, Ollama, Codestral, Sweep, and Mercury Coder), zooming and panning in the image viewer, Windows as a supported target for SSH remoting, significantly reduced resource usage when watching filesystem changes on macOS, and the ability to rename terminal tabs via right-click or double-click.

## Features

### AI

- Edit Prediction: Added support for multiple edit prediction providers, including GitHub Copilot's Next Edit Suggestions, Ollama, Codestral, Sweep, and Mercury Coder. To configure, open the `Edit Prediction` menu and select `Configure Providers`.
- Agent: Made the message queue feature available for external agents as well. ([#47379](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47379))
- Agent: Added a menu for inserting context more easily with the mouse in the agent panel. ([#47768](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47768))
- Agent: Improved `@` file completions in agent panel to be more accurate. ([#47466](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47466))
- Agent: Improved double-click word selection in Agent Panel to respect punctuation and language-specific word characters. ([#47844](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47844))
- Agent: Added a setting for controlling the behavior of the stop button in the terminal tool call card (between cancelling the command to run and the thread, or just the command). ([#47521](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47521))
- Improved memory usage of large ACP thread diff multibuffers. ([#47526](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47526))

### Git

- Improved the project picker in the Git panel by also displaying the Git status icon on them, to clearly indicate which repos have changes. ([#47752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47752); thanks [tartarughina](https://github.com/tartarughina))

### Languages

- C/C++: Added highlights for `#elifdef`, `#elifndef` directives and document comments. ([#45672](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45672); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein), [#47556](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47556); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- C++: Added first-line language detection for extensionless libc++ headers. ([#47443](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47443); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- C: Updated tree-sitter-c for highlighting attribute specifier. ([#47156](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47156); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Go: Improved support to run table-test subtests, handling tests without explicitly declaring variables for test scenarios. ([#46645](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46645); thanks [lzakharov](https://github.com/lzakharov))
- Nim: Updated file aliases so icon is shown for `.nims`/`.nimble` files. ([#47616](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47616); thanks [ire4ever1190](https://github.com/ire4ever1190))
- TypeScript: Improved keyword syntax highlighting for declarations (`const`, `let`, `var`, `function`, `class`, `enum`, `interface`, `type`) and imports/exports (`export`, `from`, `import`). ([#47435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47435); thanks [ahcurrier](https://github.com/ahcurrier))

### Terminal

- Added ability to rename terminal tabs via right-click context menu and double-click. ([#45800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45800); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

### Vim / Helix

- Added relative line jump support to go-to-line action via `+/-/f/b/F/B`. ([#46932](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46932); thanks [KalaayPT](https://github.com/KalaayPT))
- Added a `vim.gdefault` setting to make `/g` (replace all matches in a line) the default for substitutions, along with `:set gdefault` and `:set nogdefault` commands (short forms: `gd`, `nogd`). ([#47664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47664); thanks [bluetech](https://github.com/bluetech))

### Remote Development

- Added configurable remote server cache retention (default 5). ([#47202](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47202); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Improved error handling in the dev container crate to prevent panics. ([#47513](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47513); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved parsing of devcontainer CLI output when using earlier versions. ([#47403](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47403); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved error messaging to guide user away from opening a dev container from within a remote project. ([#47816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47816); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))

### Windows

- Added support for Windows as a target platform for SSH remoting. ([#47460](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47460))
- Added "Reveal in File Manager" to the project panel context menu on WSL. ([#47288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47288))

### Linux

- Relaxed the checks on `xdg_wm_base` to ensure compatibility with Weston 9. ([#47185](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47185); thanks [linghengqian](https://github.com/linghengqian))

### macOS

- Zed now uses significantly fewer resources when watching filesystem changes. ([#47322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47322); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))

### Other

- Added zooming and panning support in the image viewer with zoom in/out, reset, fit-to-view, zoom-to-actual actions, scroll-wheel zoom with modifier, click-and-drag panning, zoom percentage overlay, and toolbar controls. ([#43944](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43944); thanks [MostlyKIGuess](https://github.com/MostlyKIGuess))
- Added a menu item in the buffer and tab right-click menu for opening Markdown and SVG files in the preview tab. ([#47821](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47821))
- Added commands for extending selections to syntax node boundaries, i.e., `editor: select to start of larger syntax node` and `editor: select to end of larger syntax node`. ([#47571](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47571); thanks [alexispurslane](https://github.com/alexispurslane))
- Added support for specifying multiple snippets paths in extensions. ([#45829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45829))
- Added `project_panel.bold_folder_labels` to show folder names with bold text in the project panel (defaults to `false`). ([#47631](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47631); thanks [zertosh](https://github.com/zertosh))
- Added a menu item to close the current project, going back to a clean window state. ([#47365](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47365))
- Added support for installing a specific Zed version via the `ZED_VERSION` environment variable in the install script (defaults to `latest` when unspecified). ([#45522](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45522); thanks [mikelneonedwin](https://github.com/mikelneonedwin))
- Added "Reopen with Encoding" feature (currently supported for local files). ([#46553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46553); thanks [tomopumipumi](https://github.com/tomopumipumi))
- Improved empty workspaces with unsaved files to now restore on startup (hot-exit). ([#46557](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46557); thanks [shfc](https://github.com/shfc))
- Improved performance when a large number of files were open by making background diagnostics more efficient. ([#47510](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47510))
- Improved project search loading UI. ([#47620](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47620); thanks [zertosh](https://github.com/zertosh))
- Improved memory usage of large git diff multibuffers. ([#47524](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47524))
- Changed bold UI text to render using Plex SemiBold instead of Bold. ([#47725](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47725))
- Changed the auto signature popover — `"auto_signature_help": true` — to respect `hover_popover_delay`. ([#46745](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46745); thanks [TheSalarKhan](https://github.com/TheSalarKhan))
- Added server notifications auto-dismiss with `"global_lsp_settings": { "notifications": { "dismiss_timeout_ms": 5000 } }` setting. ([#46708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46708); thanks [tomatitito](https://github.com/tomatitito))
- Added support for importing VS Code Insiders and VSCodium Insiders user settings (`settings.json`). ([#47247](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47247); thanks [maj113](https://github.com/maj113))
- Block cursor no longer reveals characters within redacted ranges. ([#45549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45549); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

## v0.221.4 — 2026-01-28

This week's release includes support for installing agents through the new [ACP Registry](https://zed.dev/blog/acp-registry), Agent message queuing as the default behavior (with the ability to edit and interrupt queued messages), MCP server support for remote development, Vim-style tag stack navigation for "Go to Definition" jumps, EditorConfig inheritance from parent directories, and improved Dev Container support including Podman.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the ability to install new Agents via the ACP Registry. ([#47470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47470))
- Agent: Added the ability to edit queued messages. ([#47234](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47234))
- Agent: Added a menu item in the agent panel right-click menu for copying a given agent's response. ([#46529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46529); thanks [DepsCian](https://github.com/DepsCian))
- Agent: Added `@diagnostics` to "New Thread" conversations so you can feed current language-server diagnostics directly into the Agent Panel context. This keeps parity with text threads while staying within the cursor-aware assistant workflow. ([#42270](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42270); thanks [GoldStrikeArch](https://github.com/GoldStrikeArch))
- Agent: Made it easier to interrupt the agent while having messages in the queue. ([#46954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46954))
- Agent: Made queuing prompts the default behavior when sending them while there's an on-going generation. ([#46797](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46797))
- Agent: Added reasoning content support for the OpenAI provider. ([#43662](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43662); thanks [aeroxy](https://github.com/aeroxy))
- Agent: Changed the display of tokens for OpenAI models to reflect the input/output limits. ([#46829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46829))
- Agent: Changed the behavior of queued messages to gracefully wait for the current activity to complete. ([#46980](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46980))
- Agent: Improved streaming tool call performance by batching UI updates. ([#46802](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46802))
- Agent: Added support for running MCP servers on the remote server when using remote development. This can be enabled by setting the `"remote": true` property in the settings entry for the MCP server. ([#46756](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46756))

### Languages

- Markdown: Improved bracket colorization. ([#47026](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47026))
- Python/Ty: Added support for using venv-installed ty binary. ([#47029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47029))

### Vim / Helix

- Added Vim-style tag stack navigation. "Go to Definition" jumps are now tracked in a dedicated stack, so you can navigate back through them without wading through your full navigation history. Use the new `pane: go to older tag` and `pane: go to newer tag` commands. ([#46002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46002); thanks [zenazn](https://github.com/zenazn))

### Remote Development

- Changed opening bundled files, keymap, local release notes and the log file view to open in remote windows instead of opening a new local Zed window. ([#46910](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46910))
- Changed opening the settings files, keymap files, task files and debug files to open within WSL windows instead of opening a new local Zed window. ([#46910](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46910))

### Other

- Improved Dev Container support ([#47021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47021); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton)):

Use `root = true` in any `.editorconfig` to stop inheriting settings from parent directories. ([#46332](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46332))

## v0.220.2 — 2026-01-21

This week's release includes a unified Git picker (combines branches, worktrees, and stashes), structured outline support for Markdown files, the ability to open local terminals in remote projects, and Agent panel improvements including turn statistics display, line change tracking, and better partial edit recovery.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added an `agent.show_turn_stats` setting, default to `false`, that shows the timer, the number of tokens, and whose turn it is. ([#46390](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46390))
- Agent: Improved the UX for discarding partial edits by allowing the user to quickly restore the file to its original content. ([#46752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46752))
- Agent: Made the act of stopping a terminal tool call in the agent panel also cancel the thread generation. ([#46663](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46663))
- Agent: Added the total and per-file number of lines added and removed in a thread. ([#46454](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46454))
- Agent: Improved the settings configuration page for Ollama to store the current URL value if changed when clicking on "Connect". ([#46665](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46665))
- Agent: Changed pressing `esc` when the agent panel is focused to now interrupt the running thread even if the text input box is not specifically focused. ([#46410](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46410))
- Agent: Changed stopping the terminal tool to now capture its output up to that point so the model can see what was running when you stopped it. ([#46218](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46218), [#46306](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46306))
- Agent: Restricted agent server extension icon paths to subdirectories of the extension's root directory. ([#44183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44183))
- Inline Assistant: Added the ability to display messages and will be less likely to insert non-code text. ([#46107](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46107))
- Copilot: Added support for jumping to unresolved diagnostics in edit predictions. ([#46618](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46618))
- Copilot: Improved responsiveness of inline completions. ([#46895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46895); thanks [hicder](https://github.com/hicder))

### Git

- Unified the branch, worktree, and stash pickers into one, making it easier to find and access them from one another. ([#46621](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46621))

### Debugger

- Added keyboard navigation between the views in the new session picker. ([#46662](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46662))

### Languages

- Markdown: Added structured outline. ([#45643](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45643); thanks [YuantianDing](https://github.com/YuantianDing))
- Added '#' characters as part of word when double-clicking text in `.json` and `.css` files. ([#45400](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45400); thanks [dylwil3](https://github.com/dylwil3))

### Terminal

- Added support for opening local terminals in remote projects via `local` parameter on terminal commands. ([#46532](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46532); thanks [baldwindavid](https://github.com/baldwindavid))

### Vim / Helix

- Improved the `%` motion to always fall back to text-based bracket matching when language-aware matching fails. ([#45559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45559); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))
- Added `vim::SearchUnderCursor` and `vim::SearchUnderCursorPrevious` actions (for `*` / `#`) to search under cursor without immediately jumping to the next / previous match. ([#46244](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46244); thanks [a-hariti](https://github.com/a-hariti))
- Added ability to customize Vim mode foreground. ([#46639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46639); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone))
- Added `match_quotes` parameter to the `vim::Matching` action to control whether `%` matches quote characters. ([#42615](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42615); thanks [Kalmaegi](https://github.com/Kalmaegi))

### Windows

- Improved Windows credential write failures to display the underlying Credential Manager error message instead of the generic "Failed to write API key to keychain", making permission-related issues easier to diagnose. ([#46221](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46221); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))

### Other

- Improved performance of project search in remote projects. ([#45245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45245))
- Added a `tab_bar.show_pinned_tabs_in_separate_row` setting to display pinned and unpinned tabs in separate rows, giving unpinned tabs full horizontal space. ([#46573](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46573); thanks [yaroslavrick](https://github.com/yaroslavrick))
- Added `editor: move to {start,end} of larger syntax node` actions that move cursors to the start or end of the parent tree-sitter node. ([#45331](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45331); thanks [vamsi10010](https://github.com/vamsi10010))
- Workspace: Improved the UX of working with multiple projects in the same workspace through introducing a project dropdown that more clearly shows the currently active project as well as allowing you to change it. ([#46641](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46641))
- Added scrollbar in outline view picker. ([#46774](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46774); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added line numbers to the project symbols picker to help distinguish between symbols with the same name. ([#46507](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46507); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))
- Added the ability to right-click the breadcrumb button when it's a file path and copy the path. ([#46483](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46483))
- Improved multiline regex behavior. ([#46298](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46298); thanks [Zachiah](https://github.com/Zachiah))
- Improved `editor: delete to previous subword start` and `editor: delete to next subword end` interactions around newlines. You can opt-in into the previous behavior by adding `{"ignore_newlines": true}` to either action's binds in your keymap. ([#46235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46235); thanks [RubenFricke](https://github.com/RubenFricke))
- Changed preview tab to become permanent after closing all other tabs. ([#46294](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46294); thanks [mattermoran](https://github.com/mattermoran))

## v0.219.4 — 2026-01-14

This week's release includes most of [December's quality week items](https://github.com/orgs/zed-industries/projects/61) and is packed!
Highlights include subpixel (ClearType-style) text rendering on Windows and Linux to improve text clarity on standard DPI displays, the ability to favorite/pin Agent models, cycle them via `alt-tab`, and queue messages in the agent panel, a `git: create pull request` command, UI controls to restart/stop individual language servers, a which-key-like modal (enable with `{"which_key": {"enabled": true}}`), improved Markdown list editing via `extend_list_on_newline` and `indent_list_on_tab`, many performance boosts — and much much more!

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the ability to mark language models as favorites and pin them to the top of the list. This feature is available in the native Zed agent (including text threads and the inline assistant), and in external agents. ([#44297](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44297), [#45528](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45528); thanks [aqrln](https://github.com/aqrln))
- Agent: Added the ability to cycle through favorited models using the `alt-tab` keybinding. ([#45032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45032))
- Agent: Added the ability to queue messages in the agent panel. ([#46019](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46019))
- Agent: Added a right-click context menu for the thread view. ([#45440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45440); thanks [zchira](https://github.com/zchira))
- Agent: Added the ability to regenerate the auto-summarized title of threads via the "Regenerate Thread Title" button, available in the ellipsis menu of the agent panel. ([#43859](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43859); thanks [aeroxy](https://github.com/aeroxy))
- Agent: Added the ability to configure timeouts for context server tool calls. The new global `context_server_timeout` setting controls the default timeout (default is 60s, max: 10min). Additionally, per-server timeouts can be configured using the `timeout` field within servers defined in the `"context_servers"` setting. ([#45378](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45378))
- Agent: Added MCP prompt support to agent threads. Prompts from MCP servers now appear in the slash command menu when typing `/` in agent threads. ([#43523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43523); thanks [mdliss](https://github.com/mdliss))
- Agent: Show tool call parameters when the agent asks for confirmation to run a tool. ([#45931](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45931))
- Agent: Made tool calls' raw input visible in the agent UI. ([#45097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45097); thanks [tsoernes](https://github.com/tsoernes))
- Agent: Use up-to-date token counts from LLM responses when reporting tokens used per thread. ([#44943](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44943))
- Agent: Added OpenAI `gpt-5-codex` model to the assistant. ([#39989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39989); thanks [mstallone](https://github.com/mstallone))
- Agent: Added support for OpenAI's `/responses` endpoint for models that don't support the `/chat/completions` API. ([#39989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39989); thanks [mstallone](https://github.com/mstallone))
- Agent: Improved Agent Panel performance when terminals are scrolled offscreen. ([#45537](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45537))
- Agent: Updated context lengths for several Mistral models to match Mistral’s recommended values. ([#45194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45194); thanks [guiopen](https://github.com/guiopen))
- Agent: Added support for authenticating Amazon Bedrock with API keys (bearer tokens), including via environment variable or the UI. ([#41393](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41393); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))
- Agent: Improved: MCP tools are now automatically reloaded when a context server sends a `tools/list_changed` notification, eliminating the need to restart the server to discover new tools. ([#42453](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42453); thanks [tsoernes](https://github.com/tsoernes))
- Copilot now supports [Next Edit Suggestions](https://code.visualstudio.com/blogs/2025/02/12/next-edit-suggestions). ([#44486](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44486))

### Git

- Added `git: create pull request` command to open a pull request for the current branch. ([#42959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42959); thanks [tommyming](https://github.com/tommyming))
- Added the ability to copy a commit's SHA in the commit view. ([#45478](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45478); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added support for collapsing/expanding entries with your keyboard while in the git panel (tree view). ([#45002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45002); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Added a `Restore File` action in the project panel context menu to discard uncommitted file changes. ([#42490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42490); thanks [korbindeman](https://github.com/korbindeman))
- Added git clone open listeners using `zed://git/clone?repo=<git-url>`. ([#41669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41669); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Added support for `zed://git/commit/<sha>?repo=<path>` URI scheme to access the git commit view. ([#43341](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43341); thanks [schpet](https://github.com/schpet))
- Added optimistic staged hunk updating. ([#43434](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43434); thanks [van-sprundel](https://github.com/van-sprundel))
- Added support for Git repository excludes file `.git/info/exclude`. ([#42082](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42082); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/errmayank))
- Display all branches and remotes by default in the branch picker. ([#45041](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45041))
- Git panel now truncates long file paths from the left, showing "…path/filename" when space is limited, keeping filenames always visible. ([#43462](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43462); thanks [ddoemonn](https://github.com/ddoemonn))
- Added global Git settings to enable/disable `git status` and `git diff`. ([#43326](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43326); thanks [leoliu0605](https://github.com/leoliu0605))

### Debugger

- Conditionally display the debugger panel icon based on the `debugger.button` setting to avoid too many error logs. ([#45544](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45544); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

### Languages

- C++: Include namespace symbol in the outline view. ([#45794](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45794); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein))
- C/C++: Added highlighting for escape sequences. ([#46116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46116); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- C/C++: Added `union` declarations to the list of text objects. ([#45308](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45308); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein))
- Python: Added support for `uv run` in the shebang line to be interpreted as a Python script. ([#45881](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45881); thanks [flou](https://github.com/flou))
- Python: Allow using locally installed `ty` for Python. ([#45193](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45193); thanks [henryhchchc](https://github.com/henryhchchc))
- Markdown: Lists now continue automatically when you press Enter (unordered, ordered, and task lists). This can be configured with `extend_list_on_newline` (default: true). ([#42800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42800), [#45561](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45561); thanks [0xRaduan](https://github.com/0xRaduan))
- Markdown: You can now indent list markers with Tab to quickly create nested lists. This can be configured with `indent_list_on_tab` (default: true). ([#42800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42800); thanks [0xRaduan](https://github.com/0xRaduan))
- TS/JS: Files with updated imports now open in a multibuffer when renaming or moving TypeScript or JavaScript files. ([#45110](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45110))
- TS/JS: Improved syntax highlighting consistency for builtins in JavaScript and TypeScript. ([#46068](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46068))
- TS/JS: When renaming a TypeScript or JavaScript file, the selected option to automatically update imports will now be remembered across editor sessions. ([#45105](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45105))
- Proto: Added the `extend` keyword. ([#45413](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45413); thanks [Zachiah](https://github.com/Zachiah))
- Added Tailwind CSS Mode support, for Tailwind-specific CSS rules like `@apply`, `@layer`, and `@theme`. ([#45352](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45352))
- Added recognition for `.bst` files as yaml. ([#45015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45015); thanks [vixalien](https://github.com/vixalien))

### REPL

- Added an inline display of execution results (as opposed to the large execution view) for simple REPL cells. ([#44523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44523); thanks [auriium2](https://github.com/auriium2))
- Added gutter execution display. ([#44523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44523); thanks [auriium2](https://github.com/auriium2))
- Improved how execution of empty lines is handled. ([#44523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44523); thanks [auriium2](https://github.com/auriium2))

### Vim / Helix

- Added a which-key like modal with a compact, single-column panel anchored to the bottom-right. You can enable with `{"which_key": {"enabled": true}}` in your settings. ([#43618](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43618); thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin))
- Vim: Added the [`:r[ead] [name]` Vim command](https://vimhelp.org/insert.txt.html#:read). ([#45332](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45332); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))
- Added simple `g g`, `G`, `j`, and `k` motions for the file history view in Vim mode. ([#45412](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45412); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Added Helix match surround operations. ([#44317](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44317); thanks [leonqadirie](https://github.com/leonqadirie))

### Other

- Added support for subpixel (ClearType-style) text rendering. This improves the legibility of text on standard DPI displays. Subpixel rendering is enabled by default on Windows and Linux and can be configured using the `text_rendering_mode` setting. ([#45423](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45423))
- Added the ability to restart and stop individual language servers from the UI as opposed to just them all. ([#45882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45882))
- Added the language server version in a tooltip on language server hover. ([#45302](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45302))
- macOS: Bundle a placeholder `Document.icns` so Finder can display Zed’s file icons (instead of a generic icon). ([#44833](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44833))
- Added support for remote connections over IPv6. ([#43591](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43591); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Added a status bar item to display the active file's character encoding (e.g. `UTF-8`) and BOM status. ([#45476](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45476); thanks [tomopumipumi](https://github.com/tomopumipumi))
- Added a button to clear the search query for the collab and outline panels' search bars. ([#46210](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46210))
- Added a button to copy diagnostic messages from the hover popover. ([#45625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45625); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))
- Added a notification with a link to view release notes online when Zed can’t load them locally. ([#45900](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45900); thanks [CodingDoll](https://github.com/CodingDoll))
- Settings UI: Added support to edit the existing `proxy` setting. ([#45684](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45684); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Added `read_only_files` setting to allow specifying glob patterns of files that should not be editable by default. ([#44376](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44376))
- Added `pane::Split` mode (`{ClonePane,EmptyPane,MovePane}`) to allow creating an empty buffer. ([#40245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40245); thanks [iff](https://github.com/iff))
- Added ellipsis to truncated code actions and an aside showing the full action description. ([#45268](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45268))
- Added support for opening and saving files with legacy encodings (Shift-JIS, Big5, etc.). ([#44819](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44819); thanks [tomopumipumi](https://github.com/tomopumipumi))
- macOS: Mark metal layers opaque for non-transparent windows to allow direct-to-display when supported. ([#44334](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44334), [#45434](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45434); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- macOS: Buffer search now syncs with the system find pasteboard, allowing `⌘E` and `⌘G` to work seamlessly across Zed and other apps. ([#45311](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45311))
- Settings: Added Sapling directory to default `file_scan_exclusions`. ([#45837](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45837); thanks [corywilhite](https://github.com/corywilhite))
- Settings UI: Improved the UX of editing font size fields, as you can now type the desired value as opposed to just using the decrement/increment buttons. ([#45875](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45875))
- Added persistence for window size when no projects are open. ([#44937](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44937); thanks [mchisolm0](https://github.com/mchisolm0))
- Keymap editor: Added the ability to open the `keymap.json` file with a keybinding. ([#45987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45987); thanks [smitchaudhary](https://github.com/smitchaudhary))
- Keymap editor: Added a keybinding creation modal to make it easier to assign an action to a keystroke. ([#46030](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46030))
- Added hover feedback to folded path folders to indicate which folder will be targeted. ([#45876](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45876); thanks [andre-eriksson](https://github.com/andre-eriksson))
- Added autocomplete for LSP `initialization_options`. ([#43104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43104); thanks [Nereuxofficial](https://github.com/Nereuxofficial))
- Keybindings: Made the `extension` key context case-insensitive. This e.g. enables the `markdown: Open Preview` action to also handle files where the extension is capitalized as MD (case-sensitive file system). ([#45961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45961); thanks [krisfur](https://github.com/krisfur))
- Improved rendering of the border on number field inputs to ensure it's only rendered when the field is focused. ([#46165](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46165))
- Improved readability of long paths in the remote project picker. ([#46151](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46151))
- Improved responsiveness when editing very large language files. ([#45347](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45347))
- Improved `editor: add selection above` and `editor: add selection below` to select at the same text column when skipping soft-wrapped lines, instead of the same visual position. ([#45594](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45594))
- Improved Zed's memory usage when attempting to open binary files. ([#45971](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45971))
- Improved the UX of title bar modal pickers (remote projects, projects, and branches) by making them open closer to the trigger when triggering them with the mouse. ([#45361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45361))
- Git: Improved navigation of the git panel by advancing the "Uncommitted Changes" multibuffer to the currently selected file. To restore the old behavior, you can bind `up` and `down` to `menu::SelectPrevious` and `menu::SelectNext` under the `GitPanel` context in your keymap. ([#43701](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43701); thanks [coszio](https://github.com/coszio))
- Git: Unified wording for discarding file changes in the git panel. ([#45124](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45124))
- Improved display map rendering with many lines in the multi-buffer. ([#44743](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44743))
- Agent: Improved agent panel performance when rendering large diffs. ([#45077](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45077))
- Improved design of the multibuffer breadcrumbs toolbar. ([#45547](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45547); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
    - Moved breadcrumbs to file headers in multibuffer views.
    - Added collapse/expand all options for multibuffer views.
    - Improved use of space for multibuffer search by taking the place of the former breadcrumb toolbar location.
- Terminal: Improved path hyperlink performance for long lines. ([#44721](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44721); thanks [davewa](https://github.com/davewa))
- Improved performance when using relative line numbers in large files. ([#45164](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45164); thanks [HactarCE](https://github.com/HactarCE))
- Project search will consume fewer resources immediately after cancellation. ([#45406](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45406))
- Reduced number of threads when using extensions. ([#45990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45990); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Reduced GPU usage when idle by only presenting frames during bursts of high-frequency input. ([#45369](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45369))
- Skip worktree trust queries for remote collab project clients. ([#46256](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46256))
- When handling `workspace/diagnostic/refresh`, Zed now also sends new `textDocument/diagnostic` requests for open files, aligning with the LSP specification. ([#45365](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45365); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))

## Bug Fixes

- Linux (Wayland): Fixed an issue where the settings window would not respond to user interaction until resized. ([#45153](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45153))
- Linux: Fixed window border being rendered with a white background. ([#46281](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46281))
- Windows: Fixed close button hover text color. ([#45867](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45867); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Agent: Fixed the docs aside placement in selectors (i.e., model and configuration) depending on the panel dock position. ([#46050](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46050))
- Agent: Fixed a bug where mention creases didn't scale with `agent_buffer_font_size` and got clipped/jumbled when rendered one above the other. ([#45683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45683))
- Agent: Fixed scrollbar and JSON indentation for tool call input/output content's markdown codeblocks. ([#45454](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45454))
- Agent: Fixed a spurious "no checkpoint" error in the agent panel. ([#44801](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44801))
- Agent: Fixed a hang when accepting file deletions made by the agent while the deleted buffer was still open. ([#46086](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46086))
- Agent: Fixed inability to paste images from the clipboard directly into the agent panel on Windows. ([#45695](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45695); thanks [YangAoLib](https://github.com/YangAoLib))
- Agent: Fixed long error messages in Agent Panel being unreadable by making them scrollable. ([#45792](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45792); thanks [ahmedhesham6](https://github.com/ahmedhesham6))
- Agent: Fixed agent notification getting stuck and becoming undismissible when the project window is closed or when navigating to a new thread. ([#44939](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44939))
- Git: Fixed a bug where word diffs would filter out pure whitespace diffs. ([#45090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45090))
- Git: Fixed a bug where the branch list deletion button would delete the wrong branch. ([#45087](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45087))
- Git: Fixed the commit tooltip in the git panel not showing information like avatars. ([#38749](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38749); thanks [LoricAndre](https://github.com/LoricAndre))
- Git: Fixed the Git panel to preserve newlines in commit messages. ([#45167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45167); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45167))
- Git: Fixed toggling adjacent git-diff hunks based on the reported behavior in #42934. ([#43187](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43187); thanks [seanstrom](https://github.com/seanstrom))
- Git: Fixed git push to respect the upstream branch name instead of defaulting to the local branch name. ([#46158](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46158); thanks [amtoaer](https://github.com/amtoaer))
- Git UI: Fixed git tree view folders not opening when a file inside is selected. ([#45137](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45137); thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin))
- Git UI: Fixed "select first entry" selecting the wrong visual first entry when tree view is enabled. ([#45108](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45108); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Git UI: Fixed select next/previous entry selecting non-visible entries when tree view is enabled. ([#45030](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45030); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Python: Fixed selected virtual environments not being persisted/deserialized correctly within long-running Zed sessions (where multiple different projects might've been opened). This is a breaking change for users of multi-worktree projects—your selected toolchain for those projects will be reset. ([#45357](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45357))
- Python: Fixed broken completion menu layout caused by trailing newlines in ty documentation. ([#45342](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45342); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/errmayank))
- Python: Fixed an issue where the `editor: organize imports` action didn’t work for Python, even though imports were organized correctly during formatting. ([#45874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45874); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Fixed outline configuration for C++ variables with complex specifiers. ([#46135](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46135); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Fixed missing enum class struct in the outline panel for C++. ([#46121](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46121); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Fixed outline members issue for unions in C++. ([#46127](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46127); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Fixed `$` motion in Vim mode to stay at the end of the line when moving vertically. ([#45375](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45375); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/errmayank))
- Fixed an implicit dependency on a system `node` for running devcontainers. ([#45589](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45589); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Fixed an issue on macOS where audio playback would become temporarily scrambled when doing lots of IO operations, such as when running `git pull` or `git checkout` while in a call. ([#46128](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46128))

- Fixed builtin Python language servers not working correctly on SSH remotes. ([#46156](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46156))

- Fixed SVG previews and the toolbar button not working in single-file mode by using the file name for SVG detection. ([#45747](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45747); thanks [gshahbazian](https://github.com/gshahbazian))
- Fixed context menu in project panel targeting the wrong folder when right-clicking on folded directory paths. ([#45876](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45876); thanks [andre-eriksson](https://github.com/andre-eriksson))
- Fixed dock panel button tooltips not being dismissed when toggling panels via keyboard shortcut. ([#44746](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44746); thanks [Daeksell](https://github.com/Daeksell))

- Fixed a terminal scrollbar panic caused by arithmetic underflow in some cases. ([#45282](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45282); thanks [rabsef-bicrym](https://github.com/rabsef-bicrym))
- Fixed a bug where new windows would flicker, briefly showing the "Open a file or project to get started" message before an empty editor buffer appeared. ([#44915](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44915); thanks [Copilot](https://github.com/Copilot))
- Fixed a crash that occurred when signing out of Copilot. ([#46625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46625))

## v0.218.5 — 2026-01-07

This week's release includes initial support for [Dev Containers](https://zed.dev/blog/dev-containers), a new [worktree trust mechanism](https://zed.dev/blog/secure-by-default), a new Tree view for the Git panel, SQL syntax highlighting in Python files, AI-generated commit messages that respect rules files (e.g. `AGENTS.md`), improved terminal scrolling and link detection, and a set of Helix mode keymap improvements.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added `save_file` and `restore_file_from_disk` agent tools to handle dirty buffers when editing files. ([#45005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45005))
- Agent: Added a button to the agent thread view that scrolls to the most recent prompt. ([#44961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44961))
- Agent: Added the ability to use `shift-tab` to cycle through profiles for the built-in Zed agent. ([#44979](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44979))
- Agent: Added the ability to delete a profile through the "Manage Profiles" modal. ([#44977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44977))
- Agent: Improved agent panel performance when rendering large diffs. ([#44995](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44995))
- Agent: Improved the model search quality in the model picker. ([#44984](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44984))
- Agent: Added optional `timeout_ms` parameter to the terminal tool, allowing the agent to bound command runtime and prevent indefinite hangs. ([#44895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44895))
- Edit Prediction: Improved self-hosted zeta UX. Users no longer have to log into Zed to use custom or self-hosted zeta backends. ([#43236](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43236); thanks [DominicBurkart](https://github.com/DominicBurkart))
- Copilot: Improved GitHub Enterprise Copilot sign-in. ([#44085](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44085); thanks [madmo](https://github.com/madmo))
- Ollama: Added `auto_discover` setting to optionally limit visible models to only those manually configured in `available_models`. ([#42207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42207); thanks [xfbs](https://github.com/xfbs))

### Git

⭐ = Shipped via Let's Git Together

---

- ⭐Added a tree view for the Git panel. Users are able to switch between Flat and Tree view in the Git panel. ([#44089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44089); thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin))
- ⭐Improved the file history view by making it keyboard navigable. ([#44328](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44328); thanks [feeiyu](https://github.com/feeiyu))
- Improved stability of excerpts when editing in the project diff. ([#44312](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44312))
- AI-generated commit messages now respect rules files (e.g. `AGENTS.md`) if present. ([#44921](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44921))
- The branch name in the title bar now includes the name of the current repository when needed to disambiguate. ([#44793](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44793))
- ⭐Changed clicking the `changes` button in the Git panel to reset the project diff to the beginning. ([#43579](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43579); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- ⭐Improved permalinks to account for current diffs. ([#41915](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41915); thanks [siame](https://github.com/siame))
- ⭐Fixed Git panel color for staged new files. ([#44071](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44071); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- ⭐Fixed double slash in commit URLs. ([#44996](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44996); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Fixed partially-staged files not being represented accurately in the Git panel. ([#44837](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44837))

### Languages

- Improved Markdown Preview with scrolling actions: `markdown::ScrollUp`, `markdown::ScrollDown`, `markdown::ScrollUpByItem`, and `markdown::ScrollDownByItem`. ([#44585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44585); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Rust: Changed cwd of tasks that spawn a binary target to the root of a current package (which used to be a directory of the current source file). ([#44672](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44672))
- Added rainbow bracket coloring for C++ angle brackets (`<` / `>`). ([#44735](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44735); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein))
- Added language injections for string and tagged template literals in JS/TS(X). ([#44180](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44180); thanks [vitallium](https://github.com/vitallium))
- Improved JavaScript and TypeScript syntax highlighting to better distinguish types, parameters, punctuation, and JSDoc elements. ([#44532](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44532))
- Added SQL syntax highlighting support in Python files. ([#43756](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43756); thanks [jeffbrennan](https://github.com/jeffbrennan))
- Improved Proto support to work better out of the box. ([#44440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44440))

### Terminal

- Improved scroll performance. ([#44714](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44714); thanks [davewa](https://github.com/davewa))
- Improved URL link detection in terminals. ([#43559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43559); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Improved performance of terminal link matching even more. ([#44679](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44679))

### Vim / Helix

- Added Helix's `space /` keybinding to open a global search menu to Zed's Helix mode. ([#43363](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43363); thanks [godalming123](https://github.com/godalming123))
- Changed Helix keybinds to use visual line movement for `j`, `Down`, `k`, and `Up`, and textual line movement for `g j`, `g Down`, `g k`, and `g Up`. ([#42676](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42676); thanks [probablykasper](https://github.com/probablykasper))
- Added custom mappings for Zed-specific diff and git-related actions to Helix's goto mode. ([#45006](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45006))
 * `g o` - toggle selected diff hunks
 * `g O` - toggle staged
 * `g R` - restore change
 * `g u` - stage and goto next diff hunk
 * `g U` - unstage and goto next diff hunk
- Improved Helix mode keymaps by adding a Search category and clarifying non-Helix bindings. ([#43735](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43735); thanks [atahrijouti](https://github.com/atahrijouti))

### Other

- Added ability to open a project in a DevContainer, provided a `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` is present. ([#44442](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44442); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Introduced worktree trust mechanism, can be turned off with "session": `{ "session": { "trust_all_worktrees": true }}`.
  - Read the [Secure by Default](https://zed.dev/blog/secure-by-default) blog post.
- Improved link parsing for cases when a link is embedded in parentheses, e.g. Markdown. ([#44733](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44733); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved path and rendering performance. ([#44655](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44655); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Settings UI: Added an "Open Keymap Editor" item under the Keymap section. ([#44914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44914))
- Settings UI: Added a section for configuring edit prediction providers under AI > Edit Predictions, including Codestral and GitHub Copilot. Once you've updated you can use the following link to open it: zed://settings/edit_predictions.providers. ([#44505](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44505))
- Added support for on-type formatting with newlines. ([#44882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44882))
- Implemented the `zed --wait` flag so that it works when opening a directory. The command will block until the window is closed. ([#44936](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44936))
- Added scroll keybindings for the OutlinePanel. ([#42438](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42438); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA))
- Added the actions: `workspace::ZoomIn` and `workspace::ZoomOut` that complement the existing `workspace::ToggleZoom` action. ([#44587](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44587); thanks [pedroni](https://github.com/pedroni))
- Added a `connection_timeout` setting to specify the SSH connection timeout. ([#44823](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44823); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))
- Standardized `cmd-o` = open file, `cmd-k, cmd-o` = open folder across operating systems. ([#44598](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44598); thanks [Zachiah](https://github.com/Zachiah))
- Added a `show_user_menu` setting (defaulting to true) which shows or hides the user menu (the one with the user avatar) in the title bar. ([#44466](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44466); thanks [notnotjake](https://github.com/notnotjake))
- macOS: Added Force Touch support for go-to-definition. ([#40399](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40399); thanks [aarol](https://github.com/aarol))
- Improved the UI for keymap error messages. ([#42037](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42037); thanks [johnklucinec](https://github.com/johnklucinec))
- Improved LSP notification messages by adding Markdown rendering with clickable URLs, inline code, etc. ([#44215](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44215); thanks [errmayank](https://github.com/errmayank))
- Improved new windows spawned from maximized or fullscreen windows by preserving maximized and fullscreen state. ([#44605](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44605))
- Improved minimap performance when using custom fonts. ([#46024](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46024))
- Suppressed warnings for trailing commas in built-in JSON files (`settings.json`, `keymap.json`, etc.). ([#43854](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43854); thanks [ian-h-chamberlain](https://github.com/ian-h-chamberlain))
- Added a new value to the `restore_on_startup` setting called `launchpad`. This value makes Zed open with a variant of the welcome screen ("the launchpad") upon startup. Additionally, this same page variant is now also what is displayed if you close all tabs in an existing window that doesn't contain any folders open. The launchpad page shows you up to 5 recent projects, making it easy to open something you were working on recently. ([#44048](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44048); thanks [simonpham](https://github.com/simonpham))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Disabled word completions in plaintext and markdown files. To re-enable, add the following to your settings: `"languages": { "Plain Text": { "completions": { "words": "enabled" } }, "Markdown": { "completions": { "words": "enabled" } } }`. ([#44654](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44654))
- Removed `editor::AcceptPartialEditPrediction` and replaced it with `editor::AcceptNextLineEditPrediction` and `editor::AcceptNextWordEditPrediction`. ([#44411](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44411); thanks [teleoflexuous](https://github.com/teleoflexuous))
- Changed Markdown Preview commands `markdown::MovePageUp` and `markdown::MovePageDown` to `markdown::ScrollPageUp` and `markdown::ScrollPageDown`. ([#44585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44585); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Vim: Removed a keybinding conflict between the default macOS bindings for `pane::ActivateItem` and the `ctrl-6` alias for `pane::AlternateFile` which is primarily bound to `ctrl-^`. `ctrl-6` is no longer treated as an alias for `ctrl-^` in vim mode. If you'd like to restore `ctrl-6` as a binding for `pane::AlternateFile`, paste the following into your `keymap.json` file. ([#44560](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44560))

## v0.217.2 — 2025-12-17

## v0.217.1 — 2025-12-16

This week's release includes command palette history, git remotes support, branch names on git conflict buttons, automatic file context detection when pasting code into the agent panel, Grok 4.1 Fast models with 2M token context windows and vision support, and new `RotateSelectionsForward`/`RotateSelectionsBackward` actions for rotating content across multiple cursors.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added automatic file context detection when pasting code into the AI agent panel. Pasted code now displays as collapsible badges showing the file path and line numbers (e.g., "app/layout.tsx (18-25)"). ([#42982](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42982); thanks [ddoemonn](https://github.com/ddoemonn))
- Agent: Added support for Grok 4.1 Fast (reasoning and non-reasoning) models in the xAI provider, with 2M token context windows and full vision capabilities. ([#43419](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43419); thanks [mInrOz](https://github.com/mInrOz))
- Agent: Extended 2M token context to existing Grok 4 Fast variants (from 128K) for consistency with xAI updates. ([#43419](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43419); thanks [mInrOz](https://github.com/mInrOz))
- Agent: Enabled image/vision support for all Grok 4 family models. ([#43419](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43419); thanks [mInrOz](https://github.com/mInrOz))
- Agent: Added support for displaying the human-readable names of extension-provided agents in the agent menu. ([#44496](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44496))
- Agent: Added fallback to locally installed Codex version if update fails. ([#44419](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44419))
- Agent: UI now shows the checked state of a list item. ([#43567](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43567); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Edit Prediction: Improved cursor movement performance when edit predictions are enabled. ([#44161](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44161))
- Bedrock: Added opt-in `allow_global` which enables global endpoints. ([#44103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44103); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))
- Bedrock: Updated cross-region-inference endpoint and model list. ([#44103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44103); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Removed the actions `collab::ToggleMute`, `collab::ToggleDeafen`, and `collab::ToggleScreenshare`. These actions were never functional due to a registration issue, so any keybindings using them would not have worked. If you have keybindings for these actions, update them to use `collab::Mute`, `collab::Deafen`, and `collab::ScreenShare` instead. ([#44432](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44432))

## v0.216.0 — 2025-12-10

This week's release includes a `File History` view for viewing the commit history of individual files, word-based diff highlighting, UI for deleting Git branches, improved pyright/basedpyright completion sorting for Python, and many performance improvements! 🙌

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Improved delete thread action in the history view by preventing it from also triggering the thread activation. ([#43796](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43796); thanks [aeroxy](https://github.com/aeroxy))
- Agent: Made the thread loading state clearer in the agent panel. ([#43765](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43765))
- Agent: Added support for deleting your entire thread history. ([#43370](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43370); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Agent: Revised tool call description for read file tool to explain outlining behavior. ([#43929](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43929))
- Agent: Clarified grep tool description to improve agent precision when using it with the `include_pattern` parameter. ([#41225](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41225); thanks [procr1337](https://github.com/procr1337))
- Agent: Removed timeout for agent initialization. ([#44066](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44066))
- ACP: Added support for using @mentions after typing slash command. ([#43681](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43681))

Shows commit history for the selected file with author, timestamp, and commit message. Clicking a commit opens a diff view filtered to show only changes for that specific file. ## v0.215.3 — 2025-12-03

This week's release brings rainbow brackets 🌈 (addressing [a feature request](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5259) with 1100 👍s), automatic detection of uv workspaces in the toolchain selector, the ability to set a default model for built-in external agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI), and support for OpenAI's GPT-5.1 model for BYOK users.

## Features

### AI

- Added support for OpenAI's GPT-5.1 model to BYOK. ([#43492](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43492))
- Agent: Added the ability to set a model as the default for a given built-in external agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Gemini CLI). ([#43122](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43122))
- Agent: Added support for specifying settings for ACP extensions (`default_mode`, `default_model`). ([#43177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43177))
- Agent: Improved the "reject"/"keep" behavior when regenerating older prompts by auto-keeping pending edits that don't originate from the prompt to-be-regenerated. ([#43347](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43347))
- Agent: Made the thread markdown editable. ([#43377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43377))

### Git

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Linux: Added `window_decorations` setting to control whether Zed or the compositor draws window decorations. This replaces the undocumented `ZED_WINDOW_DECORATIONS` environment variable, which still works but is deprecated. Set to `"server"` for system titlebars or `"client"` (default) for Zed's custom titlebar. Requires restart. ([#39250](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39250); thanks [Be-ing](https://github.com/Be-ing))
- Removed the default `cmd-opt-.` binding for toggling hidden files in the Project Panel so it's harder to hide them by accident. ([#43091](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43091))

## v0.214.5 — 2025-11-26

This week's release includes agent server extensions over SSH remoting, pretty TypeScript errors with language-aware Markdown, Vim range write commands, improved search performance in local projects, and new `project_panel.sort_mode` and `terminal.scrollbar.scroll_multiplier` settings.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added automatic retries for OpenAI-compatible LLM providers. ([#37891](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37891); thanks [timmclean](https://github.com/timmclean))
- Agent: When `@mention`-ing large files with no outline, their first 1KB is now added to context. ([#42543](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42543))
- Agent: Improved the modal to add LLM providers by making it responsive and keyboard navigable. ([#42983](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42983))
- Agent: Improved discoverability of the `cmd-n` keybinding to create a new thread with the currently selected agent. ([#42939](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42939))
- Agent: Improved the interaction with errors by allowing links to be clickable. ([#42732](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42732))
- Agent: Improved table rendering in the agent panel, ensuring cell text wraps, not going off-screen. ([#42674](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42674))
- Agent: Made agent file edits error if the file has changed since last read, allowing the agent to read changes and avoid overwriting changes made outside Zed. ([#42895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42895))
- Agent: Added support for per-target environment variables on Agent Server Extensions. ([#42683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42683))
- Agent: Made Agent Server Extensions available when doing SSH remoting. ([#42683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42683))
- Added support for configuring MCP servers that connect over HTTP in your settings file. These are not yet available in the extensions API. ([#39021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39021); thanks [AhegaoBurger](https://github.com/AhegaoBurger))
  ```json
  {
    "context_servers": {
      "my-remote-server": {
        "enabled": true,
        "url": "http://localhost:3000/mcp"
      }
    }
  }
  ```
- Signing out now clears the local cache containing the plan and usage information. ([#42678](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42678))

## v0.213.3 — 2025-11-19

This week's release includes support for Gemini Pro 3, a setting to enable sticky scroll for keeping scopes visible at the top of the editor, multi-word snippet prefixes, configurable default models for custom agent profiles, improved UI responsiveness when staging/unstaging large Git files, and support for HTML styling elements and table captions in Markdown preview.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the newly released Gemini 3 Pro model. ([#43015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43015); thanks [mInrOz](https://github.com/mInrOz))
- Agent: Added an icon button in the agent panel that allows triggering the @-mention menu (for adding context) now also with the mouse. ([#42449](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42449))
- Agent: Added support for opening thread as markdown in remote projects. ([#42182](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42182))
- Agent: Enabled configuring a default model for each custom agent profile, available through the `default_model` key in the settings. ([#39220](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39220); thanks [dvcrn](https://github.com/dvcrn))
- Agent: Enabled uninstalling agent servers from the agent panel's settings view. ([#42445](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42445))
- Agent: Recommended AI models now still appear in their normal category in addition to "Recommended". ([#42489](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42489))
- Agent: Improved API key configuration display in language model settings. ([#42306](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42306); thanks [chenmijiang](https://github.com/chenmijiang))
- Agent: Improved the `AddSelectionToThread` action display by only making it available when there are selections in the editor. ([#42280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42280))
- Agent: Restoring a checkpoint now stops the agent conversation. ([#42537](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42537))
- Agent: Restored horizontal scrollbars for codeblocks. ([#40736](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40736); thanks [xipeng-jin](https://github.com/xipeng-jin))
- Agent: Filtered out whitespace-only text content parts for OpenAI and OpenAI compatible providers. ([#40316](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40316); thanks [Maokaman1](https://github.com/Maokaman1))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Updated how clicking on multi-buffer headers works to provide better control and prevent unexpected navigation. ([#42021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42021))
  - Clicking the header now collapses/expands the file section instead of opening the file.
  - Opening files can be done by clicking the filename or the "Open file" button on the right side of the header.
  - Existing shortcuts continue to work: use the left chevron to collapse or your keyboard shortcut to jump to the file

- Auto Updates (and remote server binaries) are now downloaded via https://cloud.zed.dev instead of https://zed.dev. As before, these URLs redirect to the GitHub release for actual downloads. ([#42246](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42246))
- `./script/install.sh` will now fetch assets via `https://cloud.zed.dev/` instead of `https://zed.dev`. As before it will redirect to GitHub releases to complete the download. ([#42399](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42399))
- Removed `trigger` argument in `ShowCompletions` command. ([#42122](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/42122))

## v0.212.3 — 2025-11-12

This week's release brings the ability to deep-link to specific settings, git worktree management for opening worktrees in new windows, a `git: pull rebase` action, GitLab and Gitee avatar support in git blame, improved git blame performance, and better keyboard input handling for international layouts and IMEs on Windows.

## Features

### Git

Let's Git Together status:\
Current Progress: 55 of 136 issues closed, with 7 PRs shipped by the community.\
Goal: Close out 136 git issues by December 31, 2025.\
The git PRs are rolling in. We're shipping the features you've been asking for, side-by-side with our open source contributors.\
It's not too late to join! Check out our [git board](https://github.com/orgs/zed-industries/projects/48/views/1?pane=info) and tackle an issue with the team.

`*` = Shipped via Let's Git Together

---

- *Added `git: worktree` creation action and git worktree picker to open a git worktree in a new window or replace the current one. ([#38719](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38719); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- *Added `git: pull rebase` action for running `git pull --rebase`. ([#41117](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41117); thanks [Sathiyaraman-M](https://github.com/Sathiyaraman-M))
- *Added support for showing GitLab and self-hosted GitLab avatars in git blame. ([#41747](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41747); thanks [amtoaer](https://github.com/amtoaer))
- *Added support for showing Gitee avatars in git blame. ([#41783](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41783); thanks [amtoaer](https://github.com/amtoaer))
- *Improved UI feedback in the Git panel when a commit is in progress. ([#41686](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41686); thanks [joeinnes](https://github.com/joeinnes))
- Improved git blame performance by reducing the number of concurrent git processes spawned. ([#41472](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41472))
- *Fixed incorrect default repository selection when using remote. ([#41698](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41698); thanks [amtoaer](https://github.com/amtoaer))

## v0.211.4 — 2025-11-05

This week's release includes a new Windows Arm64 build, a `git: branch diff` action to diff the current branch against `main`, many quality-of-life rendering improvements to markdown preview, the ability to quickly jump to the keymap editor from the command palette to set / change keybindings, and improved inlay hints stability.

## Features

## AI

- Agent: Added the ability to install ACP agents via extensions. There will be a blog post covering this soon! ([#40663](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40663))
- Agent: Added file names and line numbers to symbol completions. ([#40508](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40508); thanks [pkondzior](https://github.com/pkondzior))
- Agent: Added support for changing the Codestral endpoint for Edit Prediction. ([#41116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41116); thanks [pedrxd](https://github.com/pedrxd))

  ```json
  "edit_predictions": {
    "codestral": {
      "api_url": "https://codestral.mistral.ai",
      "model": "codestral-latest",
      "max_tokens": 150
    }
  }
  ```

- Agent: Improved the editing previous messages UX by focusing in the agent panel's message editor after regenerating a prompt, instead of moving focus to the nearest regular buffer. ([#40938](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40938))
- Added experimental terminal-based authentication to ACP support. ([#41954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41954))
- Added support for GitHub Copilot /responses endpoint. ([#40762](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40762); thanks [somtooo](https://github.com/somtooo))

## Git

- Added the ability to view the diff of the current branch since main with `git: branch diff` from the command palette. ([#40188](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40188))

## Debugger

- Added a horizontal scrollbar for frame item and tooltip for variables. ([#41261](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41261); thanks [bnjjj](https://github.com/bnjjj))
- Added inline variable value display during debugging for JavaScript, TypeScript, and TSX. Variable values now appear inline in the editor while debugging, matching the experience available for Rust, Python, and Go. ([#40914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40914); thanks [taciclei](https://github.com/taciclei))

## Settings UI

- Added a warning banner when the settings file you are looking at is out of date and needs to be migrated. ([#41112](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41112))
- Enabled editing project settings for worktrees that don't have a project setting file. ([#40971](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40971))

## Languages

- Markdown Preview:
    - Added support for HTML lists. ([#39553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39553); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
    - Added support for `HTML` table column `align` attribute. ([#41163](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41163); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
    - Added support for `colspan` and `rowspan` for HTML tables. ([#39898](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39898); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
    - Improved nested list item prefix style. ([#39606](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39606); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Go: Added comment injections for `go.mod` and `go.work`. ([#40842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40842); thanks [thedadams](https://github.com/thedadams))

## Vim

- Added Vim motions on settings navigation menu. ([#39988](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39988); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Helix: Added `alt-o` & `alt-i` to `editor: select {larger,smaller} syntax node` respectively. ([#40527](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40527); thanks [atahrijouti](https://github.com/atahrijouti))

- Allowed `About Zed` menu entry to work when all Zed windows are closed. ([#41272](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41272))
- Keybinding: Pane key context now includes `buffer_search_deployed` identifier. ([#41193](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41193); thanks [FloppyDisco](https://github.com/FloppyDisco))
- Surfaced Jupyter client errors in the UI. ([#40886](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40886); thanks [lionel-](https://github.com/lionel-))
- Reduced selection opacity when the editor is out of focus to make inactive states clearer. ([#40925](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40925))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Agent: Improved discoverability of the previously called `agent: quote selection` action—which allows adding a text selection in a buffer as context within the agent panel—by renaming it to `agent: add selection to thread` and making it available from the right-click editor context menu as well as the `Selection` app menu. ([#40897](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40897))
- Fixed an issue with a settings migration that deprecated the `code_actions_on_format` setting. The `code_actions_on_format` setting has been un-deprecated, and affected users will have the bad migration rolled back with an updated migration. ([#40409](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40409))
- Enabled automatic import organization, via [ruff](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff), when saving Python files. ([#41103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/41103))
- Emacs Keymap: `alt-x`, `ctrl-x b`, and `ctrl-x ctrl-b` are now Workspace bindings. ([#40631](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40631); thanks [Affonso-Gui](https://github.com/Affonso-Gui))

  To revert to the previous default behavior, use:

  ```json
  "Python": { "code_actions_on_format": { "source.organizeImports.ruff": false } }
  ```


## v0.210.4 — 2025-10-29

[Sign up for Office Hours](https://luma.com/ie1j512u): On November 5, get an inside look into Zed's PR review process and get your PR reviewed live with [Conrad Irwin](https://github.com/conradirwin).

---

This week's release includes support for Claude Haiku 4.5 in the agent panel, git diff view support for stash entries, Settings UI improvements including validation warnings and searchable theme dropdowns, language enhancements for Markdown, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, C/C++, and Vue 3, Vim improvements including filename autocomplete, and performance optimizations for startup time and font rendering.

## Features

## AI

- Agent: Added Claude Haiku 4.5. ([#40298](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40298); thanks [versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe))
- Registered `.rules`, `.cursorrules`, `.windsurfrules`, and `.clinerules` as Markdown files. ([#40614](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40614))

## Git

- Added git diff view for stash entries. ([#38280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38280); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Added toolbar on git diff view for stash entries. ([#38280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38280); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))

- Added way to hide git blame popover by pressing the escape key. ([#40549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40549); thanks [timvermeulen](https://github.com/timvermeulen))
- Added the `editor::CollapseAllDiffHunks` action, mirroring the existing `editor::ExpandAllDiffHunks`. ([#40668](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40668); thanks [FloppyDisco](https://github.com/FloppyDisco))
- Added disabled state for "Uncommitted Changes" toolbar buttons when there are no changes present. ([#39909](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39909); thanks [Simek](https://github.com/Simek))
