- Python: Fixed an issue where multiple language servers were enabled by default. Now only `basedpyright` and `ruff` are enabled by default when opening Python files. If you prefer one of the others, see the [docs](https://zed.dev/docs/languages/python#configure-python-language-servers-in-zed) to configure them. ([#40604](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40604))
- Vim: Changed `ctrl+w` + `shift-[hjkl]` in Vim mode to move the split to span the entire border, aligning with Vim's behavior. ([#39123](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39123); thanks [tie](https://github.com/tie))
- Updated both the `editor: add selection above` and `editor: add selection below` commands to ignore soft wrapped lines. If you wish to restore the old behavior, add the following to your keymap file. ([#40190](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/40190)):
  ```
  {
    "context": "Editor",
    "bindings": {
      "cmd-alt-up": ["editor::AddSelectionAbove", { "skip_soft_wrap": false }],
      "cmd-alt-down": ["editor::AddSelectionBelow", { "skip_soft_wrap": false }]
    }
  }
  ```

## v0.208.4 — 2025-10-15

This week's release might be our largest ever, it includes:
- Support for Windows! 🪟🪟🪟
- Codex via ACP! 🌀🌀🌀
- A new UI for settings! ⚙️⚙️⚙️

As well as: significant performance improvements for the project panel when working in large projects, support for action sequences in keymap bindings allowing you to chain multiple actions together, support for HTML tables and HTML block quotes in Markdown preview, more image types supported in the agent panel, and support for the outline modal in channel notes.

### Windows

- Windows when? Windows now.

### AI

- Added support for OpenAI's Codex agent, via an ACP adapter. 
- Agent: Added support for pasting TIFF and BMP images in the agent panel. ([#39767](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39767))
- Agent: Introduced the `agent_buffer_font_size` setting and renamed `agent_font_size` to `agent_ui_font_size`, allowing for granular buffer font size control in the agent panel vs. regular editors. ([#39468](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39468))
- Agent: Aligned default shell path in system prompt with the actual path it is given. ([#39344](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39344))
- Agent: Added support for Codex, as an ACP agent.

### Git

- Added git status indicator icon in the title bar. Note: this is only visible when the following setting is applied: `"title_bar": {"show_branch_icon": true}`. ([#38029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38029); thanks [lzakharov](https://github.com/lzakharov))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Settings: Removed support for having format steps in both the `format_on_save` and `formatter` settings for languages. `format_on_save` is now restricted to the values of `"on"` and `"off"`, and all format steps should be set under the `formatter` key. If you were using `format_on_save` but not `formatter` this will be migrated for you, otherwise it will require a manual migration. ([#39400](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39400))
- Settings: Changed code action format in `formatter` and `format_on_save` settings. ([#39375](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39375))

  **Previous format:**
  ```
  {
    "code_actions": {
      "source.organizeImports": true,
      "source.fixAll": true
    }
  }
  ```

  **New format:**
  ```
  [
    {"code_action": "source.organizeImports"},
    {"code_action": "source.fixAll"}
  ]
  ```

  After #39246, code actions run sequentially in order. The structure now reflects this and aligns with other formatter options (e.g., language servers).
  Both the `formatter` settings will be auto-migrated.

- Zed will no longer use `node` from your `$PATH` if it's older than 22.x (previously, the minimum version was 20.x). Instead, it will fall back to its bundled `node`. This fixes being unable to use Copilot if an older `node` was installed system-wide. ([#39632](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39632))



## v0.207.4 — 2025-10-09

- By default, Zed will now keep your terminal selection after copying text from it. This matches the default copy behavior of many terminals (Terminal.app, Ghostty, VS Code's terminal, etc.). To opt into the previous behavior, use `"terminal": {"keep_selection_on_copy": false}`.
  - Thanks for the heads-up, [Steve Ruiz](https://x.com/steveruizok/status/1976030698420175162)!

## v0.207.3 — 2025-10-08

This week's release includes improved font rendering on Linux, Vim commands for navigating the project panel, the ability to search agent profiles, improved Markdown preview support, and a setting to add GitHub avatars in the Git blame gutter.

## Features

### AI

- Agent: Added the ability to search profiles in the agent panel's profile picker. ([#39218](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39218); thanks [dvcrn](https://github.com/dvcrn))

- Ollama: Added qwen3-coder to list of Ollama models. ([#38608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38608); thanks [sbe-arg](https://github.com/sbe-arg))

  - `ctrl-u` scrolls the project_panel up half of the visible entries
  - `ctrl-d` scrolls the project_panel down half of the visible entries

  - `z t` scrolls current selection to top of window
  - `z b` scrolls current selection to bottom of window
  - `{num} j` and `{num} k` now move up and down with a count

- Updated commit modal tooltip to show correct shortcut in amend mode; `cmd-enter` -> `shift-cmd-enter`. ([#39008](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39008); thanks [lemorage](https://github.com/lemorage))
- Enabled splitting git commit view pane. ([#39025](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39025))

- Markdown Preview: Improved table elements appearance. ([#39101](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39101); thanks [Simek](https://github.com/Simek))

### Other

- Linux: Implemented perceptual gamma / contrast correction for font rendering. ([#38862](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38862))
- Improved project search relevance by ranking results using match score instead of insertion order. ([#38795](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38795); thanks [tsjason](https://github.com/tsjason))
- Emacs's kill ring cut at the end of the last line of the file will now no-op instead of cutting the entire line. ([#39069](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39069); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))
- Improved focus visibility of the actions within Zed's UI system prompt. ([#39106](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/39106))
- Collab: A distinct sound effect is now used for when a guest joins a call. ([#38987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38987))
- Linux: Added missing linear to sRGB transform in mono sprite rendering. ([#38944](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38944))

Users who could not previously open `zed://*` URLs in the editor can now do so by pasting the link into a buffer and using the `editor: open url` action (please open an issue if this is the case for you!). ### Git

## v0.205.4 — 2025-09-24

This week's release includes a stash picker, apply and drop git stash commands, the ability to amend commit messages without having any changes in your working copy, better drag-and-drop support in the project panel, better error reporting when the auto-updater fails, and improved token consumption when mentioning large files in the agent panel. Also, for the Pythonistas 🐍, Zed now directly ships with the [`ty`](https://docs.astral.sh/ty/) language server (disabled by default) and [`Ruff`](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/) (enabled by default) - no need to install the extensions for these anymore!

## Features

### General

- Added support for drag-and-drop files and external paths into the empty space of the project panel, placing them in the last folder you have added to the project. ([#38008](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38008))
- Improved drag-and-drop support by allowing folded directories to be dragged onto other items in the project panel. ([#38070](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38070))
- Added `whitespace_map` setting to control which visible characters are used to render whitespace when the `show_whitespace` setting is enabled. ([#37704](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37704); thanks [iluuu1994](https://github.com/iluuu1994))
- Improved error reporting when auto-updating fails. ([#38241](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38241))
- Added scrollbars to the markdown preview and syntax tree view. ([#38183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38183))
- Added `pane::SplitAndMove{Up,Down,Left,Right}` to allow creating a split without cloning the current buffer. ([#38034](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38034))
- Added support for icon themes to change the folder icon based on the directory name. ([#36351](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36351); thanks [jacobtread](https://github.com/jacobtread))
- Added reusing of reference search buffers when applicable. ([#37994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37994))
- Improved autosave behavior to prevent a confirmation dialog when quickly closing files and using the `afterDelay` setting. ([#36929](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36929); thanks [itsaphel](https://github.com/itsaphel))
- Improved the displayed keybinding for the `pane::GoForward` action on Linux. ([#38221](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38221); thanks [RocketRide9](https://github.com/RocketRide9))
- Installing a dev extension will now automatically remove the release extension should it be installed. ([#38088](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38088))
- Improved `ctrl-k` (`editor::CutToEndOfLine`) behavior when used at the end of lines. ([#34553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34553); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))
- Added an option to make `editor::CutToEndOfLine` not gobble newlines. ([#34553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34553); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))

```json
{
    "context": "Editor",
    "bindings": {"ctrl-k": ["editor::CutToEndOfLine", { "stop_at_newlines": true }]}
}
```

- Added `repl.max_columns` and `repl.max_lines` settings. ([#37927](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37927); thanks [cvanelteren](https://github.com/cvanelteren))
- Allowed `0` as a value for the `excerpt_context_lines` setting. ([#37982](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37982))

### AI

- ACP: Passed proxy settings through to all ACP agents. ([#38247](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38247))
- Agent: Added the `agent.message_editor_min_lines` setting to allow users to customize the agent panel message editor default size by using a different minimum number of lines. ([#37975](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37975); thanks [ojkelly](https://github.com/ojkelly))
- Agent: When an agent requests a tool that doesn't exist, this is now treated as a failed tool call instead of stopping the thread. ([#38207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38207))
- Agent: Added support for API key and API URL to connect to remote Ollama provider. This also adds URL and API key to be set from agent panel settings. ([#34110](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34110); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added ability to control Provider Routing for OpenRouter models from settings. ([#37979](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37979); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: When `@mention`ing large files, the Agent Panel now sends an outline of the file instead of the whole thing. ([#38032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38032))
- Agent: Added an error message when a Gemini response contains a `block_reason`. ([#38670](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38670))

### Vim / Helix

- Helix: Added dedicated "helix select" mode that can be targeted by keybindings. ([#37748](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37748); thanks [romaninsh](https://github.com/romaninsh))

### Git

- Added more git stash functionality. ([#35927](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35927); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
    - Added a stash picker to pop and drop a specific stash entry.
    - Added git stash apply command.
    - Added git stash drop command.
    - Disabled the stash pop action on the git panel when no stash entries exist.
- Commit messages can now be amended in the UI without any other changes needing to be made. ([#37256](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37256); thanks [Hawkbawk](https://github.com/Hawkbawk))
- Added tooltip to Git branch picker items, making it easier to distinguish long branch names. ([#38261](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38261))
- Used `\x00` representation instead of literal null character in strings to improve compatibility with git diff and GitHub's diff viewer. ([#38033](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38033); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))

### Languages

- Python: Improved toolchain prioritization of local virtual environments. ([#37510](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37510); thanks [dunkmann00](https://github.com/dunkmann00))
- TypeScript: Added out-of-the-box support for Tailwind completions in `.ts` files. ([#38254](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38254))

## v0.204.1 — 2025-09-17

This week's release includes support for using the `basedpyright` Python language server by default, external agents over SSH, plan mode for Claude Code, Git uncommit and blame view in multi buffers, more syntax tree navigation commands, a more familiar terminal toggling action that matches VSCode and JetBrains behavior, better URL detection in the terminal, many language improvements, and more!

## Features

### General

- Added blame view and inline blame support for multi buffer editors. ([#37366](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37366))
- Added a new action `terminal::Toggle` that is by default bound to 'ctrl-\`'. This copies the default behavior from VSCode and JetBrains where the terminal opens and closes correctly. If you'd like the old behavior you can rebind 'ctrl-\`' to `terminal::ToggleFocus`. ([#37585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37585))
- Terminal: Improved URL detection to now correctly handle trailing punctuation from sentence context. URLs ending with periods (like `https://example.com.`) and unbalanced parentheses (like `https://example.com/path)`) are now properly detected without including the trailing punctuation. ([#37684](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37684); thanks [Mearman](https://github.com/Mearman))
- Terminal: Improved terminal path hyperlink navigation by considering the terminal working directory. ([#36962](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36962); thanks [davewa](https://github.com/davewa))
- Added `project_panel::OpenSplitVertical` and `project_panel::OpenSplitHorizontal` actions for opening files in splits. ([#36973](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36973); thanks [tie](https://github.com/tie))
- Added `editor::GoToNextDocumentHighlight` and `editor::GoToPreviousDocumentHighlight` to navigate to the next LSP document highlight. Useful for navigating to the next usage of a certain symbol. ([#35994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35994); thanks [MarcoPolo](https://github.com/MarcoPolo))
- Added the ability to specify a human-readable project name for each worktree. ([#36713](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36713); thanks [Warpten](https://github.com/Warpten))
- Added `editor: select {next,previous} syntax node` actions. ([#35053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35053); thanks [idanov](https://github.com/idanov))
- Added a new `diagnostics: display current file` command to view diagnostics for the currently open file. ([#34430](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34430); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))
- Added line ending selector. ([#35392](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35392); thanks [MatinAniss](https://github.com/MatinAniss))
- Changed the syntax tree view to stay attached to the buffer it was opened in, similar to the Markdown preview. Use the `UseActiveEditor` action when the view is shown to change it to the last focused editor. ([#37570](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37570))
- Updated error view to show the error in invalid buffer view. ([#37657](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37657))
- Improved fallback open picker to be more intuitive. ([#37564](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37564))
- Changed remote projects to sync in local user settings. ([#37560](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37560))
- Linux: Migrated to newer version of Blade upstream. ([#37516](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37516); thanks [WERDXZ](https://github.com/WERDXZ))
- Added ability to create sub-directories when renaming a file in file finder. ([#37437](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37437); thanks [Zertsov](https://github.com/Zertsov))
- Improved word deletions to consider whitespace sequences and brackets by default. ([#37352](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37352))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Removed the chat feature from Zed (Sorry to the 5 of you who use this on the regular!). ([#37789](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37789))
- Added built-in support for the `basedpyright` language server for Python. `basedpyright` is now enabled by default, and `pyright` (the primary Python language server previously) remains available, but is disabled by default. This supersedes the `basedpyright` extension, which can be uninstalled. Advantages of `basedpyright` over pyright include support for inlay hints, semantic highlighting, auto-import code actions, and stricter type checking. To switch back to `pyright`, add the following configuration to settings.json:

```json
{
  "languages": {
    "Python": {
      "language_servers": ["pyright", "pylsp", "!basedpyright"]
    }
  }
}
```

- Added bindings for navigating between sibling nodes in the syntax tree on macOS (`cmd-ctrl-{up/down}` for `SelectPreviousSyntaxNode` and `SelectNextSyntaxNode`). Breaking change: the existing syntax tree parent/child navigation bindings have moved from `ctrl-shift-{left/right}` to `cmd-ctrl-{left/right}` to create a unified four-directional navigation pattern where all syntax tree operations use the same modifier combination. We could not use the previous base modifiers without breaking more bindings. ([#37874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37874))


## v0.203.5 — 2025-09-12

- Fixed a bug where automatic updates were disabled by default for everyone.  ([#38022](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/38022))

----

⚠️Due to this bug, Zed's version v0.203.x through v0.204.0 will *not* automatically update. ⚠️ 

You will need to:
* Open the command palette (cmd-shift-p on macOS, ctrl-shift-p on Linux) and type "auto update: check" 
* Or (on macOS) open the Zed menu and click "Check for updates"
* Or, download [the latest version](https://zed.dev/download)

We are sorry for the mistake.


## v0.203.4 — 2025-09-10

This week's release includes native macOS window tabbing support, enhanced font rendering with perceptual gamma correction and improved text contrast, expanded AI provider compatibility with configurable MCP tool timeouts and improved Ollama/OpenRouter handling, improvements to Vim/Helix, and much more!

## Features

### General

- Improved font rendering quality via perceptual gamma / contrast correction. ([#37167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37167))
- Improved text contrast when selected or highlighted in the editor. ([#37165](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37165))
- Added support for native macOS window tabbing. When you set `"use_system_window_tabs": true`, Zed will merge windows in the same way as macOS: by default this happens only when full screened, but you can adjust your macOS settings to have this happen on all windows. ([#33334](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33334); thanks [gaauwe](https://github.com/gaauwe))
- Added support for configuring the number of context lines shown in a multibuffer via new `excerpt_context_lines` setting. ([#37138](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37138))
- Added support for rewrap in block comments. ([#34418](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34418); thanks [claytonrcarter](https://github.com/claytonrcarter))
- Added setting `rounded_selection` to disable rounded corners for text selection. ([#36987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36987); thanks [tie](https://github.com/tie))
- Added LSP log tracing in both remote collab and remote SSH environments. ([#36709](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36709), [#37083](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37083))
- Debugger: Added option to only show stack frames from user's project in stack frame list. ([#37061](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37061))
- Extensions: Added installation and updates to the activity indicator. ([#37374](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37374))
- Markdown Preview: Added HTML `<img src="/some-image.svg">` tag support. ([#36700](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36700); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Markdown Preview: Fixed auto size rendering of SVG images in Markdown. ([#36663](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36663); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Preserved search options between buffer search dismisses. ([#36954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36954); thanks [tidely](https://github.com/tidely))

### AI

- Added support for configurable timeout for MCP tool calls. ([#33348](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33348); thanks [ribelo](https://github.com/ribelo))
- Ollama: Resolved an issue with the Ollama provider that caused requests to fail with a 400 error for models that don't support tools. The tools object is now only sent to compatible models to ensure successful requests. ([#37221](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37221); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))

- Edit Prediction: Added Zlib license to open-source licenses eligible for data collection. ([#37238](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37238))
- Edit Prediction: Added various BSD licenses to open-source licenses eligible for data collection. ([#37194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/37194))

## v0.202.5 — 2025-09-03

Last week we launched [Agent Client Protocol (ACP)](https://agentclientprotocol.com/overview/introduction), an open standard for integrating external agents with editors. Today we're launching beta support for [Claude Code](https://www.anthropic.com/claude-code) in Zed via our [ACP adapter](https://github.com/zed-industries/claude-code-acp) for the Claude Code SDK! Read more about it in the [blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/claude-code-via-acp).

This week's release also contains plenty of improvements to Zed itself. An enhanced tab switcher with diagnostics indicators and preview functionality; file icons in multibuffers; the ability to run `rust-analyzer`'s flycheck actions from anywhere in the project, and support for xAI's `grok-code-fast-1`.

## Features

- Added diagnostics indicators to the tab switcher. ([#34547](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34547); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Improved tab switcher; it now shows a preview of the selected tab. ([#36718](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36718))
- Added setting for disabling drag and drop in project panel: `{ "project_panel": {"drag_and_drop": false } }`. ([#36719](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36719))
- Added file icons to multi-buffer view. ([#36836](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36836); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Added support for .editorconfig's `max_line_length` property. ([#36426](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36426); thanks [learnitall](https://github.com/learnitall))
- Restored the zoomed panel padding. ([#36884](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36884))
- Added `zoomed_padding` to allow disabling of padding around zoomed panels. ([#31913](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31913); thanks [Cretezy](https://github.com/Cretezy))
- Adjusted the file finder to show matching file paths when adding `:row:column` to the query. ([#36025](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36025); thanks [henne90gen](https://github.com/henne90gen))
- Improved the flow when attempting to open an unsupported file in Zed. ([#36764](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36764))

- Introduced `min_words_query_len` threshold for automatic word completion display, and set it to 3 by default to make them less intrusive. ([#36745](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36745))

## v0.201.4 — 2025-08-27

This week, we are launching [Agent Client Protocol (ACP)](https://agentclientprotocol.com/overview/introduction), an open standard for integrating external agents with editors, with support for [Google's Gemini CLI](https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/gemini-cli) as the first integration. Read more about it in the [blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/bring-your-own-agent-to-zed)!

This week's release also contains plenty of improvements to Zed itself. An improved Python virtual environment propagation to LSP for more reliable language features, configurable auto-indentation per language, file status indicators in multibuffer headers, an improved project panel empty state, and support for xAI's `grok-code-fast-1`.

## Features

- Added rendering of file status indicators for multibuffer headers. ([#36489](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36489))
- Added context menu for buffer titles. ([#36398](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36398))
- Added an option for the `status_bar.cursor_position_button`. Setting to `false` will hide the button. It defaults to `true`. ([#36288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36288); thanks [zumbalogy](https://github.com/zumbalogy))
- Added support for highlighting where a dragged tab will be dropped between two other tabs. ([#34740](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34740); thanks [djsauble](https://github.com/djsauble))
- Added an env flag (`ZED_BUILD_REMOTE_SERVER=nomusl`) to opt out of musl builds when building the remote server. ([#36069](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36069); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Keymap Editor: Added a button in the top left to allow opening the keymap JSON file. Right-clicking the button provides shortcuts to opening the default Zed and Vim keymaps as well. ([#36182](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36182))
- Improved visuals of zoomed panels. ([#36012](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36012); thanks [Cretezy](https://github.com/Cretezy))
- Improved file sorting by making alphabetical sorting the default. ([#32315](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32315); thanks [TomPlanche](https://github.com/TomPlanche))
- Improved the search function in the terminal when Vim mode is activated. ([#33305](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33305); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))

## AI

- Agent: [ACP support](https://agentclientprotocol.com/overview/introduction).
- Agent: Font size will now inherit the UI font size by default if not set in your settings. ([#36306](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36306))
- Agent: Automatically select a language model provider if there's no user-set provider. ([#36722](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36722))
- Agent: The fetch tool now requires confirmation. ([#36881](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36881))
- Agent: Added the `grok-code-fast-1` model to xAI's list of available models. ([#36959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36959); thanks [Nitemaeric](https://github.com/Nitemaeric))

## Git

## v0.200.4 — 2025-08-20

This week's release includes operating system-specific settings, improved Edit Prediction latency, subtle and eager modes for Copilot and Supermaven, thinking support for Mistral, the ability to clone Git repositories, file comparison through the project panel, and support for adjusting the reasoning effort for OpenAI models.

## Features

- Settings can now be configured per operating system with the new top-level fields: `"macos"`/`"windows"`/`"linux"`. These will override user-level settings, but are lower precedence than _release channel_ settings. ([#35756](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35756))
- Added an `editor: unwrap syntax node` action. ([#31421](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31421); thanks [Gregoor](https://github.com/Gregoor))
- Added the ability to set theme-specific overrides via the `theme_overrides` setting. ([#30860](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30860); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Added setting `status_bar.show_active_language_button` to show/hide the language button in the status bar. ([#33977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33977); thanks [zumbalogy](https://github.com/zumbalogy))
- Added `project_panel.starts_open` to control opening the project panel in new projects. ([#34752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34752); thanks [maan2003](https://github.com/maan2003))
- Added new keymap contexts for various pickers: CommandPalette, GitBranchSelector, GitRepositorySelector, RecentProjects, LanguageSelector, IconThemeSelector, ThemeSelector. ([#35665](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35665))
- Added icon for Puppet (`.pp`) files. ([#35778](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35778); thanks [Tonguechaude](https://github.com/Tonguechaude))
- Improved diagnostics performance in collaborative mode. ([#35794](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35794))
- Improved usability of close tab and pin tab buttons by making them slightly larger. ([#34428](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34428); thanks [djsauble](https://github.com/djsauble))
- Keymap Editor: Added a warning to the keybind editing modal when existing bindings have the same keystrokes. Clicking the warning will close the modal and show bindings with the entered keystrokes in the keymap editor. This behavior was previously possible with the `keymap_editor::ShowMatchingKeybinds` action in the Keymap Editor, and is now present in the keybind editing modal as well. ([#35732](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35732))

## AI

- Agent: Added thinking to Mistral Provider. ([#32476](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32476); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added support for Ollama `gpt-oss`. ([#35648](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35648); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Create agent checkpoints more frequently (before every edit). ([#36253](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36253))
- Agent: OpenAI-compatible models now have configurable capabilities. ([#36370](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36370); thanks [@calesennett](https://github.com/calesennett))
- Added a setting to control `reasoning_effort` in OpenAI models. ([#35929](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35929); thanks [Cretezy](https://github.com/Cretezy))

```json5
"language_models": {
  "openai": {
    "available_models": [
      {
        "name": "gpt-5-mini",
        "display_name": "GPT 5 Mini (custom reasoning)",
        "max_output_tokens": 128000,
        "max_tokens": 272000,
        "reasoning_effort": "high" // Can be minimal, low, medium (default), and high
      }
    ],
    "version": "1"
  }
}
```

- Edit Prediction: Improved latency. ([#35968](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35968))
- Edit Prediction: Added Apache 2.0 license to open-source licenses eligible for data collection. ([#35900](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35900))
- Edit Prediction: Made license detection update eligibility for data collection when license files change. ([#35900](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35900))

## Debugger

- Added `Run to Cursor` back to Editor's context menu. ([#35745](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35745))
- Filtered out more invalid debug configurations from the debug picker. ([#35744](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35744))

## Git

- Added the ability to diff a file against another through the project panel's `compare marked files` context menu item. ([#35255](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35255); thanks [mcwindy](https://github.com/mcwindy))
- Added the ability to clone remote Git repositories through the `git: Clone` action. ([#35606](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35606))
- Added Subtle and Eager edit prediction modes to Copilot and Supermaven. ([#35548](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35548); thanks [raphaelluethy](https://github.com/raphaelluethy))
- Added configurable padding to inline blame via `git.inline_blame.padding`. ([#33631](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33631); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Surfaced Bitbucket pull request number. ([#34584](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34584); thanks [nihgwu](https://github.com/nihgwu))

## Languages

- Vue: Added support for Emmet in Vue.js files. ([#35599](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35599); thanks [xar](https://github.com/xar))

## Vim

- Added support for filenames in both `:tabnew` and `:tabedit` commands. ([#35775](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35775); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))
- Added `ctrl-y`/`ctrl-e` in insert mode to copy the next character from the line above or below. ([#36017](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36017))

## Bug Fixes

- Windows: Fixed an issue where rust-analyzer was not installed correctly. ([#36056](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36056))
- Windows: Fixed underline flickering. ([#35989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35989))
- Windows: Fixed wavy underlines looking inconsistent on different displays. ([#35816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35816))

- Fixed icon detection for files with custom suffixes like `module.ts` that are overwritten by the language's icon `.ts`. ([#34170](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34170); thanks [gilmar-sales](https://github.com/gilmar-sales))
- Fixed input being sent to editor/terminal when pending keystrokes are resolved. ([#35979](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35979))

- Fixed file finder borders not rendering properly. ([#35684](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35684); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Fixed terminal scrollbar covering bottom right text by adding proper content padding when scrollbar is visible. ([#33636](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33636); thanks [ddoemonn](https://github.com/ddoemonn))
- Fixed bug where context menu doesn't circle back to the first item when the last item is not selectable. ([#35875](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35875); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Fixed API key input fields getting shrunk in Agent Panel settings view on low panel widths paired with high UI font sizes. ([#36362](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36362))
- Fixed an issue where Dart projects were being formatted incorrectly by the language server. ([#36234](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36234))
- Fixed a bug where changing the `toolbar.breadcrumbs` setting didn't immediately update the UI when saving the `settings.json` file. ([#36177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36177))
- Fixed a bug where the sign-in success page would show prematurely during the sign-in flow. ([#36440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36440))
- Fixed a rare startup crash on macOS. ([#36382](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36382))
- Fixed a crash that could occur when an inlay hint ended with `...`. ([#36405](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36405))

- Changed the default split directions for the `pane: split horizontal` and `pane: split vertical` actions. You can restore the old behavior by modifying the `pane_split_direction_horizontal` and `pane_split_direction_vertical` values in your settings. ## v0.199.5 — 2025-08-13

This week's release includes vision support for OpenAI models, improved project search performance, an option to create a branch from a default branch, a toggle to enable/disable edit predictions across all files, and experimental support for settings profiles.

## Features

- Added vision support for OpenAI models. ([#36047](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36047))
- Improved prompt caching for OpenAI models. ([#36065](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/36065))
- Improved project search speed. ([#35470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35470))
- Improved the YAML outline to include the key's value if it's a simple string. ([#35562](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35562))
- Linux: Improved visibility of prompt dialog by dimming the background. ([#35348](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35348))
- Linux: Improved support for `zed://` URLs. ([#35597](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35597))
- Changed the icon of the language servers entry in the status bar. ([#35373](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35373); thanks [ThatOneCalculator](https://github.com/ThatOneCalculator))
- Added `workspace::ToggleEditPrediction` action for toggling `show_edit_predictions` in settings (Edit Predictions menu -> All Files). ([#35418](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35418))
- Added icon for KDL (`.kdl`) files. ([#35377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35377); thanks [ThatOneCalculator](https://github.com/ThatOneCalculator))
- Introduced experimental support to configure settings profiles via the "profiles" key. To set a temporary profile, use `settings profile selector: toggle`. ([#35339](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35339))

```json
{
  "profiles": {
    "Streaming": {
      "agent_font_size": 20,
      "buffer_font_size": 20,
      "theme": "One Light",
      "ui_font_size": 20
    }
  }
}
```

## v0.198.2 — 2025-08-06

This week's release includes performance improvements for projects with large numbers of repositories, memory optimization for GPU rendering, enhancements to the keymap editor's keystroke input and layout, Git stash/pop functionality through the Git panel, and Vim mode support for the `:norm` command.

## Features

- Keymap Editor: Added a short timeout to the stop recording keybind handling in the keystroke input, so that it is now possible using the default bindings as an example (custom bindings should work as well) to search for/enter a binding ending with `escape` (with no modifier), pause for a moment, then hit `escape escape escape` to stop recording and search for/enter a keystroke ending with `escape`. ([#35289](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35289))
- Keymap Editor: Made the keymap editor denser, improving how easy you can parse it at a glance. ([#35236](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35236))
- Windows: Searching Windows paths is now possible with a forward slash. ([#35198](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35198))
- Improved support for keyboard-based dock show/hide in Jetbrains keymap. ([#35234](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35234))
- Added collapse functionality to outline entries, allowing you to collapse/expand sections in the outline view. ([#33490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33490); thanks [NRodriguezcuellar](https://github.com/NRodriguezcuellar))
- Added a new `expand_outlines_with_depth` setting to customize how deep the tree is expanded by default when a file is opened. ([#33490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33490); thanks [NRodriguezcuellar](https://github.com/NRodriguezcuellar))
- Added support for closing docks (sidebars) with `shift-escape` in the Jetbrains keymaps. ([#35230](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35230))

- Added icon for SurrealQL (`.surql`) files. ([#34855](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34855); thanks [ThatOneCalculator](https://github.com/ThatOneCalculator))
- Improved Zed's performance in projects with large numbers of repositories. ([#35052](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35052))
- Improved highlighting of regex errors in search dialogs. ([#35001](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35001))
- Improved display of environment variables in LSP Logs: Server Info view. ([#34971](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34971))

## Git

- Added a menu entry on the git panel to git stash and git pop stash. ([#32821](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32821); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Improved support for GitHub remote URLs where the username/organization is preceded by an extra `/` to match the behavior of `git`, `gh` and `github.com`. ([#34134](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34134); thanks [zacharyhamm](https://github.com/zacharyhamm))

## Vim

  - Vim style <C-w> and zed style <ctrl-w>
- Differs from Vim in how multi-line is handled:

  - Zed is combinational (with multi-cursor)

- Improved append (`insert_after`) to better match helix's behavior: move cursor to end of selection if it exists. ([#34765](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34765); thanks [praguevara](https://github.com/praguevara))

## Languages

- Python: Zed now reports a slightly different set of workspace folders for Python projects to work around quirks in handling of multi-lsp projects with virtual environment. This behavior will be revisited in the near future. ([#35243](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35243))
- Added support for running Go benchmarks named "Benchmark". ([#35167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35167); thanks [rfratto](https://github.com/rfratto))

## v0.197.3 — 2025-07-30

This week's release includes Magistral support for Ollama, a screen selector dropdown for picking which screen to share when collaborating through Zed, an option to disable all AI features in Zed, automatic retries on more failed requests in the Agent panel, debugger data breakpoint access type specification, improvements to the keymap editor, and a new action to diff the current selection against the clipboard contents.


## Features

- Added screen selector dropdown to screen share button. ([#31506](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31506))
- Added 25+ keybinds to the macOS and Linux/Windows JetBrains compatibility keymaps. ([#34641](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34641))
- Added `panel.sticky_entry.background` theme selector for modifying project panel entries when they become sticky when scrolling and overlap with entries below them. ([#34655](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34655); thanks [bcomnes](https://github.com/bcomnes))
- Added `none` as one of the values for `snippet_sort_order` to completely disable snippet completion. ([#34565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34565); thanks [zeux](https://github.com/zeux))
- Keymap Editor: Made keystroke search matches match based on ordered (not necessarily contiguous) runs. For example, searching for `cmd shift-j` will match `cmd-k cmd-shift-j alt-q` and `cmd-i g shift-j` but not `alt-k shift-j` or `cmd-k alt-j`.

## Agent

- The Agent panel now automatically retries failed requests under more circumstances. ([#34842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34842))
- Added support for adding multiple OpenAI API compatible providers. ([#34212](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34212))
- Added the `use_modifier_to_send` setting, which makes holding a modifier (`cmd`/`ctrl`), together with `enter`, required to send a new message. ([#34709](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34709), [#34866](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34866))
- Improved Bedrock streaming by eliminating response buffering delays. ([#33931](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33931); thanks [tiagoq](https://github.com/tiagoq))
- Added setting to disable all AI features (`"disable_ai": true`). ([#34896](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34896))
- Agent: Added magistral support to ollama. ([#35000](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35000); thanks [@versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe))
- Agent: Added support for magistral-small and magistral-medium. ([#34983](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34983))
- Agent: Added support for Mistral Devstral Medium. ([#34888](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34888))
- Agent: Context servers will now be spawned in the currently active project root. ([#35271](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35271))
- Agent: The edit tool can now access files outside the current project, but only if the user grants it permission to. ([#35221](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35221))
- LMStudio: Display specific backend error messaging on failure rather than generic ones ([#34538](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34538))

## Debugger

- Added support for Go subtest runner with raw string names. ([#34636](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34636); thanks [Spissable](https://github.com/Spissable))
- Added support for specifying a data breakpoint's access type - Read, Write, Read & Write. ([#34639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34639))

## Git

- Added an `editor: diff clipboard with selection` action. ([#33283](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33283))
- Added git `--signoff` support. ([#29874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29874); thanks [ericcornelissen](https://github.com/ericcornelissen))
- Improved the git `--amend` experience. ([#29874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29874); thanks [ericcornelissen](https://github.com/ericcornelissen))
- Improved git panel to persist width as well as amend and signoff on a per-workspace basis. ([#29874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29874); thanks [ericcornelissen](https://github.com/ericcornelissen))

## Vim

- Added `;` key binding to collapse the current text selection in Helix mode. ([#34315](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34315); thanks [djsauble](https://github.com/djsauble))
- Added `editor::BlameHover` action for showing the git blame popover under the cursor. By default bound to `ctrl-k ctrl-b` and to `g h` in vim mode. ([#32096](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32096); thanks [Daste745](https://github.com/Daste745))

## Languages

- Improved indentation during typing for C/C++ around if/for/while/do blocks. ([#34549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34549); thanks [zeux](https://github.com/zeux))

## Bug Fixes

- Agent: Fixed a crash that occurred when jumping from a message to a thread included in the context. ([#34843](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34843))
- Agent: Fixed an issue where clicking on "Start New Thread" in the agent configuration would not always switch to the correct provider/model. ([#34708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34708))
- Agent: Fixed a regression where the keybindings for the `New Thread` and `New Text Thread` entries were missing from the `New Thread...` menu. ([#34967](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34967))
- Debugger: Fixed debug console persist to history when reusing a previous item. ([#34893](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34893); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Debugger: Fixed built-in JavaScript debug tasks were not working due to missing `type` field value. ([#34894](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34894); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Debugger: Fixed attaching with DebugPy. DebugPy is now installed automatically from pip (instead of GitHub), unless it is present in active virtual environment. Additionally this should resolve any startup issues with missing .so on Linux. ([#34706](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34706))
- Vim: Fixed an issue so `ctrl-w` / `ctrl-h` and `ctrl-u` work in pickers on Linux when Vim mode is enabled. ([#34840](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34840))
- Linux: xkb-defined hotkeys for arrow keys should behave as expected. ([#34823](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34823); thanks [stillonearth](https://github.com/stillonearth))
- Linux: Fixed an issue where button clicks wouldn't work on startup until clicked on the center pane. ([#34590](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34590))
- Wayland/Linux: Made resizing smoother on Wayland/Linux. ([#34760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34760); thanks [sethdusek](https://github.com/sethdusek))
- Fixed search filter patterns on remote projects. ([#34748](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34748); thanks [maan2003](https://github.com/maan2003))
- Fixed an issue where closing remote workspace restores last local workspace on startup. ([#34931](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34931))
- Fixed an issue where the last removed folder from workspace used to reopen on Zed startup. ([#34925](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34925))
- Fixed empty pane being left after a binary file is dropped into a new pane. ([#34908](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34908))
- Fixed an issue where redo would not work after buffer formatting (including formatting on save) when the formatting did not result in any changes. ([#34898](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34898))
- Fixed textmate keymap misbehaving in certain contexts. ([#34895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34895))
- Fixed an issue where scrollbars would appear in containers where no scrolling was possible. ([#34832](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34832))
- Fixed `workspace: open in terminal` action not working with paths that contain spaces in SSH projects. ([#34844](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34844))
- Fixed an issue where accepting variable completion in PHP would result in a double $ sign in the prefix. ([#34726](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34726))
- Fixed an issue where the cursor doesn't move up and down on arrow keys when no completions are shown. ([#34678](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34678))
- Fixed the issue where the green (+) cursor style sometimes appears when navigating to the definition in buffer. ([#34638](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34638))
- Fixed regressions with loading environment variables in nushell ([#35002](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35002), [#35054](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/35054))
- Fixed project panel not opening when `project panel: rename` and `project panel: duplicate` actions are triggered from workspace. ([#34988](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34988))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- The context predicates in the keymap file now handle ! and > differently. Before this change ! meant "this node does not match", now it means "none of these nodes match". Before this change > meant "child of", now it means "descendent of". We do not expect these changes to break many keymaps, but they may cause subtle changes for complex context queries. ([#34664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34664))
- Renamed `CloseInactiveItems` action to `CloseOtherItems` for naming consistency. ([#34676](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34676))

## v0.196.5 — 2025-07-23

This week's release includes a new keymap editor view, a memory view for the debugger, support for data breakpoints, improved user/agent collaborative editing where the agent now receives diffs of user edits, automatic retry for more Agent errors, and the ability to rename, delete, and duplicate files via the command palette when focused on the workspace.

## Features

- Introduced a new keymap editor view:
    - Search for existing actions via keystroke input
    - Set keybindings via keystroke input
- Added support for streaming LSP workspace diagnostics. ([#34022](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34022); thanks [4teapo](https://github.com/4teapo))
- Added `project panel: rename`, `project panel: delete` and `project panel: duplicate` actions to workspace. ([#34478](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34478))
- Added `editor: toggle focus` action, which focuses the last active editor pane item. ([#34495](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34495))
- Added `panel.sticky_entry.background` theme selector for modifying project panel entries when they become sticky when scrolling and overlap with entries below them. ([#34655](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34655); thanks [bcomnes](https://github.com/bcomnes))
- Linux / Windows: Added `show_menus` setting to always show menu bar. ([#34139](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34139))
- macOS: Added default mappings for `alt-delete` and `cmd-delete` in Terminal (delete word to right; delete to end of line). ([#34493](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34493))
- Added ability to fold all excerpts in a multibuffer (`alt-click`) and in singleton buffers `editor::ToggleFoldAll`. ([#34317](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34317))
- Added `severity` argument to `editor::GoToDiagnostic`, `editor::GoToPreviousDiagnostic`, `project_panel::SelectNextDiagnostic` and `project_panel::SelectPrevDiagnostic` actions. ([#33995](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33995); thanks [happenslol](https://github.com/happenslol))
- Added Google Repo `.repo` folders to default `file_scan_exclusions`. ([#34431](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34431))
- Improved performance with the minimap enabled. ([#33067](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33067))
- Improved behavior when clicking a sticky item in the Project Panel so it scrolls just enough for the item to no longer be sticky. ([#34367](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34367))

## Agent

- Added a chip communicating which Zed plan you're subscribed to in the agent panel settings view. ([#34503](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34503))
- Added support for clicking on the header of the read file tool to jump to the exact file location. ([#33161](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33161); thanks [max-frai](https://github.com/max-frai))
- Enhanced `read_file` tool call result message for long files. ([#34542](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34542); thanks [Damecek](https://github.com/Damecek))
- Improved user/agent collaborative editing: agent now receives diffs of user edits. ([#34487](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34487))
- Automatic retry for more Agent errors. ([#34473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34473))
- Whenever the Agent stops, play a sound (if configured) and show a notification (if configured) if the Zed window was in the background. ([#34473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34473))
- Preserve unsent chat message text when creating a new thread. ([#34150](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34150))
- Disabled `project_notifications` by default for the time being. ([#34619](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34619))
- Only auto-retry Agent requests when Burn Mode is enabled. ([#34669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34669))

## Debugger

- Added memory view. ([#33955](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33955)) 
- Added support for data breakpoints. ([#34391](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34391))
- Added support for shutting down debug sessions while they're booting up. ([#34362](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34362))
- Added support for environment variable files in the Go debugger through the envFile setting. ([#34300](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34300); thanks [Spissable](https://github.com/Spissable))
- Improved the appearance of JavaScript sessions in the debug panel's session list. ([#34322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34322))
- Multi-line debug inline values are now truncated. ([#34305](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34305))
- Made the semantics of the `dap.$ADAPTER.binary` setting more intuitive for the `JavaScript` and `Debugpy` adapters. In the new semantics, this should be the path to `dapDebugServer.js` for `JavaScript` and the path to the `src/debugpy/adapter` directory for `Debugpy`. ([#33926](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33926))

## Git

- Added support for `shift-click`ing to stage a range of entries in the git panel. ([#34296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34296))
- Added support for "Open Pull Request" on more platforms. ([#33833](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33833); thanks [stephenhillier](https://github.com/stephenhillier))
- Improved merge conflict buttons clarity by changing labels to "Use HEAD" and "Use Origin". ([#34297](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34297))

- Fixed an issue where pane activations would sometimes have a brief delay, causing a flicker in the process. ([#33973](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33973); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Fixed an issue where interacting with blocks in the editor would sometimes not properly work with the minimap enabled. ([#33067](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33067))
- Fixed automatic contrast adjustment for Powerline separators. ([#34417](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34417))
- Fixed JS/TS outlines to show generator functions. ([#34388](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34388); thanks [eventualbuddha](https://github.com/eventualbuddha))
- Fixed a bug where the `Close others` context menu action was keeping the active tab open instead of the right-clicked tab. ([#34355](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34355); thanks [vipexv](https://github.com/vipexv))
- Resolved an issue where the ESLint language server returned an empty string for the CodeDescription.href field in diagnostics, leading to missing diagnostics in editor. ([#33814](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33814); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Fixed horizontal scrolling not working for sticky items in the Project Panel. ([#34367](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34367))
- Fixed issue where hovering over the last sticky item in the Project Panel showed a hovered state on the entry behind it. ([#34367](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34367))
- Fixed an issue where scrolling would stutter at the top of multibuffers. ([#34295](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34295))
- Fixed an issue where the scale factor was not detected correctly on X11 systems when `Xft.dpi` is not defined (mostly in cases involving window managers). ([#34265](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34265))
- Fixed autocomplete on settings.json after restarting Zed. ([#34142](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34142))
- Fixed an issue where folding the topmost buffer in a multibuffer would cause the header to jump slightly. ([#34721](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34721))
- Linux: xkb-defined hotkeys for arrow keys should behave as expected. ([#34823](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34823); thanks [stillonearth](https://github.com/stillonearth))
- Fixed an issue where redo would not work after buffer formatting (including formatting on save) when the formatting did not result in any changes. ([#34898](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34898))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Linux: When typing non-ASCII keys, we will now also match keybindings against the QWERTY-equivalent layout. This should allow most of Zed's builtin shortcuts to work out of the box on most keyboard layouts. **Breaking change**: If you had been using `keysym` names in your keyboard shortcut file (`ctrl-cyrillic_yeru`, etc.) you should now use the QWERTY-equivalent characters instead. ([#34053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34053); thanks [stillonearth](https://github.com/stillonearth))

## v0.195.2 — 2025-07-16

This week's release includes xAI language model provider support, sticky scroll in the project panel, better window restoration on app load, improved text drag and drop, UI polish to the Git panel, better navigation to agent edit review buffer, improved terminal rendering performance, dynamic foreground/background contrast in the terminal, and many debugger improvements.

## Features

- Added sticky scroll to the project panel, which keeps parent directories visible while scrolling. To disable it, set `"sticky_scroll": false` in settings. ([#33994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33994))
- Added zed://extension/{id} links to open the extensions UI with a specific extension ([#34492](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34492))
- Added support for loading environment variables from Plan9 `rc` shell. ([#33599](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33599))
- Added `editor::SortLinesByLength` action to sort lines by their length ([#33622](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33622); thanks [alexpovel](https://github.com/alexpovel))
- Implemented signature help for overloaded items and added support for rendering signature help documentation. ([#33199](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33199); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))
- Improved Zed window restoration - now multiple windows will reopen concurrently instead of one after another. ([#33784](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33784))
- Improved Go to Definition / Declaration / Type Definition / Implementation and Find All References to include all results from different language servers ([#29359](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29359); thanks [XiNiHa](https://github.com/XiNiHa))
- Improved drag and drop text editing and added `drag_and_drop_selection.delay_ms` setting ([#33928](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33928); thanks [djsauble](https://github.com/djsauble))
- Improved support for Fish/Nushell for Zed generated tasks and debug sessions ([#33806](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33806))
- Tasks from package.json now include the parent directory as a label to help disambiguate ([#33798](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33798))
- Added warnings for unknown fields when editing `tasks.json` / `snippets.json`. ([#33883](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33883))
- Disabled word-completions by default in Plain Text and Markdown Buffers ([#34065](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34065))
- Polished the git panel spacing, border colors, and icons. ([#34064](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34064))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed YAML indentation for lines containing comments with `:` in them ([#33882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33882))

- Fixed diagnostic popovers not being scrollable ([#33581](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33581); thanks [curiouslad](https://github.com/curiouslad))
- Fixed path parsing paths in the format of the Haskell language server ([#33697](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33697); thanks [Aerma7309](https://github.com/Aerma7309))
- Fixed panic when trying to split on multibyte UTF-8 sequences. ([#33676](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33676))
- Fixed restarting Zed on Nix and other systems which need `/usr/bin/env bash` to find bash ([#33936](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33936); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Fixed a panic that could occur when opening the rules library. ([#34438](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/34438))

## v0.194.3 — 2025-07-09

This week's release includes error reporting on malformed regex patterns in buffer and project searches, better view of multi-line text in search inputs, SVG previews, better `settings.json` diagnostics, agent panel retries on API errors, better debugger breakpoint property management, and more!

Compatibility Note: this week's preview release (v0.195.x) includes a change to the handling of LSP actions when sharing projects via Zed Collaboration. When a host using the new Zed Preview collaborates with a guest using an older Zed release (<= v0.194.x), or vice versa, go to definition will not work on the guest. This can be fixed by running either the new preview or an older release on both host and guest. Go to definition will work again in mixed stable/preview shared projects after next week's releases.

## Features

- Added support for respecting the NO_PROXY environment variable when any HTTP proxy is configured. See [Zed Network Proxy docs](https://zed.dev/docs/configuring-zed#network-proxy) for more. ([#33742](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33742))
- Added SVG file preview, accessible via the quick action bar button or keyboard shortcuts (`ctrl/cmd+k v` and `ctrl/cmd+shift+v`) when editing SVG files. ([#32694](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32694); thanks [ronharel02](https://github.com/ronharel02))
- Added ability to manipulate dock size with new `workspace::{Decrease,Increase,Reset}{Open,Active}DockSize` actions. ([#31366](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31366); thanks [aurexav](https://github.com/aurexav))
- Added warnings for unknown fields when editing `settings.json`. ([#33678](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33678))
- Improved pasted newlines in search: render as "\n" (with an underline), instead of line-wrapping. This should make it much clearer what you're searching for. ([#33504](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33504))
- Improved Prettier config file detection ([#33744](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33744); thanks [IanMitchell](https://github.com/IanMitchell))
- Use git cli to perform checkouts (to avoid a crash seen in libgit2) ([#33499](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33499))
- Show regex parsing errors under the search bar for buffer and project search. ([#33638](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33638); thanks [mikalsande](https://github.com/mikalsande))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed the missing shadow for blurred-background windows on macOS. ([#27403](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27403); thanks [alphaArgon](https://github.com/alphaArgon))
- Fixed an issue where rewrap would not work with selection when two comment blocks are separated with line of code. ([#33566](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33566))
- Fixed an issue where horizontal autoscrolling would stutter and indent guides would drift when scrolling horizontally. ([#33514](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33514); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Fixed git commit message line break getting stripped after committing. ([#33409](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33409); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Fixed long branch names overflowing to multiple lines in git panel branch selector. ([#33529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33529); thanks [ddoemonn](https://github.com/ddoemonn))
- Fixed the removal of leading whitespace in a language server's stderr logs. ([#33418](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33418); thanks [davidbarsky](https://github.com/davidbarsky))
- Fixed an issue with empty code actions menu locking the cursor ([#33386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33386))
- Fixed file finder selecting wrong worktree when creating a file ([#33139](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33139); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- helix: Fixed edge-cases with word motions and newlines ([#33408](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33408); thanks [fantacell](https://github.com/fantacell))
- Improved rewrap to respect changes in indentation or comment prefix (e.g. `//` vs `///`) as boundaries so that it doesn't merge them into one mangled text. ([#33566](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33566))
- Linux: Now skips insertion of characters when modifiers are held. Before, characters were inserted if there's no match in the keymap. ([#33424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33424))
- emacs: Bound `alt-q` to `editor::Rewrap` (like `M-q` or `M-x fill-paragraph`) ([#33588](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33588))
- Fixed a remote server (SSH) crash when editing JSON files ([#33824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33824)).

If you're running into issues with this open an issue [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues) ([#33372](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33372))

## Debugger

- CodeLLDB no longer enables pretty-printers for Rust by default. This fixes pretty-printers for C++. This is a breaking change for user-defined debug scenarios from debug.json; in order to enable Rust pretty printing when using CodeLLDB, add `"sourceLanguages": ["rust"]` to your debug configuration. This change does not affect scenarios automatically inferred by Zed.([#33670](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33670))
- Breakpoint properties (log/hit condition/condition) can now be set directly from breakpoint list. ([#33097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33097))
- Reorganized layout of a debug panel without any sessions for a vertical dock position. ([#33625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33625))
- Moved parent directories of source breakpoints into a tooltip. ([#33625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33625))
- Fixed Zed's debugger issuing threads request before it is allowed to do so per DAP specification. ([#33627](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33627))
- Fixed a bug which caused global debug scenarios (from global .zed/debug.json) to not be picked up. ([#33664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33664))
- Fixed an issue with Debug Adapter log showing sessions from other Zed windows in the dropdown. ([#33656](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33656))
- Fixed invalid json schema for `debug.json`. ([#33875](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33875))
- Restarting a debug session now reruns build tasks that are associated with the session ([#33724](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33724))
- go: debugger now respects the `envFile` setting ([#33666](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33666))
- go: Fixed debugging Go subtests. ([#33694](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33694))
- javascript: Fixed nameless child sessions appearing with the JavaScript adapter. ([#33739](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33739))
- javascript: Added attachSimplePort to JavaScript DAP schema ([#31412](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31412); thanks [sigmaSd](https://github.com/sigmaSd))
- ruby:The ruby debug adapter has been moved to the [ruby extension](https://github.com/zed-extensions/ruby), if you have any saved debug scenarios you'll need to change `"adapter": "Ruby"` to `"adapter": "rdbg"`. ([#33541](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33541))
- rust: Ensure Cargo locator only targets relevant executables. ([#33126](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33126); thanks [CathalMullan](https://github.com/CathalMullan))

## Languages

- python: Support highlighting additional operators ("&=", "<<=", ">>=", "@=", "^=" and "|=") ([#33720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33720))
- python: Improved auto outdent for Python while typing keywords like `except`, `else`, `finally`, etc. ([#33370](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33370))
- markdown: Fixed issue where `(` wouldn’t autocomplete when `.` is preceded by it in Markdown. ([#33705](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33705))
- markdown: Improved rewrap for lists, todos, and block quotes. ([#33702](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33702))
- markdown: Allow multiple Markdown preview tabs ([#32859](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32859); thanks [ddoemonn](https://github.com/ddoemonn))
- markdown: Support PgUp/PgDown in Markdown previews ([#33403](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33403); thanks [djsauble](https://github.com/djsauble))
- heex: Fixed Emmet file expansion for files ending in .html.heex. ([#32208](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32208); thanks [conradwt](https://github.com/conradwt))

## Vim

- vim: Added support for vim-mode in git commit editor ([#33222](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33222); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- vim: Allow `.` repeat in visual mode. ([#33569](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33569))
- vim: Run r! in a non-interactive shell ([#33568](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33568))
- vim: Paragraph objects now support counts: `d2ap`, `v2ap`, etc. ([#33489](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33489); thanks [warp-records](https://github.com/warp-records))
- vim: Motions now push to the jump list using the same logic as vim (i.e. `G`/`g g`/`g d` always do, but `j`/`k` always don't). Most non-vim actions (including clicking with the mouse) continue to push to the jump list only when they move the cursor by 10 or more lines. ([#33495](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33495))
- vim: Fixed an issue when pasting text that was yanked with vim's linewise selections. ([#33555](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33555); thanks [afgomez](https://github.com/afgomez))
- vim: Fixed a crash with ctrl-g ([#33474](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33474))


## v0.193.3 — 2025-07-02

Today's release includes a new Helix mode, improved UX when configuring MCP servers in the agent panel, completion triggers and variable watch support in the debugger, and more.

## Enhancements

- Added `editor::ConvertIndentationToSpaces` and `editor::ConvertIndentationToTabs` actions to change editor indents. ([#32340](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32340); thanks [rodrigoFfreire](https://github.com/rodrigoFfreire))
- Improved minimap width calculation that now scales with the editor width. ([#32317](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32317); thanks [esimkowitz](https://github.com/esimkowitz))
- Added optional `clone: bool` (default: `false`) to `workspace::MoveItemToPane` and `workspace::MoveItemToPaneInDirection` which causes the item to be cloned into the destination pane rather than moved. ([#32895](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32895); thanks [carlsverre](https://github.com/carlsverre))
- Made the horizontal outputs scrollable in REPL. ([#33247](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33247); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet))
- Collaboration: Now fetches and waits for channels when opening channel notes via URL. ([#33291](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33291))
- Prevented diagnostics from showing in diff-related editors. ([#33285](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33285))
- Disabled indent on `tab` in single line editors. ([#33031](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33031); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Disabled button menu hunk if there are no changes. ([#32907](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32907); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))

### AI

- Agent: Added support for Vercel as a language model provider. ([#33292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33292))
- Agent: Added support to delete and configure MCP servers from the panel's settings view. ([#32622](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32622))
- Agent: Added ability to see the source of an MCP server, whether it is from an extension or custom added. ([#32622](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32622))
- Agent: Added a button to scroll to top of the thread. ([#33130](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33130))
- Agent: "New From Summary" now preserves any unsent content in the chat box. ([#33220](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33220))
- Agent: Allowed to force uninstall extension if it provides more than the MCP server. ([#33279](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33279))
- Agent: Added prompt caching support for Bedrock. ([#33194](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33194); thanks [kuzaxak](https://github.com/kuzaxak))
- Agent: Use Anthropic Haiku 3.0 in AWS regions where Haiku 3.5 is unavailable under Bedrock. ([#33214](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33214))
- Agent: Added cross-region usage of Sonnet 4 in EU/APAC AWS regions under Bedrock. ([#33192](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33192); thanks [kuzaxak](https://github.com/kuzaxak))
- Agent: Allowed to enable/disable context servers permanently in the agent configuration view. ([#32994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32994))
- Agent: Added thinking support to OpenRouter provider. ([#32541](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32541); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Improved layout shift when clicking to edit a previously sent message. ([#33055](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33055))
- Redact sensitive environment variables from MCP logs. ([#32985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32985))
- Linux: Added way to minimize, maximize, and close the rules library window. ([#33025](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33025))

### Debugger

- Added support for completion triggers in debug console. ([#33211](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33211); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Added support for variable watchers. ([#32743](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32743); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Swapped step in/out icon positions in debug panel to be consistent with other editors. ([#33330](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33330))
- Generate inline values based on a language's `debugger.scm` file. ([#33081](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33081))
- Shutdown and clean up debug processes when force quitting Zed. ([#33273](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33273))

### Languages

### Git

- Added `collapse_untracked_diff` setting to auto-collapse untracked diffs. ([#32591](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32591); thanks [zeux](https://github.com/zeux))

### Vim

- The `use_multiline_find` setting is replaced by binding to the correct action in the keymap ([#32763](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32763); thanks [fantacell](https://github.com/fantacell)):
    ```
     "f": ["vim::PushFindForward", { "before": false, "multiline": true }],
     "t": ["vim::PushFindForward", { "before": true, "multiline": true }],
     "shift-f": ["vim::PushFindBackward", { "after": false, "multiline": true }],
     "shift-t": ["vim::PushFindBackward", { "after": true, "multiline": true }],
    ```
- Helix: `f`/`t`/`shift-f`/`shift-t`/`h`/`l`/`left`/`right` are now multiline by default (like helix). ([#32763](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32763); thanks [fantacell](https://github.com/fantacell))
- Helix: Added a `helix_mode` setting to enable/disable helix key bindings. Enabling `helix_mode` *also* enables `vim_mode`. ([#31843](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31843); thanks [sethstha](https://github.com/sethstha))
