## v0.192.5 — 2025-06-25

Today's release includes inline color previews, support for Vercel as a language model provider, enterprise support for GitHub Copilot, the latest Gemini 2.5 models, support for streaming for OpenAI's o1 model, initial support for both `z l` and `z h` in vim mode, and more.

## Enhancements

- Added caps lock support and shows a warning if the user is entering an SSH password with Caps Lock enabled. ([#30470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30470); thanks [mzaks](https://github.com/mzaks))
- Added a setting to show the minimap only on the current active editor (file). ([#31390](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31390); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
  - This can be configured in `settings.json`:
  ```json
  { "minimap": { "display_in": "active_editor" } }
  ```
- Added `cmd + shift` to start columnar selection from the mouse position. ([#32779](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32779))
- Added more settings file locations to check for VS Code / Cursor settings import. ([#32721](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32721))
- Added a way to collapse all entries in the Project Panel without having to focus it. This can be done by using the `project panel: collapse all entries` action. ([#32660](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32660))
- Restored `opt + shift` to create columnar selection (or consecutive multi-cursor on click) from the selection head. ([#32779](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32779))
- Started showing inline previews for LSP document colors. ([#32816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32816))
- Improved handling of environment variables. ([#32637](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32637))

### AI

- Agent: Added support for Vercel as a language model provider. ([#33292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33292))
- Agent: Added support for streaming for OpenAI's o1 model. ([#32597](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32597))
- Agent: Added image support to LMStudio provider. ([#32741](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32741); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added support for Gemini thought signatures. ([#32064](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32064))
- Agent: Added a suggestion to turn burn mode on when getting close to the context window limit. ([#32691](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32691))
- Agent: Automatically removes context server settings when uninstalling MCP extension. ([#32560](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32560))
- Agent: Enabled accepting and rejecting individual file changes from message editor. ([#32801](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32801))
- Agent: Clicking on header of an edit file card now takes you to the first modified hunk. ([#32611](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32611))
- Agent: Updated to latest Gemini 2.5 models. ([#32904](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32904))
- Agent: Gemini models now use diff format when making edits. ([#32737](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32737))
- Agent: The panel now scrolls to the bottom after submitting a new message, allowing you to see it more easily. ([#32819](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32819))
- Agent: Improved the agent's ability to use MPC tools that require absolute paths to files and directories in the project. ([#32725](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32725))
- Agent: Improved locating edits. ([#32628](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32628))
- Added enterprise support for GitHub Copilot. ([#32296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32296); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))

### Debugger

- Implemented support for passing custom arguments to a debug adapter binary using the `dap.args` setting. ([#33251](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33251))
- Fixed not being able to use the `dap` setting in `.zed/settings.json`. ([#33251](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/33251))

### Git

### Languages

- Debugger: Fixed wrong arguments being passed to the DAP when debugging scripts from package.json. ([#32995](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32995))

## v0.191.5 — 2025-06-18

- Fixed a bug where `zed --diff A B` wouldn't open a diff. ([#32962](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32962))
- Debugger: Added the onboarding modal. ([#32961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32961))
- Debugger: New session modal for a debugger will now show tasks from package.json as debuggable scenarios. ([#32958](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32958))
- Debugger: Fixed setting breakpoints in TypeScript code when debugging compiled JavaScript. ([#32954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32954))
- Debugger: Fixed a potential crash when opening active modules in a debugger session (with Copilot enabled). ([#32698](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32698))


## v0.191.4 — 2025-06-18

Today's release includes a native debugger, ability to diff between two files via `zed --diff A B`, ability to reorder collaboration channels, per-thread agent profiles, image/thinking support for more models in the agent panel, drag and drop text selections, and a **ton** of bug fixes.

## Enhancements

- Added channel reordering for administrators (use `cmd-up` and `cmd-down` on macOS or `ctrl-up` and `ctrl-down` on Linux to move channels up or down within their parent). ([#31833](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31833))
- Added support to configure the minimum line number width in gutter. ([#31959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31959); thanks [maxmynter](https://github.com/maxmynter))
- Added a `pane: unpin all tabs` action. ([#32423](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32423))
- Added trailing whitespace rendering. ([#32329](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32329); thanks [JonasKaplan](https://github.com/JonasKaplan))
- Added support to hide the root entry of the Project Panel when there's only one folder in the project. This can be enabled by setting `hide_root` to `true` in the `project_panel` config. ([#25289](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25289); thanks [Angelk90](https://github.com/Angelk90))
- Added support for drag and drop text selection. It can be disabled by setting `drag_and_drop_selection` to `false`. ([#30671](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30671); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- Added dynamic tab titles for unsaved files based on buffer content. ([#32353](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32353))
- Added the `multi_cursor_modifier` setting to be respected when making columnar selections using the mouse drag. ([#32273](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32273))
- Added new `resize_all_panels_in_dock` setting to optionally resize every panel in a dock together. ([#30551](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30551); thanks [Aaron-212](https://github.com/Aaron-212))
- Added support for `Ctrl-w ]` and `Ctrl-w Ctrl-]` to go to a definition in a new split. ([#31990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31990); thanks [afgomez](https://github.com/afgomez))
- Allowed to reuse windows in open remote projects dialogue. ([#32138](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32138))
- Allowed running certain Zed actions when headless. ([#32095](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32095))
- Improved `AddSelectionAbove` and `AddSelectionBelow` to extend multiple cursors/selections. ([#32204](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32204))
- Improved the behavior of `editor::Rewrap` to not join paragraphs together. ([#32046](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32046))
- Improved `alt-left` and `alt-right` by skipping punctuation on macOS to respect the Mac default behaviour. ([#31977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31977); thanks [remorses](https://github.com/remorses))
- Whitespace added by inlay hints is no longer shown when `"show_whitespaces": "all"` is used. ([#32088](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32088))
- Preserve pinned tab state when dragging to position 0 in new pane with no pinned tabs. ([#32213](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32213))

### Debugger

We are happy to announce that native debugging in Zed is now available to all! 🎉

### AI

- Agent: Improved the review experience in the agent panel. Now, when you commit changes (generated by the AI agent) using Git, Zed will automatically dismiss the agent's review UI for those changes. This means you won't have to manually "keep" or approve changes twice—just commit, and you're done. ([#32093](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32093))
- Agent: Added image support to OpenRouter models. ([#32012](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32012); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added image support to Mistral models. ([#32154](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32154); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added thinking support to LM Studio provider. ([#32337](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32337); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Added thinking support to DeepSeek provider. ([#32338](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32338); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Improved handling of large terminal output. ([#32416](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32416))
- Agent: Enabled cross-region inference for Claude 4 family models on Amazon Bedrock provider. ([#32235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32235); thanks [unexge](https://github.com/unexge))
- Agent: Enabled Vim window commands (ctrl-w X) when agent panel is focused. ([#31000](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31000); thanks [pavles6](https://github.com/pavles6))
- Agent: Allowed saving the profile per thread. ([#31907](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31907))
- Agent: Added the latest versions of Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash Preview. ([#32183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32183))
- Agent: Added support for attaching images as context from clipboard in the inline assistant. ([#32087](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32087))
- Agent: Updated to latest Gemini 2.5 models. ([#32904](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32904))
- Agent: Show warning on context pill when selected model doesn't support adding images as context. ([#31848](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31848); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Prevent models from hallucinating tool parameters. ([#32081](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32081))
- Linux (X11): Restored the ability to paste images as context in agent threads. ([#32121](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32121))
- Added support for manually providing an OAuth token for GitHub Copilot Chat by assigning the GH_COPILOT_TOKEN environment variable. ([#31392](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31392); thanks [clauses3](https://github.com/clauses3))
- Copilot Chat endpoint URLs can now be configured via `settings.json` or Configuration View. ([#32248](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32248))

### Git

- Added `zed --diff A B` to show the diff between the two files. ([#32922](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32922))

- Added the `git::FetchFrom` action to fetch from a single remote. ([#26897](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26897); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))

- Provided feedback on commit message generation error. ([#29005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29005); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))

### Languages

- Added support for the LSP `textDocument/diagnostic` command. ([#19230](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19230); thanks [vitallium](https://github.com/vitallium))
- Added initial `package.json` scripts task autodetection. ([#32497](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32497))
- Improved detection of runnable TypeScript/JavaScript test cases when they contain identifier. ([#32467](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32467); thanks [lsndr](https://github.com/lsndr))
- Allowed running dynamic TypeScript/JavaScript tests. ([#31499](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31499); thanks [lsndr](https://github.com/lsndr))
- Added scope for JSDoc. ([#29476](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29476); thanks [chbk](https://github.com/chbk))

### Vim

- Improved vim's search to respect the `search.case_sensitive` setting when searching. ([#32276](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32276); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))
- Multi-key bindings in insert mode will now show the pending keystroke in the buffer. For example if you have `jk` mapped to escape, pressing `j` will immediately show a `j`. ([#32007](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32007))

- Fixed proxy URL resolution when using custom DNS entries. ([#32679](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32679))
- Fixed a panic when merging pull and (newer) push diagnostics. ([#32826](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32826))

- PHP: Fixed an issue in PHP where PHP language settings would be occasionally overridden by HTML language settings. ([#32145](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32145))
- Fixed a rare crash on macOS when putting the app in the background. ([#32116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32116))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- SQL: Disabled `format_on_save` using `prettier-plugin-sql` by default. Please see the [Zed SQL Language Docs](https://zed.dev/docs/languages/sql) for settings to use `sql-formatter` directly instead.


## v0.190.6 — 2025-06-13

- Automatic population of `Co-authored-by` now uses `git config --global user.email`. ([#32639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32639))

## v0.190.5 — 2025-06-12

- Fixed language tasks fetched incorrectly for certain selections. ([#32580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32580))

## v0.190.4 — 2025-06-11

Today's release includes Vim mode support in the agent panel, as well as many other agent additions, automatic Python virtual environment configuration, better project panel dragging, a Cursor keymap, more Vim commands, and many bug fixes from [Quality Week](https://zed.dev/faq#quality-week).

## Enhancements

- Added highlighting to entries being dragged in the Project Panel, indicating which items are being moved. ([#32044](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32044))
- Added copy-drag cursor when pressing `alt` or `shift` to copy the file in Project Panel. ([#32040](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32040))
- Added option to create new file in project search panel. ([#31567](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31567); thanks [xyzqm](https://github.com/xyzqm))
- Added `close_on_file_delete` setting (off by default) to allow closing open files after they have been deleted on disk. ([#31920](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31920))
- Added subword navigation and selection to Sublime keymap. ([#30268](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30268); thanks [fernandocarletti](https://github.com/fernandocarletti))
- Added MacOS titlebar double-click action. ([#30468](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30468); thanks [chungweileong94](https://github.com/chungweileong94))
- Added `View Release Notes` to `Help` menu. ([#31704](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31704); thanks [simonpham](https://github.com/simonpham))
- Added Cursor compatibility keymap. ([#31702](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31702))
- Added `ZED_RELATIVE_DIR` (path to current file's directory relative to worktree root) task variable. ([#31657](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31657); thanks [d5ng4i](https://github.com/d5ng4i))
- Added version information, in a tooltip, when hovering on the activity indicator for both the download and install status. ([#31568](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31568))
- Added initial support for ssh remotes running FreeBSD x86_64. ([#29561](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29561))
- Snippet insertions now preserve leading whitespace instead of using language-specific auto-indentation. ([#31933](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31933))
- Improved project panel to show a highlight on the containing folder which would be the target of the drop operation. ([#31976](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31976))
- Improved Zed inheriting environment variables from user shells. ([#31799](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31799); thanks [haruleekim](https://github.com/haruleekim))
- Improved Zed prompts for file path selection. ([#32014](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32014))
- Improved displaying of project search matches or diagnostics when the excerpts are adjacent. ([#31708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31708); thanks [Rogue-striker](https://github.com/Rogue-striker))
- Improved the keyboard navigability of the file finder filtering options. ([#31777](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31777))
- Improved persistence when selecting themes and icon themes. ([#29560](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29560); thanks [hoodie](https://github.com/hoodie))
- Ensured that cut project panel entries are cut-pasted only on the first use, and copy-pasted on all subsequent pastes. ([#31931](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31931); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Allowed opening 1 more item if `n` tabs are pinned, where `n` equals the `max_tabs` count. ([#31871](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31871))
- Preserve pinned tab state when dragging to position 0 in new pane with no pinned tabs. ([#32213](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32213))
- Disabled the `Close Clean` tab context menu action when all items are "dirty." ([#31859](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31859))
- Changed the highlighting of the current file to represent the current saved state, when the tab bar is turned off. ([#30507](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30507); thanks [ViveK-PothinA](https://github.com/ViveK-PothinA))

### Git

- Extended the support for configuring custom git hosting providers to cover project settings in addition to global settings. ([#31929](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31929))

### Languages

- Added support for filtering language server completions instead of re-querying. ([#31872](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31872))
- Python toolchain selector now uses path to the closest pyproject.toml as a basis for picking a toolchain. All files under the same pyproject.toml (in filesystem hierarchy) will share a single virtual environment. It is possible to have multiple Python virtual environments selected for disjoint parts of the same project. ([#31893](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31893))
- Added more docstring highlights for Python. ([#31628](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31628); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))

- Improved TypeScript shebang detection. ([#31437](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31437); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Ruby: Added `sorbet` and `steep` to the list of available language servers. ([#32008](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32008))
- LaTeX: Added default `latexindent` formatter settings without relying on `texlab`, as well as allowing `prettier` to be chosen for formatting. ([#28727](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28727); thanks [lnay](https://github.com/lnay))

## Bug Fixes

- Agent: Fixed incorrect file edits when edit locations are ambiguous. ([#32056](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32056))
- Agent: Fixed inability to use Claude 4 Thinking models with Bedrock. ([#31599](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31599); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))
- Agent: Fixed a panic that could sometimes occur when the agent panel was too narrow and contained context included via `@`. ([#31960](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31960))
- Agent: Fixed a panic when re-editing old messages. ([#32017](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32017))
- Agent: Fixed bug with double-counting tokens in Gemini. ([#31885](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31885))
- Agent: Fixed an issue where copying and pasting an assistant response in text threads would result in duplicate text. ([#31882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31882))
- Agent: Fixed GitHub Copilot chat provider error when sending follow-up messages in threads containing images. ([#31760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31760); thanks [spmurrayzzz](https://github.com/spmurrayzzz))
- Agent: Fixed a bug where the panel navigation menu wouldn't open with the keybinding on text threads. ([#31709](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31709))
- Agent: Fixed a bug where the "go back" button wouldn't go back to the Text Thread after visiting another view from it. ([#31706](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31706))
- Agent: Fixed an issue where rejecting agent changes could result in data loss in agent-created files. ([#31617](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31617))
- AWS Bedrock: Fixed cross-region inference for all regions. ([#30659](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30659); thanks [5herlocked](https://github.com/5herlocked))
- Vim: Fixed duplicate prefixes when repeating completions via `.` ([#31818](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31818); thanks [zeux](https://github.com/zeux))
- Vim: Fixed pasting in vim's visual line mode when cursor is on a newline character. ([#30791](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30791); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))
- Git: Fixed an issue that prevented `git::Restore` keybindings from working in editors for buffers that had previously been modified by the agent. ([#31930](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31930))
- Fixed certain external worktrees' files sometimes not registered with language servers. ([#32057](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32057))
- Fixed completions menu closing on typing after being requested while `show_completions_on_input: false`. ([#32015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32015))
- Fixed Python virtual environment detection when no `pyrightconfig.json` is present. ([#31934](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31934); thanks [pachecoio](https://github.com/pachecoio))
- Pyright now correctly resolves imports from packages installed in virtual environments (`.venv`, `venv`, etc.). ([#31934](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31934); thanks [pachecoio](https://github.com/pachecoio))
- Python projects with virtual environments no longer show false `reportMissingImports` errors. ([#31934](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31934); thanks [pachecoio](https://github.com/pachecoio))
- Fixed Python tasks always running with a toolchain selected for the root of a workspace. ([#31150](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31150); thanks [pachecoio](https://github.com/pachecoio))
- Fixed channel notes not re-connecting when a connection to Zed servers is restored. ([#31950](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31950))
- Fixed wrong line number being shown in the status bar when in multi-buffer. ([#31947](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31947))
- Fixed terminal pinned tab state not persisting across restarts. ([#31921](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31921))
- Fixed unnecessary delay when typing a multi-stroke binding that doesn't match any non-null bindings. ([#30260](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30260); thanks [joe-p](https://github.com/joe-p))
- Fixed an edge case where indent guides would be rendered incorrectly if lines consisted of entirely whitespace. ([#31916](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31916))
- Fixed the issue where keybinding wouldn't work in a pane after focusing it from dock using the `ActivatePaneInDirection` action in certain cases. ([#31905](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31905))
- Fixed terminal inline assistant clipping when cursor is at bottom of terminal. ([#31807](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31807); thanks [alisinabh](https://github.com/alisinabh))
- Fixed the issue where the columnar selection (`opt+shift`) incorrectly used the cursor to start the selection instead of the mouse position. ([#31888](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31888))
- Fixed an issue where autocompleting optional chaining methods in TypeScript, such as `x.tostr`, would result in `x?.toString()tostr` instead of `x?.toString()`. ([#31878](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31878))
- Fixed a bug where pinned tabs were closed when running `Close Others` from the tab context menu. ([#31783](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31783))
- Fixed a bug where pinned tabs would eventually be closed out when exceeding the `max_tabs` count. ([#31871](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31871))
- Fixed a bug where pinning a tab, when already at the `max_tabs` limit, could cause other tabs to be incorrectly closed. ([#31871](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31871))
- Fixed a bug where inactive tabs would be activated when pinning or unpinning. ([#32026](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32026))
- Fixed a bug where if the last tab was a pinned tab and it was dragged to the right, resulting in a no-op, it would become unpinned. ([#32228](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32228))
- Fixed a bug where a pinned tab dragged just to the right of the end of the pinned tab region would become unpinned. ([#32228](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32228))
- Fixed a bug where dragging a pinned tab from one pane to another pane's pinned region could result in an existing pinned tab becoming unpinned when `max_tabs` was reached. ([#32228](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32228))
- Fixed a bug where moving an unpinned tab to the left, just to the end of the pinned region, would cause the pinned tabs to become unpinned. ([#32228](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32228))
- Fixed a bug where dragging a pinned tab into a new split would lose its pinned tab state. ([#32184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32184))
- Fixed a bug where pinned tabs in one pane could be lost when moving one of the pinned tabs to another pane. ([#32184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32184))
- Fixed a bug where ERB files were not parsed correctly when the languages were initially loaded. ([#32278](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32278))
- Fixed a bug where buffers render on every mouse move. ([#32412](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32412))
- Fixed regression in startup performance by not deserializing and instantiating recently opened agent threads. ([#32351](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32351))
- Fixed incorrect offsets during outline panel navigation in singleton buffers. ([#32321](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32321))
- Fixed sluggish cursor motions in Terminal when Vi Mode is enabled. ([#31824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31824); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Fixed issue where some applications won't receive the clipboard contents from Zed. ([#30251](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30251); thanks [aldofunes](https://github.com/aldofunes))
- Fixed in-app release notes having an incorrect title. ([#31703](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31703); thanks [simonpham](https://github.com/simonpham))
- Fixed an issue where migration banner wouldn't go away after clicking "Backup and Migrate". ([#31723](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31723))
- Fixed issue where task history wasn't being cleared after task file updates. ([#31720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31720))
- Fixed issue navigating SSH config servers in Remote Projects with keyboard. ([#31650](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31650))
- Fixed issue preventing remote projects modal from regaining focus after a successful SSH server connection. ([#31651](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31651))
- Fixed the issue where the terminal focused when the mouse hovered over it after selecting text in the editor. ([#31639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31639))
- Fixed a crash that could occur when editing YAML files. ([#32090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32090))
- Fixed a crash that could occur when editing bash files. ([#32091](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32091))
- Fixed a crash when editing large bash scripts. ([#32091](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32091))
- Fixed a crash when editing YAML files. ([#32090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32090))
- Fixed a few rare panics that could happen when a multibuffer excerpt started with expanded deleted content. ([#32189](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32189))
- Fixed a panic that could occur when editing files containing merge conflicts. ([#32123](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32123))
- Fixed a panic that could sometimes occur when the agent performed edits. ([#32245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/32245))

## v0.189.5 — 2025-06-04

Today's release includes numerous agent improvements with better responsiveness and reliability, a Cursor settings importer, initial support for a new element inspector to aid development, and a lot more!

## Enhancements

- Added an element inspector for development. On debug builds, `dev::ToggleInspector` will open a pane allowing inspecting of element info and modifying styles. ([#31443](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31443))
- Added support for importing settings from Cursor. Cursor settings can be imported using the `zed: import cursor settings` command from the command palette. ([#31424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31424))
- Added hover state to scrollbars outside of the editor. ([#25525](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25525); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Added code action indicator which shows up inline at the start of the row. This can be disabled by setting `inline_code_actions` to `false`. ([#31432](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31432))
- Added faster scrolling in the editor while holding `opt`/`alt`. ([#31056](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31056); thanks [alii](https://github.com/alii))
- Added `minimap.thumb.background` colors and `minimap.thumb.border` to themes to customize the thumb colors and border of the minimap. ([#30785](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30785); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Added language icons and file names to snippet scope selector. ([#30212](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30212); thanks [loczek](https://github.com/loczek))
- Added a way to split and clone tab with alt (macOS) / ctrl-mouse drop. ([#29921](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29921); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- Added a way to prefer LSP tasks over Zed tasks. ([#31551](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31551))
- Improved TypeScript task detection. ([#31711](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31711))
- Surfaced the version that will be installed, in a tooltip, when hovering on the `Click to restart and update Zed` status. ([#31179](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31179))
- Improved file finder to include indexed gitignored files in its search results. ([#31542](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31542))
- Improved file icon associations to support more shell configuration files. ([#31110](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31110); thanks [lukejans](https://github.com/lukejans))
- Improved the auto-updater to continue checking for updates even after finding and installing an initial update, reducing the chances of a double update. ([#30969](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30969))
- Improved keybinds displayed for actions in macOS application menus. ([#28440](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28440); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Improved `AddSelectionBelow` and `AddSelectionAbove` to no longer skip shorter lines when the selection is empty, aligning with VSCode and Sublime behavior. ([#31100](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31100))
- Made `workspace::MoveItemToPaneInDirection` and `workspace::MoveItemToPane` create non-existing panes. ([#31449](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31449))
- Parse `./`/`a/`/`b/`-prefixed paths more leniently in the file finder. ([#31459](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31459))

### AI

- Added the ability to use max mode on text threads. ([#31361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31361); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))
- Updated the Zed provider to fetch the list of available language models from the server. ([#31316](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31316))
- Agent: Added a notice that editing a message in the agent panel will restart the thread from that point. ([#31508](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31508))
- Agent: Added the ability to have a sound notification when the agent is done generating and/or needs user input. ([#31472](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31472))
- Agent: Added a space after @-mentioning something in the message editor to allow for continuous typing. ([#30381](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30381); thanks [pleibers](https://github.com/pleibers))
- Agent: Added support for tool calls to LM Studio provider. ([#30589](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30589); thanks [gyzerok](https://github.com/gyzerok))
- Agent: Added an `agent: chat with follow` action via `cmd-enter` on macOS and `ctrl-enter` on Linux. ([#31401](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31401))
- Agent: Added an option in the settings file to choose either the `agent` panel or the `thread` panel as the default assistant panel when you first open it. ([#31353](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31353); thanks [AlvaroParker](https://github.com/AlvaroParker))

```json5
{
  "agent": {
    "default_view": "text_thread", // default is `thread`
    }
}
```
- Agent: Improved responsiveness of mouse interactions with the agent panel. ([#31585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31585))
- Agent: Improved latency when the agent starts streaming edits. ([#31582](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31582))
- Agent: Improved consecutive tool call UX by allowing users to quickly continue an interrupted thread with one click. ([#31470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31470))
- Agent: Improved reliability of the agent when a model outputs malformed edits. ([#31453](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31453))
- Agent: Improved agent latency on repositories containing many files or large files. ([#31352](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31352))
- Agent: `Restore Checkpoint` now appears if you press `Cancel` during generation. ([#31310](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31310))
- Agent: Agents now automatically format after edits if `format_on_save` is enabled. ([#31047](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31047))

### Git

- Git: Default to fast model first if not configured for generating commit messages. ([#31385](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31385); thanks [abdelq](https://github.com/abdelq))
- Updated the branch picker to convert spaces to hyphens when creating new branch names. ([#27873](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27873); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian))

### Languages

- Added support for "compound" file extensions in language extensions, such as `blade.php` and `component.html`. ([#29716](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29716); thanks [claytonrcarter](https://github.com/claytonrcarter))
- Added support for configuring all ESLint server settings instead of only a limited set of predefined options. ([#31302](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31302))
- List of runnable markdown cells is now based on detected jupyter kernels instead of hardcoded to Python and TypeScript. ([#29664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29664); thanks [JonGretar](https://github.com/JonGretar))

## v0.188.3 — 2025-05-28

Today's release includes importing of SSH host names from the SSH config, improvements for multiple languages, as well as improvements to the agent panel.

## Enhancements

- Added icons to the file finder. ([#30893](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30893); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Added `excluded_files` to `pane::DeploySearch`. ([#30699](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30699); thanks [theherk](https://github.com/theherk))
- Added Emacs keymap bindings for Ctrl/Alt-V in selection mode to extend the selection one page up/down. ([#30858](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30858); thanks [akaihola](https://github.com/akaihola))
- Added a way to import SSH host names from the SSH config. ([#30926](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30926))
- Added `from_existing_connection` flag to `OpenRemote` action to directly open path picker for current connection, bypassing the Remote Projects modal. ([#30954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30954))
- Added dedicated keybind for "Find in Folder..." from the project panel (`cmd-alt-shift-f`, `ctrl-alt-shift-f`). ([#29681](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29681))
- Added code action indicator which shows up inline at the start of the row. This can be disabled by setting `inline_code_actions` to `false`. ([#31432](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31432))
- Terminal: Implemented basic support for Japanese Input Method Editors (IMEs) on macOS. Users can now see pre-edit (marked) text as they type Japanese and confirm their input with the Enter key directly in the terminal. This provides a more natural and efficient experience for Japanese language input. ([#29879](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29879); thanks [gentamura](https://github.com/gentamura))
- Improved project search performance. ([#30842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30842); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Improved the default terminal keybind to not conflict on Czech keyboards. ([#30827](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30827); thanks [halvko](https://github.com/halvko))

### AI

- Agent: Added tool call support for existing mistral models. ([#29994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29994); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Made the previous message editing UX more consistent with the main message editor. ([#30825](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30825))
- Agent: Improved UX by scrolling to the bottom of the thread after submitting a new message or editing a previous one. ([#30878](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30878))
- Agent: Improved UX for dismissing an edit to a previous message. ([#30822](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30822))
- Agent: Improved responsiveness of mouse interactions with the agent panel. ([#31585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31585))

### Git

- Changed the project diff to autosave the targeted buffer after resolving a merge conflict. ([#30762](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30762))

### Languages

- Python: Fixed syntax highlighting for `isinstance()` and `issubclass()` calls. ([#30807](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30807); thanks [csernazs](https://github.com/csernazs))
- Improved auto-indentation when using round brackets in Python. ([#31260](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31260))
- Rust: Run ignored test if user wants to run one specific test. ([#30830](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30830); thanks [Khayet](https://github.com/Khayet))
- Added automatic asterisk insertion for new lines in multiline comments for Go, Rust, C, C++, and JSDoc. This can be disabled by setting `extend_comment_on_newline` to `false`. ([#30808](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30808), [#30768](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30768))
- Improved JSDoc auto-commenting on newline which now correctly indents as per convention. ([#30800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30800))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where hover popovers or signature popovers would overlap with existing opened completion or code actions context menus. ([#31090](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31090))
- Fixed `Replace Next Match` command. Previously it worked once, then Zed incorrectly switched the focus to the editor. ([#30890](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30890); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Fixed SOCKS proxy incorrectly always using remote DNS resolution. ([#30619](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30619); thanks [xJonathanLEI](https://github.com/xJonathanLEI))
- Fixed a bug that prevented the `editor: copy permalink to line` action from working on systems with older versions of git. ([#31053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31053))
- Fixed issue where info and diagnostic hover popovers were still visible when code action menu is triggered. ([#31042](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31042))
- Fixed a regression in Sublime Text keymap for find next/previous in the search bar. ([#31029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31029))
- Fixed images not opening on drag and drop into the editor. ([#31009](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31009))
- Fixed `ctrl-delete` in terminal, now it deletes a word forward. ([#30720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30720); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron))
- Fixed issue where setting `buffer_line_height.custom` to 0 would cause text to disappear. ([#30832](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30832); thanks [kmpeeduwee](https://github.com/kmpeeduwee))
- Fixed issue where "Open local folder" was not opening folder picker when connected to a remote host. ([#30954](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30954))
- Fixed issue where comments weren't extending when adding new line immediately after comment prefix (`//`). ([#30824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30824))
- Fixed an issue with the assistant settings where `amazon-bedrock` was incorrectly called `bedrock` in the settings schema. ([#30805](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30805))
- Fixed an issue with askpass on Linux after an auto-update is installed but not yet applied. ([#30774](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30774))
- Fixed external files spawning extra language servers. ([#30707](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30707))
- Fixed `ctrl-delete` in terminal, now it deletes a word forward. ([#30720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30720))
- Fixed a regression in Sublime Text keymap for find next/previous in the search bar. ([#31029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31029))
- Fixed a bug that prevented the `copy permalink to line` action from working on systems with older versions of git. ([#31053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31053))
- Fixed the issue where adding a newline after the `///` comment would extend it with `//` instead of `///` in Rust and other similar languages. ([#31129](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31129))
- Fixed the issue where in some cases the block comment continues to the next line even though the comment block is already closed. ([#31204](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31204))
- Fixed issue where pressing `Enter` on a line starting with `*` incorrectly added comment delimiter. ([#31271](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31271))
- Agent: Fixed the background color of the agent panel changing if you zoomed it in. ([#30804](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30804))
- Git: Fixed local git branches being excluded from the branch selector when they were set as the upstream of another local branch. ([#30557](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30557))

## v0.187.4 — 2025-05-21

Today's release includes a minimap, image support in hover documentation, and many improvements to the agent panel.

## Enhancements

- Added minimap for high-level overview and quick navigation of editor contents. ([#26893](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26893); thanks [esimkowitz](https://github.com/esimkowitz))
  - To enable, use `"minimap": {"show": "always"}`. See the PR for configuration options.
- Added support for rendering images with data URLs in markdown. This can show up in hover documentation provided by language servers. ([#30322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30322))
- Added `hover_popover_delay` to settings, which determines time to wait in milliseconds before showing the informational hover box. ([#30620](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30620))
- Added more settings to hide buttons from Zed UI. ([#30565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30565))
  - `"search": {"button": false}`
  - `"diagnostics": {"button": false}`
  - `"title_bar": {"show_project_items": false}`
  - `"title_bar": {"show_branch_name": false}`
- Added a new `included_files` field to the `DeploySearch` action to automatically pre-fill which files to include in the search. This lets you use a keybinding to search in a particular folder or for a certain set of files. ([#30327](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30327); thanks [trishume](https://github.com/trishume))
- Added new `workspace: close active dock` action to close the currently focused dock. ([#30369](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30369))
- Added `terminal::RerunTask` task action. ([#30288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30288))
- Added `OpenDocs` action to open Zed's docs in a browser, aliased to `:h[elp]` in Vim. ([#30179](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30179))
- Added the `scrollbar.thumb.active_background` color to themes. Theme authors can use this property in combination with `scrollbar.thumb.hover_background` to customize the color of the editor scrollbar thumbs while these are hovered or being dragged. ([#30177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30177); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Added ability to use `ESC` to cancel dragging in Zed. ([#30318](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30318))
- Added ability to temporarily toggle diagnostics in the editor and set the maximum allowed diagnostics level in its settings. ([#30316](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30316))
- Enabled scrollbar marker rendering for small files. ([#30189](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30189); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Linux: Added initial support for `font_features`. ([#27808](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27808); thanks [peppidesu](https://github.com/peppidesu))
- Improved project panel, outline panel, and collab panel to persist width on a per-workspace basis. New windows will use the width specified in the `default_width` setting. ([#30652](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30652))
- Improved checking of Zed settings so that unrecognized keys show warnings while editing them. ([#30583](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30583))
- Improved snippet code completion to show key in completion menu and description in aside. ([#30603](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30603))
- Improved background coloring for search inputs located in the toolbar. ([#30355](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30355); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Improved the default terminal keybind to not conflict on Czech keyboards. ([#30827](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30827))

### Languages

- Added highlighting for TypeScript and JavaScript shebang lines. ([#30531](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30531); thanks [d1y](https://github.com/d1y))

### Vim

- Added support for `:w[rite] <filename>`. ([#29256](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29256); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))

### AI

- Added tool result image support to Gemini models. ([#30647](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30647))
- Added input image support for OpenAI models. ([#30639](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30639))
- Agent: Allowed copying entire line when selection is empty in text threads. ([#30612](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30612))
- Agent: Improved clarity of MCP server connection status in the Settings view. ([#30573](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30573))
- Agent: Improved inline assistant behavior to focus existing assistants when cursor is placed on their line, matching selection behavior. ([#29998](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29998); thanks [imumesh18](https://github.com/imumesh18))
- Agent: Fixed Amazon Bedrock settings link buttons not working. ([#30541](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30541))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue where signature popover displayed at incorrect width instead of adapting to its content. ([#30646](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30646); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet))
- Fixed project search focus not toggling between query and results on ESC. ([#30613](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30613))
- Fixed document highlight behavior so it no longer appears when selecting multiple words or lines, making text selection and selection highlights clearer. ([#30602](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30602))
- Fixed issue where code completion menu would flicker while typing. ([#30598](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30598))
- Fixed a bug where Python path could be corrupted. ([#30585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30585))
- Fixed an issue where the `o1` model would not work when using Copilot Chat. ([#30581](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30581))
- Fixed indentation guides extending beyond the final scope in a file. ([#29482](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29482); thanks [ronharel02](https://github.com/ronharel02))
- Fixed scrollbars sometimes not scrolling all the way to the bottom. ([#27402](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27402); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Ensured that the vertical editor scrollbar no longer overlaps with buffer headers. ([#30477](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30477); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Fixed deprecation warning text being covered by right dock. ([#30456](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30456); thanks [kmpeeduwee](https://github.com/kmpeeduwee))
- Fixed an issue where accepting a method as an object string in JavaScript would incorrectly expand. E.g., `MyClass["sayHello(name)"]` instead of `MyClass["sayHello"]`. ([#30351](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30351))
- Fixed TypeScript auto-import behavior where functions with generic type arguments (like `useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)`) would incorrectly insert snippet placeholders, breaking the syntax. ([#30312](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30312))
- Fixed the project search considering included and excluded filters after toggling them off. ([#30162](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30162); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Fixed JSX component names with periods (e.g., `<Animated.View>`) now maintain linked edits between opening and closing tags. ([#30167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30167))
- Fixed indentation-related issues involving tab, newline, etc. for Python. ([#29625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29625))
- Fixed panel button tooltip overlapping with the panel button's right-click menu. ([#30108](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30108), [#29473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29473); thanks [ronharel02](https://github.com/ronharel02))
- Fixed an issue where entering a new search in project search would drop unsaved edits in the project search buffer. ([#30865](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30865))
- Fixed `ctrl-delete` in terminal; now it deletes a word forward. ([#30720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30720))
- Fixed a regression in Sublime Text keymap for find next/previous in the search bar. ([#31029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31029))
- Fixed a bug that prevented the `copy permalink to line` action from working on systems with older versions of Git. ([#31053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/31053))
- Linux: Fixed text rendering issues. ([#30552](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30552); thanks [143mailliw](https://github.com/143mailliw))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Removed the code actions indicator from the gutter. It is still available from the right-click menu, or with the keyboard shortcut. ([#30140](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30140))
- The actions used while developing Zed have been renamed from `debug:` to `dev:` to avoid confusion with the new debugger feature ([#30675](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30675)):
  - `dev::OpenDebugAdapterLogs`
  - `dev::OpenSyntaxTreeView`
  - `dev::OpenThemePreview`
  - `dev::OpenLanguageServerLogs`
  - `dev::OpenKeyContextView`

## v0.185.10 — 2025-05-07

Today's release introduces the [Agent Panel](https://zed.dev/blog/fastest-ai-code-editor) for AI-powered editing.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that would cause the message composer in the agent panel to not render when the context strip was empty. ([#30085](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30085))
- Prevented `agent: open active thread as markdown` from panicking when used in a non-local project. ([#30062](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30062))



## v0.185.9 — 2025-05-07

Today's release introduces the [Agent Panel](https://zed.dev/blog/fastest-ai-code-editor) for AI-powered editing, initial support for resolving merge conflicts, a VS Code settings importer, and improvements to diagnostics reporting.

## Enhancements

- Added a VSCode settings importer, available via a `zed::ImportVsCodeSettings` action. ([#29018](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29018))
- Diagnostics: Rust diagnostics now show code snippets in monospace font. ([#29629](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29629))
- Diagnostics: Improved diagnostics by no longer merging when they're on the same line. ([#29629](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29629))
- Diagnostics: Show the diagnostic code if available. ([#29296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29296))
- Added `tab_switcher::ToggleAll` to search open tabs from all panes and focus the selected one. ([#28047](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28047))
- Allowed creating entries when nothing is selected in the project panel. ([#29336](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29336))
- Added support for socks4a proxies. ([#27773](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27773); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Improved default Helix keybindings. ([#29518](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29518); thanks [jneem](https://github.com/jneem))
- Improved code completion sort order, handling more cases with Rust and Python. ([#29990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29990))
- Linux: Added support for `F10` toggling of menus. ([#29607](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29607))
- Linux (X11): Added support for pasting images from clipboard. ([#29387](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29387))

### Git

- Implemented initial support for resolving merge conflicts. ([#28065](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28065))
- Added a `git_panel.sort_by_path` setting to mix untracked/tracked files in the diff list. ([#28791](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28791))
- Git blame links now prefer the `upstream` remote over `origin` if it exists. ([#29382](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29382))
- Git inline blame popover now dismisses when the cursor is moved, the editor is scrolled, or the command palette is opened. ([#29320](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29320))
- Removed the "•" placeholder for "Tracked". The commit button says "Commit Tracked" still by default, and this was misinterpreted to mean "partially staged". Hovering over the button will show you which files are tracked (in addition to the yellow square-with-a-dot-in-it). ([#28791](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28791))
- Increased the default value of `expand_excerpt_lines` from 3 to 5. This makes it faster to see more context in the git diff view. ([#28791](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28791))

### Languages

- Python: Improved builtin type highlighting. ([#29475](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29475); thanks [chbk](https://github.com/chbk))

### Vim

- Added AnyQuotes, AnyBrackets, MiniQuotes, and MiniBrackets text objects. ([#26748](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26748); thanks [oca159](https://github.com/oca159))
- Replace with register has been remapped from `gr` to `gR`. ([#28602](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28602); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian))

### AI

- Introduced agentic editing via the Agent Panel.
- Improved Content Type matching of `/fetch` commands in text threads. ([#29124](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29124))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a bug that could cause conflicted paths to not appear in their own section in the git panel. ([#29534](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29534))
- Fixed case where extension page scrolls up to the top when installing an extension. ([#29640](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29640))
- Fixed paragraph spacing in git commit messages. ([#29637](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29637))
- Fixed several image-related memory leaks. ([#29452](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29452))
- Fixed an issue where the project settings file would be truncated when opened with `zed: open project settings` if the ".zed" directory was excluded from the files scanned in a workspace (in "file_scan_exclusions"). ([#29578](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29578))
- Fixed an issue where markdown code blocks did not wrap correctly. ([#29571](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29571))
- Fixed an issue where selection and bracket pair highlights would not update when new text was added via collab. ([#29558](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29558))
- Fixed selecting the correct theme when searching. ([#28278](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28278); thanks [hoodie](https://github.com/hoodie))
- Fixed an issue where using tab with multiple cursors would result in inconsistent relative indentation across lines. ([#29519](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29519))
- Fixed issues with code completions where they wouldn't show completions with matched prefix at top. ([#29456](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29456))
- Fixed an issue where `SelectNext` and `SelectPrevious` did not preserve the last selection's cursor direction. ([#29293](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29293))
- Fixed a bug causing incorrect formatting of Git commit tooltips. ([#29704](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29704))
- Fixed file finder crashing for certain file names with multiple characters in lowercase form. ([#29798](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29798))
- Fixed tasks not being stopped on reruns. ([#29786](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29786))
- Fixed SSH projects not restoring their window position on reopen. ([#29906](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29906))
- Fixed an error that could sometimes occur when editing using Copilot Chat. ([#30007](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30007))
- Fixed an issue where Zed would show no language and an incorrect line/column value on startup. ([#29480](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29480))
- Fixed an issue where accepting an HTML completion would correctly edit the start tag but incorrectly update the end tag. ([#29988](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29988))
- Fixed an issue where the keymap/settings migration message would sometimes show up on tabs other than `settings.json` and `keymap.json`. ([#29989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29989))
- Fixed a (rare) panic when highlighting text in the editor. ([#29985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29985))
- Fixed a panic that could sometimes occur when the agent applies edits. ([#30030](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/30030))
- Fixed a crash when inputting `ciq` in vim mode inside of a raw string in a bash file. ([#29617](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29617))
- Vim: Fixed a bug when escaping `(` and `)` in command-palette find and replace. ([#29555](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29555); thanks [Hilda24](https://github.com/Hilda24))
- Vim: Fixed deleting to the end of paragraph when there are no blank lines. ([#29490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29490); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))
- Vim: Fixed `'t'` motion going on top of character that is at the beginning of soft wrapped line instead of before. ([#29303](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29303); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))

## v0.184.8 — 2025-04-30

Today's release features drag-and-drop file uploads to remote projects, remote branch support in the branch picker, multiple Python virtual environments in a single worktree, and customizable Vim cursor shapes for different modes.

## Enhancements

- Added the ability to copy external files into remote projects by dragging them onto the project panel. ([#28987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28987))
- Added a way to navigate between changes with `editor::GoToPreviousChange` and `editor::GoToNextChange`. ([#28891](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28891))
- Improved terminal right-click to automatically select the word under the cursor if no selection is present. ([#29131](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29131); thanks [kylelau519](https://github.com/kylelau519))
- Improved regex highlighting. ([#28183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28183); thanks [chbk](https://github.com/chbk))
- Improved code completion ranking with better balance between LSP and fuzzy search results. ([#29442](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29442))

### Git

- Added support for remote branches to the branch picker. ([#28978](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28978))
- Added head commit SHA information to the Git branch picker in the title bar and Git panel. ([#29007](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29007))

### Languages

- Improved code completions to prioritize LSP hints, such as local variables, so they appear at the top of the list. ([#29182](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29182))
- Improved HTML highlighting. ([#28184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28184); thanks [chbk](https://github.com/chbk))

### Vim

- Vim: Added cursor shape settings for each mode. ([#28636](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28636); thanks [knmts](https://github.com/knmts))

```json
{
  "vim_mode": true,
  "vim": {
    "cursor_shape": {
      "normal": "hollow",
      "insert": "bar",
      "replace": "block",
      "visual": "underline"
    }
  }
}
```

### AI

- Ollama: Added support for Qwen3. Defaults to 16K token context. See [Assistant Configuration Docs](https://zed.dev/docs/assistant/configuration#ollama-context) to increase. ([#29580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29580))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed a regression where `shift-v up` on an empty line would appear to have selected the line after (though in reality it did not). ([#29253](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29253))
- Fixed wrong paths opening when cmd-clicking in the terminal. ([#29274](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29274))
- Fixed a panic when joining a project with a multibuffer with merged excerpts. ([#29245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29245))
- Fixed an issue where the `--system-specs` arg wouldn't work if Zed panicked during app initialization (e.g., when failing to create a Vulkan context in blade). ([#29240](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29240))
- Fixed duplicated excerpts (and resulting panics) in multi-buffers. ([#29193](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29193))
- Fixed an issue where Zed would crash when scrolling over single-line input fields with `scroll_beyond_last_line` set to `vertical_scroll_margin`. ([#28471](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28471); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi))
- Fixed an issue where the editor context menu remained visible when a modal, such as the command palette, was opened. ([#29127](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29127); thanks [redforks](https://github.com/redforks))
- Fixed the signature popover not hiding on editor scroll. ([#29149](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29149))
- Fixed Zed sometimes becoming a stopped background process when run from a terminal. ([#29070](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29070))
- Fixed an issue where invoking `DeployReplace` while the Find dialog was open did not switch to the Find & Replace dialog. ([#29066](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29066))
- Fixed an issue where invoking `DeployReplace` while the Find & Replace dialog was already open did not focus it. ([#29066](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29066))
- Fixed macOS key symbols being displayed on other platforms. ([#29016](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29016))
- Fixed an issue where editor scrolling would stop when the mouse hovered over another editor's gutter. ([#28924](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28924))
- Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause Gemini models to fail streaming their response. ([#29470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29470))
- Fixed a missing shell-escape in askpass resulting in erroneous "Permission denied" errors when trying to connect to a remote server over SSH. (preview only) ([#29449](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29449))
- Fixed a bug where the Key Context View could show incorrect context, causing confusing results. ([#29324](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29324))
- Fixed a rare panic in the editor. ([#29352](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29352))
- Fixed issues with code completions where they wouldn't show completions with matched prefix at the top. ([#29456](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29456))
- Removed the need to have OpenBSD `netcat` (`nc`) installed on your system to enter passwords for `git` or `ssh` (remote development). If you previously installed `netcat` specifically for Zed, you may uninstall it. ([#28920](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28920))
- Git: Fixed amend not working for detached HEAD. ([#29017](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29017))
- Vim: Fixed a panic when using `gv` after `p` in visual line mode. ([#29251](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29251))
- Vim: Fixed character count in visual line mode. ([#28669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28669); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian))
- Vim: Fixed an issue where `c j` and `c k` did not respect indentation. ([#28934](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28934); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV))
- Vim: Fixed cursor scrolling off screen with `ctrl-y`. ([#27754](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27754); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian))
- Linux: Improved parsing of `ZED_DEVICE_ID` environment variable in an attempt to fix some cases where it erroneously failed to parse. The `ZED_DEVICE_ID` is now expected to always be a 4-digit hexadecimal number (as it is in the output of `lspci`) with an optional `0x` or `0X` prefix. ([#29235](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29235))
- Linux: Fixed incorrect config directory being used when Zed is installed via Flatpak. ([#28952](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28952))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Changed default bindings for splitting terminals from `ctrl-k {up,down,left,right}` to `ctrl-alt-{up,down,left,right}`. `ctrl-k` is used by Readline to cut to the end of the line. ([#29188](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29188))
- Renamed `outline_panel::Open` to `outline_panel::OpenSelectedEntry` for better clarity. ([#28890](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28890))

## v0.183.10 — 2025-04-23

Today's release features Git amend support, customizable bottom dock layouts, improved diagnostics rendering, and support for OpenAI's `o3` and `o4-mini` models.

## Enhancements

- "Block" diagnostics (that show up in the diagnostics view, or when using `f8`/`shift-f8`) are rendered more clearly. ([#28006](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28006))

![Improved block diagnostics rendering](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae6d2ff6-5183-4b74-89d0-fefee1aa11e3)

- `f8`/`shift-f8` now always go to the "next" or "prev" diagnostic, regardless of the state of the editor. ([#28006](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28006))
- Added a new `bottom_dock_layout` setting that can take the following options: `contained` (default), `full`, `left_aligned`, and `right_aligned`. This setting defines how the bottom dock should be laid out when multiple docks are open at the same time. ([#26211](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26211); thanks [th0jensen](https://github.com/th0jensen))

![Using the `left_aligned` option](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8460a3ce-56af-4c6f-bd72-cb69269f30f7)

- Added new actions `editor::FindNextMatch` and `editor::FindPreviousMatch` that are similar to `editor::SelectNext` and `editor::SelectPrevious` with `"replace_newest": true`, but jump to the first or last selection when there are multiple selections. ([#28559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28559))
- Added enabling of required features when executing a Rust example or bin through a task. ([#27312](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27312); thanks [NiklasEi](https://github.com/NiklasEi))
- Sublime Keymap: Added `git::Restore` compatibility bind (revert_hunk). Mac: `cmd-k cmd-z` and Linux: `ctrl-k ctrl-z`. ([#28444](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28444))
- Added file icon for Vyper (`.vy`, `.vyi`) files. ([#28307](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28307); thanks [ThatOneCalculator](https://github.com/ThatOneCalculator))
- Tasks are now loaded from local `.vscode/tasks.json` files even if they are `.gitignore`d. ([#28631](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28631); thanks [hrou0003](https://github.com/hrou0003))
- Snippets are now resolved for all languages active at the cursor location. ([#27718](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27718); thanks [claytonrcarter](https://github.com/claytonrcarter))
- Improved visibility of code actions by showing them in the right-click context menu. ([#28677](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28677))
- Improved app responsiveness when spawning Rust tasks. ([#28553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28553))
- Improved scroll behavior of `editor: select all matches`. ([#28435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28435); thanks [neunato](https://github.com/neunato))
- Improved `editor: copy and trim` command. ([#29023](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29023); thanks [redforks](https://github.com/redforks))
- Improved selection highlight speed. ([#29097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29097))
- Made it so Markdown preview uses the buffer font size instead of the UI font size. ([#29183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29183))
- Updated snake_case check for grammar names in extensions. ([#28608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28608))
- Made it so the cursor position is reset to where it was after the last edit when undoing a format operation. This only changes the behavior when you make an edit, scroll away, initiate formatting (either by saving or manually), and then undo the format. ([#28527](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28527))

### Git

- Added Git amend support. ([#28187](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28187))
- Improved performance of Git panel with a large number of untracked files. ([#28670](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28670))
- Improved the Git panel context menu to show actions with no effect as disabled. ([#28288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28288); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian))

### Languages

- Python: Added support for auto-closing `f`, `b`, `u`, `r`, `rb`, and the newly released `t` strings. ([#28709](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28709))
- Go: Corrected SoftTab indentation handling for lines with mixed spaces and tabs across `.go` files and other file types. ([#27336](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27336); thanks [rodrigoFfreire](https://github.com/rodrigoFfreire))

### Vim

- Added some forced motion support for delete and yank. ([#27991](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27991); thanks [mastion](https://github.com/mastion))
- Added delete mapping in normal mode. ([#28551](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28551); thanks [mastion](https://github.com/mastion))
- Improved `single-repeat` after accepting a completion; now pressing `.` to replay the completion will re-insert the completion text at the cursor position. ([#28586](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28586))
- The `:s//` command now defaults to replacing the first match per line (like Vim). Use `/g` to replace all matches. ([#28138](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28138); thanks [dinocosta](https://github.com/dinocosta))

### AI

- Added support for OpenAI o3 and o4-mini models via OpenAI API and Copilot Chat providers. ([#28881](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28881); thanks @imumesh18)

- Fixed a crash when screen sharing on macOS. ([#28784](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/28784))

- Fixed a panic when joining a project with a multibuffer with merged excerpts. ([#29245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/29245))

- Improved how upper-case characters are handled in keybinds. "Special" keys such as the function keys, `control`, `shift`, etc. are now parsed case-insensitively, so for example `F8`, `CTRL`, `SHIFT` are now acceptable alternatives to `f8`, `ctrl`, and `shift` when declaring keybindings. Additionally, upper-case (ASCII) characters will now be converted explicitly to `shift` + the lowercase version of the character, to match the Vim behavior. ## Linux Video

- Added the ability to specify which GPU Zed uses on Linux by setting the `ZED_DEVICE_ID` environment variable. You can obtain the device ID of your GPU by running `lspci -nn | grep VGA` which will output each GPU on one line like:
  ```
  08:00.0 VGA compatible controller [0300]: NVIDIA Corporation GA104 [GeForce RTX 3070] [10de:2484] (rev a1)
  ```
  where the device ID here is `2484`. This value is in hexadecimal, so to force Zed to use this specific GPU you would set the environment variable like so:
  ```
  ZED_DEVICE_ID=0x2484
  ```
  Make sure to export the variable if you choose to define it globally in a `.bashrc` or similar

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Files that are 6GB or larger will now not open. This is a temporary workaround for inefficient handling of large files resulting in extremely high memory usage, often resulting in system freezing, requiring a restart of Zed or the entire system. ([#27458](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27458))
- Changed Markdown default to `soft_wrap` at window width instead of `preferred_line_length`. ([#27205](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27205))

## v0.179.2 — 2025-03-26

We introduced a new display mode for Edit Prediction called `subtle`, which makes predicted text hidden by default and only visible when you're holding a modifier key. To turn it on, open the `Edit Prediction` status bar menu and select `subtle`. This can also be adjusted via your `settings.json` with: `"edit_predictions": { "mode": "subtle" }`. To read about this new mode, check [the blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/out-of-your-face-ai).

## Enhancements

- Added support for word-based completions via `editor: show word completions`. ([#26410](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26410))
- Added the ability to filter the list of extensions by category. ([#27005](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27005))
- Added support for reading from anonymous file descriptors (e.g., created as part of process substitution) on macOS and Linux. ([#26744](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26744))
- Added a setting `use_system_prompts`. On macOS, you can set this to `false` to use Zed's in-window confirmation dialogs instead of the system ones. (On Linux, Zed's dialogs are always used). ([#26201](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26201); thanks [Hawkbawk](https://github.com/Hawkbawk))
- Added fallback colors for the `version_control.<variant>` theme properties. ([#27106](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27106))
- Git: Added a `SelectRepo` action that opens the repository selector in a modal. ([#26950](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26950))
- Git: Added a new `git_hosting_providers` setting for configuring custom Git hosting providers. ([#26879](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26879); thanks [khayyamsaleem](https://github.com/khayyamsaleem))
- Git: Improved the placement of the repo and branch picker popovers in the git panel. ([#26950](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26950))
