- Git: Synced Git action buttons between the project diff and git panel. ([#26938](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26938))
- Git: Removed a behavior where staging the last hunk in the project diff would open the commit modal. ([#26939](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26939))
- SSH: Improved handling of multiple `@` in connection strings: e.g., `ssh jim.lv@es2@10.220.67.57@11.239.1.231` improving support of jump hosts running JumpServer. ([#25314](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25314); thanks [ColorFuzzy](https://github.com/ColorFuzzy))
- Multi-buffer: Improved `Expand Excerpt Down` so the button stays in place, allowing rapid expansion without moving the mouse. ([#27058](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27058))
- Improved Multibuffer design. Multibuffers now use less vertical space for excerpt boundaries. Additionally, the expand up/down arrows are hidden at the start and end of the buffers. ([#24428](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24428))
- Improved performance when using the scroll wheel and some other mouse interactions. ([#25009](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25009); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Improved support for extended keyboards on Mac (F20-F35). ([#26899](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26899); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA))
- Improved autocomplete for `keymap.json` by treating `::` like word characters when inside a string. ([#26574](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26574); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved save dialogues for new files to default to the directory you're currently working in instead of the project root. ([#22563](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22563); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- Extended timeout used when connecting to remote instances. ([#27250](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/27250))

- Git: On macOS, switched to using the system's Git binary to create commits. This fixes issues that some users were seeing with pre-commit hooks. Compatibility note: after this change, it is no longer possible to commit from Zed unless Git is installed. ([#26705](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26705))
- Git: Fixed a bug that prevented putting the cursor after a deletion hunk at the end of a file, in the absence of trailing newlines. ([#26621](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26621))
- Git: Fixed flicker when reverting last hunk in project diff view. ([#26706](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26706))
- Git: Fixed the Git panel to not show an "Initialize Repositories" button in empty projects. ([#26713](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26713))
- Git: Fixed showing commit messages for all repos. ([#26709](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26709))
- Fixed `vim::PreviousSectionEnd` (bound to `[ ]`) to move to the beginning of the line, matching the behavior of `vim::NextSectionEnd`. ([#26264](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26264))

- Git: Fixed git-credential-manager. ([#26573](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26573))
- Git: Fixed a bug where unstage/stage all in project diff wouldn't work while Git panel was closed. ([#26575](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26575))
- Git: Commit messages are now wrapped "as you type" to 72 characters. ([#26507](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26507))

- Fixed a bug where the modal layer could not be dismissed via the mouse.

## v0.177.7 — 2025-03-12

🚀 Zed now has [built-in Git support](https://zed.dev/git)! 🚀

You can view your diff, stage changes, commit, and push from within the editor. For more information, check out the [blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/git).

---

## Enhancements

- Added support for `stop_at_indent` to `Editor::DeleteToBeginningOfLine`. (Thanks [@felixpackard](https://github.com/felixpackard))
- Added support to unfold multibuffer excerpts when editing their contents. ([#25677](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25677))
- Added a way to toggle inlay hints with modifiers. ([#25752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25752))

```json5
"inlay_hints": {
    /// A set of modifiers which, when pressed, will toggle the visibility of inlay hints.
    /// If the set is empty or not all the modifiers specified are pressed, inlay hints will not be toggled.
    "toggle_on_modifiers_press": {
        "control": false,
        "shift": false,
        "alt": false,
        "platform": false,
        "function": false
    }
}
```

- Added `copy permalink` action for self-hosted GitHub enterprise instances. ([#26482](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/26482))
- SSH: Added support for specifying `ssh_config` files (`ssh -F ssh_config`) in connection string. ([#25619](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25619))
- SSH: Added support for downloading `zed-remote-server` with busybox wget (Alpine, etc). ([#25621](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25621))
- Improved Zed tasks' `ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT` fallbacks. ([#25605](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25605))
- Improved performance of rendering multibuffers with very large numbers of buffers. ([#26308](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/26308))
- Changed the `always_show_close_button` key to `show_close_button` and introduced a new `hidden` value, that allows never displaying the close button. ([#23880](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23880); thanks [@Morgandri1](https://github.com/Morgandri1))
- Updated bundled JSON schemas for `package.json` and `tsconfig.json`. ([#25826](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25826))

### Vim

- Added the ability to set the default Vim mode. ([#25067](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25067); thanks [@aspiringLich](https://github.com/aspiringLich))
- Fixed back quotes ``` `` ``` not recognized as object. ([#24999](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24999); thanks [@yichengliu](https://github.com/yichengliu))

### Languages

## v0.175.5 — 2025-02-26

We are currently working to integrate Git more deeply into Zed. [Join the waitlist](https://zed.dev/git?g=41) for the private beta, and we will pull you in when it's ready!

---

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- A number of themes are no longer installed in Zed by default: `Andromeda`, `Atelier`, `Rosé Pine`, `Sandcastle`, `Solarized` & `Summercamp`. If you would like to continue using one of these extensions ([#24589](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24589)):
  1. Open `zed: extensions`
  2. Install the `zed-legacy-themes` extension
  3. Re-select your desired theme
- No longer open the split menu in the file finder when command is pressed. ([#25097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25097))

## Enhancements

- Added support for Mistral to the Assistant. ([#24879](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24879); thanks [Shidfar](https://github.com/Shidfar))

- Added a way to configure user key bindings to toggle font size without adjusting user settings ([#24857](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24857)). By default, toggling font size will not result in the user settings being updated. You can opt into persistence by adding some of the following keybindings to your `keybindings.json` file:
    - `"cmd-=": ["zed::IncreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd-+": ["zed::IncreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd--": ["zed::DecreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd-0": ["zed::ResetBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`

- Improved LSP documentation file links by opening in Zed, not the system opener. ([#25117](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25117))
- Improved rendering of completion documentation markdown consistently with documentation markdown. ([#25117](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25117))
- Improved display of long paths in the file finder modal. ([#25049](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25049))
- Improved workspace serialization by persisting latest selections for editors. ([#25083](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25083))
- Improved redaction of Google Gemini keys from API errors in logs. ([#24884](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24884))

## v0.174.6 — 2025-02-20

- Fixed an issue where using `zed: increase buffer font size` and `zed: decrease buffer font size` commands would alter the user's `settings.json` file. Now, by default, using these commands will not alter your settings file, but you can opt into persistence by adding some of the following keybindings to your `keybindings.json` file:
    - `"cmd-=": ["zed::IncreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd-+": ["zed::IncreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd--": ["zed::DecreaseBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`
    - `"cmd-0": ["zed::ResetBufferFontSize", { "persist": true }]`

## v0.174.4 — 2025-02-19

Last week, we introduced the public beta of [Edit Prediction](https://zed.dev/blog/edit-prediction). To support the launch of this beta, we accelerated the release of all preview features and bug fixes to the stable version. This resulted in a more substantial stable release last week, followed by a smaller update this week. Check out today's preview release (`v0.175.0`) for more action.

---

- Fixed a bug where edit predictions would not interact correctly with code within folded blocks. Folded blocks are now automatically expanded when jumping to them. ([#25116](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25116))
- Fixed panics on completion with multi-byte characters input. ([#25150](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/25150))

## v0.173.8 — 2025-02-13

Introducing [Edit Prediction](https://zed.dev/edit-prediction). Powered by [Zeta](https://huggingface.co/zed-industries/zeta), our open-source, open-dataset language model.

To learn more, check out the [blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/edit-prediction).

## Enhancements

- Allow searching within the results of a project search ([#23819](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23819)).
- Icon themes: Added the ability for extensions to change the file icon for the following file types:
   - Bicep (`.bicep`) ([#24757](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24757); thanks [jezikk](https://github.com/jezikk)).

   - Cue (`.cue`) ([#24711](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24711); thanks [sethstha](https://github.com/sethstha))
   - GitLab YAML (`gitlab-ci.yml`) ([#24711](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24711); thanks [sethstha](https://github.com/sethstha))
   - Luau (`.luau`) ([#24711](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24711); thanks [sethstha](https://github.com/sethstha))
   - Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`) ([#24648](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24648))
   - React (`.mjsx`, `.cjsx`, `.mtsx`, `.ctsx`) ([#24659](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24659), thanks [twlite](https://github.com/twlite))
   - Solidity (`.sol`) ([#24711](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24711); thanks [sethstha](https://github.com/sethstha))
   - Svelte (`.svelte`) ([#24644](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24644))
   - Stylehint (`stylelint.config.cjs`, `stylelint.config.js`, `stylelint.config.mjs`, etc.) ([#24605](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24605); thanks [radmorecameron](https://github.com/radmorecameron))
- Icon themes: Added support for configuring both a light and dark icon theme and switching between them based on system preference ([#24702](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24702)).

```json
{
  "icon_theme": {
    "mode": "system",
    "light": "Zed (Default)",
    "dark": "Zed (Default)"
  }
}
```

- Added an option to open the icon theme selector from the user menu ([#24482](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24482); thanks [beniaminzagan](https://github.com/beniaminzagan)).

- Modified some keymap actions and settings for naming consistency ([#23834](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23834)). To ensure a smooth transition, we implemented a settings migrator. If Zed detects that you’ve customized a keybinding with an outdated name, you’ll receive a toast notification. This notification includes an action that, when activated, creates a backup of your current settings and updates the setting name while preserving your custom binding. Our aim is to establish consistent and easily-searchable action names. For any potential future changes, we’ll continue to use the migrator, so that you do not have to manually update your `keymap.json` file.

## v0.172.8 — 2025-02-05

Users have been asking us for a long time to give them the ability to customize their file icons:

![file-icons-issue](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e4c26fec-d3c2-4f19-b3bb-6fdddcb1eaf2)

With today's release of [icon themes](http://zed.dev/blog/icon-themes), this is now possible! 🎉

![feature-image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6056e86e-0def-48ce-a1a0-87c3ec3d4e46)

# Enhancements

## General

- Added support for icon themes ([#23987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23987)).
  - Extensions can now provide icon themes.
  - Use the `icon theme selector: toggle` action to switch between installed icon themes.
- Added precise drag-and-drop for files onto folded directories in the Project Panel ([#22983](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22983); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Added functionality to expand or collapse a directory and all its contents (`alt+click`) ([#22896](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22896); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Added `Open File` action in file menu for Linux and Windows ([#23707](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23707); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Added a new `show_tab_bar_buttons` setting, under `tab_bar`, that enables hiding the pane tab bar buttons ([#23752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23752)).
- Added auto-completion support for snippet files ([#23698](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23698); thanks [loczek](https://github.com/loczek)).
- Added an `editor: open selections in multibuffer` (`alt-enter`) command ([#23644](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23644)).
- Added Copilot Chat support for `o3-mini` and remove support for `o1-mini` ([#24080](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24080); thanks [SkywardSyntax](https://github.com/SkywardSyntax)).
- Improved terminal hover word matching ([#23776](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23776)).
- Improved diff rendering, allowing you to navigate with your cursor inside of deleted text in diff hunks ([#22994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22994)).
- Improved editor horizontal autoscroll to now place the cursor to the left of the scrollbar rather than under it ([#23586](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23586)).
- Improved the task modal by using the full task label when it does not require truncation ([#23611](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23611)).
- Improved project search performance in worktrees with binary files ([#23581](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23581)).
- Improved the `Copy Permalink` menu item by disabling it when not in a Git repository ([#23350](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23350); thanks [Swiftaff](https://github.com/Swiftaff)).
- Improved `workspace: new window` action to now bring app to foreground ([#24015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24015)).
- Improved default `inline_completions.disabled_globs` ([#24051](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24051)).
- Revised "Hide/Show Inline Completions" menu.
- Errors in settings file are now reported in UI on startup ([#23817](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23817)).

## Language Support

- Added Python syntax highlighting for class- and module-level docstrings, additional docstrings, and improved recognition of function-level docstrings ([#20898](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20898); thanks [jfmontanaro](https://github.com/jfmontanaro)).
- Improved support for `yaml-language-server` as YAML formatter ([#23612](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23612)).
- Language servers now track their working directory more accurately ([#23473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23473)).

## AI

- Accepting completions while the cursor is in the middle of suggested completion will now result in smaller edits being applied ([#23490](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23490)).

## Vim, Emacs, and Keybinds

- Vim: Added `ab`/`ib` "AnyBrackets" text objects that are the smallest of `a(`, `a[` or `a{` or `i(`, `i[` or `i{` ([#23679](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23679); thanks [oca159](https://github.com/oca159)).
- Vim: Added support for `ctrl-g` and `{count} ctrl-g` to show the filename in the status bar ([#23562](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23562)).
- Vim: Fixed aq/iq "AnyQuotes" text objects when they are nested ([#23679](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23679); thanks [oca159](https://github.com/oca159)).

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed terminal drag and drop, including project panel items ([#23827](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23827)).
- Fixed inline Git blame not visible on long lines due to overflow ([#23374](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23374); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Fixed `project_panel::NewDirectory`, `editor:: NewlineAbove` in TextMate keymap ([#23825](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23825); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee)).
- Fixed `.gitignore`d files filter occasionally not working in context file picker ([#23777](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23777)).
- Fixed an issue where snippets would not update when a snippets file contained comments ([#23755](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23755); thanks [loczek](https://github.com/loczek)).
- Fixed the issue where a file outside of the workspace was opening in a random window instead of the last active window ([#23726](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23726); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Fixed `ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT` incorrectly pointing to a file. Now points to a directory when current file is a project or unset when in out-of-project files (settings.json, tasks.json, etc) ([#23150](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23150); thanks [aborg-dev](https://github.com/aborg-dev)).
- Fixed incorrect UTF-8 characters handling in `GoToLine` and caret position ([#23654](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23654)).
- Fixed some instances of disabled list items still registering clicks ([#23569](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23569)).
- Fixed `The path /.../tsserver.js doesn't point to a valid tsserver install. Falling back to bundled TypeScript version.` pop-up appearing ([#23525](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23525)).
- Fixed panics on opening repositories with empty remotes ([#23520](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23520)).
- Python: Fixed venv activation script path showing up in terminal for non-existent scripts ([#23476](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23476)).
- Fixed a crash that could happen when expanding certain diff hunks ([#23990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23990)).
- Fixed a bug where diff hunks were not syntax highlighted when reopening a project with previously-opened buffers ([#23990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23990)).
- Fixed an issue in certain themes where diffs would render with the wrong red and green colors for deletions and insertions ([#24151](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24151)).
- Fixed some modifier changed events not being present on Linux X11. This affected things like the project search palette, where holding ctrl would not cause the split options to appear ([#24154](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24154)).
- Fixed multiple save modals appearing when app is being closed multiple times ([#24180](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24180)).
- Fixed a panic when deleting text after a deletion hunk ([#24280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24280)).
- Fixed missing git blame and status output in some projects with multiple git repositories ([#24283](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24283)).
- Fixed a bug where Zed could crash with certain input sources on macOS ([#24286](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/24286)).

## Breaking changes

- Changed `editor: open excerpts split` key binding to `cmd-alt-enter` on macOS and `ctrl-alt-enter` on Linux, to be more consistent with other actions that open files in a new split ([#23646](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23646)).

## v0.170.1 — 2025-01-22

# Enhancements

## General

- Improved app responsiveness with large number of diagnostics ([#23122](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23122)).
- Improved visibility of errors from language servers by reporting them in the UI when the user invokes an LSP action ([#23011](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23011)).
- Improved formatting of selection by adding support for multiple cursors ([#22933](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22933)).
- Improved diagnostic excerpts by using syntactic info to determine the context lines to show ([#22858](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22858)).
- Added an error toast that is shown when a dev extension fails to install ([#22914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22914)).
- Added the process ID (PID) to terminal tab tooltips ([#21955](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21955); thanks [Angelk90](https://github.com/Angelk90)).
- Added `project_panel.entry_spacing` setting to configure spacing between entries in the project panel: `comfortable` (default) or `standard` ([#16255](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16255); thanks [mikesun](https://github.com/mikesun)).
- Improved keymap settings file with enhanced JSON schema information, enabling better `json-language-server` completions and tooltips, especially for actions requiring input ([#23044](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23044)).

## Language Support

- Added support for checking for `yaml-language-server` on the`$PATH` ([#22036](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22036); thanks [henryhchchc](https://github.com/henryhchchc)).
- Changed default formatter for C/C++ to be the primary language server, not Prettier. Format-on-save is still disabled by default for C/C++, but if one uses the `editor: format` command now, it will default to the language server. `clangd` can format C++ files, whereas prettier cannot ([#23112](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23112), [#23119](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23119)).
- Fixed rename symbols action when the language server does not have the capability to prepare renames - such as `luau-lsp` ([#23000](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23000)).
- Added configuration sent on initialization to the `Server Info` section of the language server logs ([#23084](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23084)).
- Improved LSP debug logs by defaulting to soft wrap and folding a suffix of long lines. Also adds autoscroll, so if the cursor is on the last line of the logs they will scroll like `tail` ([#22996](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22996)).

## AI

- Added support for [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/) to the Assistant ([#23097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23097); thanks [yagil](https://github.com/yagil)).
- Renamed Github Copilot Chat "o1-preview" model to "o1" ([#23038](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23038); thanks [SkywardSyntax](https://github.com/SkywardSyntax)).

## Vim, Emacs, and Keybinds

- Vim: Added SubWord TextObject ([#22387](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22387); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA)).
- Vim: Added support for the popular [vim_sneak](https://github.com/justinmk/vim-sneak) plugin. This is disabled by default and can be enabled by binding a key to the `Sneak` and `SneakBackward` operators ([#22793](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22793); thanks [nilehmann](https://github.com/nilehmann)).
- Emacs: Added support for `ctrl-t` transposing characters on Linux ([#22974](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22974)).
- Added `Diagnostics` key context allowing Diagnostic pane-specific keybinds ([#23043](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23043); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone)).
- macOS: Added `fn-f` keyboard shortcut for fullscreen toggle ([#23184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23184)).

- Fixed outline items not scrolling properly ([#22890](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22890)).

# Enhancements

## General

- Typescript: Improved `typescript-language-server` completion details rendering ([#23034](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23034))
- Ensure `end >= start` in `lsp::Range` (fixes some Zig zls crashes; perhaps others) ([#22690](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22690); thanks [unexge](https://github.com/unexge)).
- Improved Tree-sitter support with added compatibility for standard injections captures ([#22268](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22268); thanks [uncenter](https://github.com/uncenter)).
- Fixed `gopls` path construction on Windows 11 ([#22727](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22727); thanks [TorratDev](https://github.com/TorratDev)).

## AI

- Improved support for Phi4 with ollama ([#23036](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/23036)).
- Added support for Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash experimental model ([#22665](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22665); thanks [respberryx](https://github.com/respberryx)).
- Added support for the Claude 3.5 Haiku model ([#22323](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22323); thanks [saahityaedams](https://github.com/saahityaedams)).

## Vim, Emacs, and Keybinds

- vim: Add 'g J' JoinLines and JoinLinesNoWhitespace ([#22496](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22496); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA)).
- vim: Add `aq`/`iq` "any quote" text objects that are the smallest of `a"`, `a'` or <code>a`</code> ([#22263](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22263); thanks [oca159](https://github.com/oca159)).
- Fixed a panic in vim text objects in multibuffers ([#22753](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22753)).
- Fixed `Y` so it yanks entire line instead of selection ([#22416](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22416); thanks [0x2CA](https://github.com/0x2CA)).
- Improvements to emacs keybindings ([#22590](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22590) and [#22629](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22629); thanks [rosstimson](https://github.com/rosstimson)).:
  - Better support for running emacs inside Zed terminal (e.g. `ctrl-x ctrl-c` will quit emacs in terminal not zed)
  - `alt-;` Toggle Comments
  - `alt-^` Join Lines
  - `ctrl-/` Undo
  - `alt-.` GotoDefinition and `alt-,` GoBack
  - `alt-<` / `alt->` Goto End/Beginning of Buffer
  - `alt-g g` or `alt-g alt-g` Goto Line Number
  - `ctrl-x h` SelectAll
  - `ctrl-x b` Switch Tabs
  - `ctrl-g` Menu::cancel
  - `ctrl-x 5 0` CloseWindow
  - `ctrl-x 5 2` as workspace::NewWindow
- Added keyboard navigation for menus on Linux (left/right/up/down).  ([#22074](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22074); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)). If you wish to open menus with keyboard shortcuts add the following to your user keymap:
    ```json
      {
        "context": "Workspace",
        "bindings": {
          "alt-z": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Zed"],
          "alt-f": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "File"],
          "alt-e": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Edit"],
          "alt-s": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Selection"],
          "alt-v": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "View"],
          "alt-g": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Go"],
          "alt-w": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Window"],
          "alt-h": ["app_menu::OpenApplicationMenu", "Help"]
        }
      }
    ```

- Clicking on empty space in the Project Panel now deselects all selected items ([#22073](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22073); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb))
- Improved diff syntax highlighting ([#21740](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21740); thanks [uncenter](https://github.com/uncenter))
- Improved performance of the cursor position indicator in single buffers ([#21946](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21946))
- gpui: Add linear gradient support to fill background ([#20812](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20812); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Added file icon for metal ([#21720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21720); thanks [nervenes](https://github.com/nervenes))
- Added file icon for gitcommit files ([#21935](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21935))
- Added support for tasks spawned via custom keybinding to launch into the center pane ([#22004](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22004)):
    ```json5
    // Assuming you have a task labeled "echo hello"
    "ctrl--": ["task::Spawn", { "task_name": "echo hello", "target": "center" }]
    ```

### Languages and AI

- Changed how inline completions (Copilot, Supermaven, ...) and normal completions (from language servers) interact. Zed will now also show inline completions when the completion menu is visible. The user can accept the inline completion with `<shift-tab>` and the active entry in the completion menu with `<tab>` ([#21858](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21858), [#22069](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22069), [#22077](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22077), [#22093](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22093)).
- Improved completions menu layout to be more stable and use available space better ([#22102](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22102)).
- Added Restart Button to Inline Assistant When Prompt Is Unchanged ([#20439](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20439); thanks [g0t4](https://github.com/g0t4))
- Improved ElixirLS LSP autocomplete to show module, function and struct field details ([#21666](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21666); thanks [jotaviobiondo](https://github.com/jotaviobiondo)).
- Suggest Cython extension for syntax highlighting  of `.pyx`, `.pxd` and `.pxi` files ([#22053](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22053); thanks [lgeiger](https://github.com/lgeiger)).
- Fixed model version of o1 in GitHub Copilot Chat ([#22376](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22376); thanks [chirpcel](https://github.com/chirpcel)).
- The Python virtual environment activation command is no longer shown in the terminal output by default ([#22256](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22256)).

### Vim, Emacs and Keymaps: Oh my!

- Added `Editor::DuplicateSelection` action. Bound to `cmd-d` / `ctrl-d` in JetBrains/SublimeText keymaps ([#21154](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21154) and [#21976](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21976); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- Added `Editor && selection` context for keybindings that are active when there is a text selection ([#21927](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21927); thanks [ozanmakes](https://github.com/ozanmakes)).
- Addded `ToggleRegex` action (macos: `cmd-alt-x`, linux: `ctrl-alt-x`) for buffer search ([#21799](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21799); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823))
- vim: Add support for `:g/<pattern>/<cmd>` and `:v/<pattern>/<cmd>` ([#22177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22177))
- vim: Add <count> support for [x/]x ([#22176](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22176))
- vim: Do not dismiss inline completions when leaving insert/replace mode with `<esc>` ([#22075](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/22075)).
- vim: Improved cursor shape behavior to better match Vim ([#21502](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21502); thanks [5brian](https://github.com/5brian)).
- emacs: Improved `ctrl-a` / `ctrl-e` / `home` / `end` behavior ([#21923](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21923))
- emacs: Added for `ctrl-s` / `ctrl-r` / `ctrl-g` for navigating buffer search results ([#21923](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21923))

## v0.166.1 — 2024-12-18

## Enhancements

### General

- Added support for opening images, either by dropping them onto a pane or by opening them via the command line ([#21803](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21803)).
- Added `left_neighbour` option to the `tabs.activate_on_close` setting to activate the left adjacent tab on tab close ([#21800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21800); thanks [MrSubidubi](https://github.com/MrSubidubi)).
- Added `show_completions_on_input` and `show_completion_documentation` per-language settings.  These settings were available before, but were not configurable per-language ([#21722](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21722)).
- Added support for language server actions being executed on file rename ([#21651](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21651)).
- Added `editor: insert uuid v4` and `editor: insert uuid v7` actions for inserting generated UUIDs into the editor ([#21656](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21656)).
- Added setting (`"project_panel": {"show": "always"}`) to display error and warning indicators in tabs ([#21383](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21383); thanks [nilskch](https://github.com/nilskch)).
- Added `editor::OpenContextMenu` action to open context menu at current cursor position ([#21494](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21494)).
- Changed the include warnings toggle in the diagnostic tab to be global for a Zed session ([#21618](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21618)).
- Improved key equivalents for Norwegian Extended layout ([#21665](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21665)).
- Linux: Added preliminary support for voice chat and viewing screenshares ([#21550](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21550)).

### Languages

- Added support for `*.C` and `*.H` (uppercase) to be recognized as C++ ([#21647](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21647); thanks [budde25](https://github.com/budde25)).
- Added JavaScript runnable detection for `context` and `suite` methods for mochajs framework ([#21719](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21719); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev)).
- Added YAML and TOML frontmatter highlighting for markdown ([#21503](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21503); thanks [uncenter](https://github.com/uncenter)).

### Vim

- Added delete action to HelixNormal mode ([#21544](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21544); thanks [leroycep](https://github.com/leroycep)).
- Added `[ c` & `] c` to select prev/next git modified file within the project panel ([#20941](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20941); thanks [Anthony-Eid](https://github.com/Anthony-Eid)).
- Added `[ d` & `] d` to select prev/next file with diagnostics from an LSP within the project panel ([#20941](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20941); thanks [Anthony-Eid](https://github.com/Anthony-Eid)).
- Added `{` & `}` to select prev/next directory within the project panel ([#20941](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20941); thanks [Anthony-Eid](https://github.com/Anthony-Eid)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed missing `musl` dependency required to build from source on ArchLinux ([#21830](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21830); thanks [connortsui20](https://github.com/connortsui20)).
- Fixed diagnostics editor not scrolling properly under certain conditions ([#21209](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21209)).
- Fixed completion list moving around on load of documentation. The previous approach to mitigating this was to rate-limit the fetch of docs, configured by a `completion_documentation_secondary_query_debounce` setting, which is now deprecated ([#21716](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21716)).
- Fixed right click selection behavior in project panel ([#21707](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21707); thanks [0xtimsb](https://github.com/0xtimsb)).
- Fixed a bug where `cmd-escape` could act like `.` ([#21667](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21667)).
- Fixed a bug where the `panel.background` color was not used in the file tree ([#21559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21559); thanks [nilskch](https://github.com/nilskch)).
- Fixed detection of git remotes when using SSH and username is not "git" ([#21508](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21508); thanks [nickbreaton](https://github.com/nickbreaton)).
- Fixed opening git worktrees that were created from a bare repository ([#21596](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21596)).
- Fixed completion item labels not being updated after the resolve for non-LSP compliant servers ([#21521](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21521)).
- Fixed an issue with multiline code actions' rendering by forcing them to be single line ([#21409](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21409); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- SSH Remoting: Fixed an issue where some dev extensions would not work after being uploaded to the remote server ([#21761](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21761)).

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- `editor::ShowInlineCompetion` is now `option-tab` on macOS (not `option-/`). `editor::{Next,Previous}Completion` are `option-tab` and `option-shift-tab` (not `option-[` and `option-]`). This fixes typing characters generated by option-{/,[,]} on keyboards like Croatian ([#21669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21669)).
- In keymap.json `"use_layout_keys": true` is now the default. If you want to opt-out of this behaviour, set `"use_key_equivalents": true` to have keys mapped for your keyboard ([#21662](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21662)). See [documentation](https://zed.dev/docs/key-bindings#non-qwerty-keyboards).

    {

        }

## v0.163.2 — 2024-11-27

## Enhancements

### General

  ```json
  "file_finder": {
      "modal_width": "medium"
  },
  ```

- Sublime Keymap: Added `editor::SelectAllMatches` compatibility bind (`find_all_under`). Mac: `ctrl-cmd-g` and Linux: `alt-f3` ([#20866](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20866)).

- Enabled snippet parsing to successfully parse snippets with choices ([#13958](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13958); thanks [Anthony-Eid](https://github.com/Anthony-Eid)).
- Show completion menu when tabbing to a snippet variable with multiple choices ([#13958](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13958); thanks [Anthony-Eid](https://github.com/Anthony-Eid)).
- Improved detection of `.env.*` files as Shell Scripts by default ([#20429](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20429)).
- Improved the vertical movement behavior when reaching the start or end of a document. The selection goal is now maintained, aligning with native text field functionality ([#20705](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20705); thanks [lord](https://github.com/lord)).
- Improved handling of externally deleted files: auto-save will be disabled, multibuffers will treat this as a save conflict, and single buffers will ask for restore confirmation ([#20742](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20742)).
- Changed the tab bar height according to `ui-density` ([#19076](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19076); thanks [Aaron-212](https://github.com/Aaron-212)).
- Updated Copilot's underlying version to [Copilot.vim 1.41.0](https://github.com/github/copilot.vim/commit/87038123804796ca7af20d1b71c3428d858a9124) ([#20520](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20520)).

### AI

- Added inline hints that guide users on how to invoke the inline assistant and open the assistant panel. (These hints can be disabled by setting `{"assistant": {"show_hints": false}}`) ([#20824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20824)).
- Updated the Assistant to show more details in error cases ([#20740](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20740)).

### Vim

- Added `:<range>cpplink` to copy a permanent git link to the highlighted range to the clipboard ([#20707](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20707)).

- Added support for `ctrl-o` in insert mode to enter temporary normal mode ([#19454](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19454); thanks [axelcarl](https://github.com/axelcarl)).

### SSH Remoting

- Improved environment variable handling for SSH remotes ([#20641](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20641)).

### Languages

- Python: Improved syntax highlighting ([#20487](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20487), [#20763](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20763)):
  - Differentiated between function and method calls and definitions. `function.definition` matches the highlight for e.g. rust, `function.call` is new (thanks [clwainwright](https://github.com/clwainwright)).
  - Differentiated between class calls and class definitions (thanks [clwainwright](https://github.com/clwainwright)).
  - Better highlighting of function decorators (the `@` symbol is punctuation, and now the decorator itself has a `function.decorator` tag) (thanks [clwainwright](https://github.com/clwainwright)).
  - Made `cls` a special variable (like `self`) (thanks [clwainwright](https://github.com/clwainwright)).
  - Added `ellipsis` as a built-in constant (thanks [clwainwright](https://github.com/clwainwright)).
  - Added syntax highlighting for attribute docstrings (thanks [JaagupAverin](https://github.com/JaagupAverin)).

- Python: Added a configurable option for switching between unittest and pytest as a test runner under Python language settings. Set "TASK_RUNNER" to "unittest" under task settings for Python if you wish to use unittest to run Python tasks; the default is pytest ([#18824](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18824); thanks [jrderuiter](https://github.com/jrderuiter)).
- Python: Improved toolchain selection for Conda environments ([#20702](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20702); thanks [wolffiex](https://github.com/wolffiex)).
- Python: Improved handling of triple-quote strings ([#20664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20664)).
- Python: Improved detection of Poetry-based environments ([#20669](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20669)).
- Python: tasks now use active toolchain to run ([#20667](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20667)).
- HTML: Added injections for Markdown syntax highlighting ([#20527](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20527); thanks [uncenter](https://github.com/uncenter)).
- JavaScript, TypeScript, and TSX: Highlighted `?` and `:` in ternary expressions as operator ([#20573](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20573); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii)).
- Added some more common Prettier plugin base paths ([#20758](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20758); thanks [sweetppro](https://github.com/sweetppro)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed ESLint 404 downloads ([#21233](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21233)).
- Fixed for cmd-shift-\ (cmd-|) not working for MoveToEnclosingBracket on macOS ([#21207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/21207)).

- Fixed rendering of dragged project panel entries ([#20686](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20686)).
- SSH Remoting: Fixed accidental use of GNU netcat instead of nc provided by macOS ([#20751](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20751)).

- Fixed a bug where a directory would be expanded when dropped onto itself in project_panel ([#20365](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20365); thanks [matubu](https://github.com/matubu)).
- Fixed inline completions (Copilot, Supermaven, ...) taking over when a snippet completion was active. That resulted in `tab` not working to jump to the next placeholder in the snippet ([#20300](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20300)).
- Fixed a bug where file-closing actions would close pinned tabs ([#19593](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19593); thanks [axelcarl](https://github.com/axelcarl)).
- Typescript: Fixed a bug where abstract classes weren't shown correctly in the outline view when editing code ([#20377](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20377)).
- Fixed Zed when the directory that you opened is renamed ([#20313](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20313)).
- SSH Remoting: Fixed password dialog for remote server showing ligatures ([#20549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20549)).


## Breaking Changes and Notices

We have made a number of changes to keyboard shortcuts to support non-US keyboard layouts. See [the blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/keyboard-localization) for more information on our general approach, or [the issue](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/20425) for details about what changed.

- All builtin shortcuts that were bound to `alt-[a-z]` have been rebound, as these shortcuts intefered with typing on non-US keyboards. You can restore these by adding them to your keymap file. The complete list of changes is:

  | Old Binding   | Mapped To                      | Function                                            |
  | ------------- | ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
  | `alt-b`       | `alt-right`                    | `editor::MoveToNextWordStart`                       |
  | `alt-d`       | `alt-delete`                   | `editor::DeleteToNextWordEnd`                       |
  | `alt-f`       | `alt-left`                     | `editor::MoveToNextWordEnd`                         |
  | `alt-shift-f` | `ctrl-shift-f`                 | `project_panel::SearchInDirectory`                  |
  | `alt-h`       | `alt-backspace`                | `editor::DeleteToPreviousWordStart`                 |
  | `alt-m`       | `ctrl-shift-m`                 | `assistant::ToggleModelSelector`                    |
  | `alt-q`       | `cmd-k q` / `ctrl-k q`         | `editor::Rewrap`                                    |
  | `alt-t`       | `cmd-shift-r` / `ctrl-shift-r` | `task::Spawn`                                       |
  | `alt-shift-t` | `alt-cmd-r` / `ctrl-alt-r`     | `task::Rerun`                                       |
  | `alt-v`       | `ctrl-shift-v`                 | `["editor::MovePageUp", { "center_cursor": true }]` |
  | `alt-z`       | `cmd-k z` / `ctrl-k z`         | `editor::ToggleSoftWrap`                            |

  Note that `alt-t` and `alt-shift-t` have been kept as secondary bindings for Tasks but we may remove them completely in the future.

- macOS: (For non-US keyboards). Shortcuts are now [automatically localized](https://zed.dev/docs/key-bindings#non-qwerty-keyboards) in the same way they are on macOS. For example on QWERTZ keyboards `cmd-[` is now `cmd-ö` and `cmd-]` is `cmd-ä`. This allows anyone to access all of our builtin shortcuts.
- macOS: (For non-Latin keyboards). All keyboard shortcuts now trigger based on the [command layout](https://zed.dev/docs/key-bindings#non-qwerty-keyboards) of your keyboard. This fixes `ctrl-a` on a Cyrillic keyboard, and allows you to use Vim's normal mode on an IME-based keyboard like Japanese.
- macOS: Key repeat is now always enabled in the Terminal. This disables the character picker that typically shows up when you hold down a key. This was previously enabled only on a best-effort basis.
- Linux: Use `ctrl-right` instead of `cmd-right` as the default for `editor::AcceptPartialInlineCompletion` ([#20443](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20443)).

## v0.161.1 — 2024-11-13

🍂🎉 We squashed some bugs during last week's Quality Week, and half of these fixes have made their way into this week's stable release! 🐛🐞🐜 + 🔨💥 = 😵⚰️!

## Enhancements

### General

- Added scrollbar to info popovers in editor ([#20184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20184)).
- Added auto-scrolling to project panel when a vertical edge of a panel is hovered with a dragged entry ([#20207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20207)).
- Added option to dim inactive panes ([#18968](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18968); thanks [aexvir](https://github.com/aexvir)).
- Added option to highlight active pane with a border ([#18968](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18968); thanks [aexvir](https://github.com/aexvir)).
- Added `auto_indent_on_paste` setting, which can be used on a per-language basis, to configure whether indentation should be adjusted when pasting. This setting is enabled by default for languages other than YAML and Markdown ([#20193](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20193)).
- Added a new reveal option for tasks: `"no_focus"`. If used, the tasks terminal panel will be opened and shown, but not focused ([#19901](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19901)).
- Added a new `editor: spawn nearest task` action that spawns the task with a run indicator icon nearest to the cursor. It can be configured to also use a `reveal` strategy ([#19901](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19901)).

```json
{
  "context": "EmptyPane || SharedScreen || vim_mode == normal",
  "bindings": {
    ", r t": ["editor::SpawnNearestTask", { "reveal": "no_focus" }],
  }
}
```

- Improved editor performance with large # of diagnostics ([#20189](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20189)).
- Improved sort order in completions to show relevant matches first ([#20145](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20145); thanks [80avin](https://github.com/80avin)).
- Improved project search functionality by reusing the query from the focused buffer's local search ([#20253](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20253)).
- Improved large project search performance ([#20211](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20211)).
- Improved `workspace::SendKeystrokes` to support re-binding keys. For example you can now do: `"x": ["workspace::SendKeystrokes", "\" _ x"]` in vim mode to ensure that `x` does not clobber your clipboard ([#20277](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20277)).
- Improved outline panel keyboard navigation ([#20385](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20385)).
- Updated the settings schema to allow `null` as a value for optional settings instead of showing a warning ([#20192](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20192)).
- Added `debug: open theme preview` action to the command palette to preview the current theme's styles ([#20039](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20039)).
- Added optional `ignore_indent` parameter to `editor::ToggleComments` to place comment characters at the left margin. You can make this the default by adding `"ctrl-/": ["editor::ToggleComments", { "ignore_indent": true }]` to your keymap.json in the `Editor` context ([#19746](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19746); thanks [NichtJens](https://github.com/NichtJens)).
- Added `debug: Open Key Context View` action to command palette to help debug custom key bindings ([#19872](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19872)).
- Added scrollbars to outline panel ([#19969](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19969)).
- Added `\u2028` and `\u2029` as invisible characters. Previously these were treated as `\n` ([#19712](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19712)).
- Markdown Preview: Added button to copy code blocks ([#19312](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19312); thanks [Irilith](https://github.com/Irilith)).
- Markdown Preview: Added detection to update when file was changed outside of the editor ([#20175](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20175)).
- Disabled REPL buttons and actions for remote projects and collaboration ([#20397](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20397)).


### AI

- Improved memory footprint for inline transformations ([#20296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20296)).
- Moved the text selection action to a slash command (`/selection`) in the assistant panel ([#19988](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19988); thanks [marechaux](https://github.com/marechaux)).
- Diagnostics are no longer automatically attached as context to `/tab`, `/file` slash commands in the Assistant Panel. Use `/diagnostics` to include them if desired ([#20297](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20297)).

### SSH Remoting

- Improved latency of connecting ([#20220](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20220)).
- Improved keyboard navigation in SSH modal ([#19894](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19894)).
- Fixed duplicated SSH Remote Projects ([#20271](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20271); thanks [AidanV](https://github.com/AidanV)).

### Languages

- Added support for autoclosing braces `{}` and single quotes `''` in Shell Scripts ([#20278](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20278)).
- Added support for git worktrees. Zed can now open git worktrees and the git status in them is correctly handled ([#20164](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20164)).
- Go: Improved `go test ./...` and `go generate ./...` commands to run in the go module directory rather than the current package directory ([#20190](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20190); thanks [rpadaki](https://github.com/rpadaki)).
- Go: Added runnable and tasks for `go generate` commands ([#19987](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19987); thanks [rpadaki](https://github.com/rpadaki)).

### Vim

- Added `r`  and `a` as aliases for `[` and `<` text objects (copying vim-surround) ([#20104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20104); thanks [mike-lloyd03](https://github.com/mike-lloyd03)).
- Added :noh[lsearch] ([#20056](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20056)).
- Added `ctrl-v`/`ctrl-q` to type any unicode code point. For example `ctrl-v escape` inserts an escape character(U+001B), or `ctrl-v u 1 0 E 2` types ტ (U+10E2). As in vim `ctrl-v ctrl-j` inserts U+0000 not U+000A. Zed does not yet implement insertion of the vim-specific representation of the typed keystroke for other keystrokes ([#19585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19585)).
- Added `ctrl-shift-v` as an alias for paste on Linux ([#19585](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19585)).
- Extended `ctrl-w` to work in non-editor contexts. E.g. markdown preview and screen shares ([#20058](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20058)).
- Fixed `r`, `~` etc. appearing to modify readonly buffers ([#20264](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20264)).
- Fixed some shortcuts to render correctly in Command ([#20254](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20254)).
- Fixed `q` and `@` in visual mode ([#20261](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20261)).
- Fixed paragraph object in the presence of softwrap ([#20259](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20259)).
- Fixed search in the assistant panel ([#20258](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20258)).
- Fixed `d G` in not deleting until the actual end of the document if soft-wrap is turned on ([#20160](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20160)).

- Fixed `gu$` missing last character of the line ([#20057](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20057)).
- Fixed surrounds to allow `b`/`B`/`r`/`a` anywhere you could use `(`, `{`, `[`, `<` ([#20104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/20104); thanks [mike-lloyd03](https://github.com/mike-lloyd03)).

## v0.160.7 — 2024-11-06

## Enhancements

### General

- Added support for new models with GitHub Copilot Chat (OpenAI o1-mini, o1-preview; Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet ([#19968](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19968))).
- Added support for `zed://ssh/<connection>/<path>` ([#19970](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19970)).
- Added support to show invisible characters in the editor ([#19846](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19846)).
- Added support for self-hosted GitLab instances when generating Git permalinks ([#19909](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19909)).
  - The instance URL must have `gitlab` somewhere in the host in order to be recognized.
- Added feature to show commit summary as part of the inline Git blame ([#19759](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19759); thanks [pjtatlow](https://github.com/pjtatlow)).
- Improved the parsing of Git remote URLs to support additional scenarios ([#19924](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19924)).

### AI

- Added "Suggest Edit" button to the assistant panel if `"enable_experimental_live_diffs": true` is set in the `"assistant"` section of `settings.json` ([#19900](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19900)). This button takes the place of the previous `/workflow` command, but it is experimental and may change!

## v0.159.5 — 2024-10-30

## Enhancements

Today we're excited to launch Zed SSH Remoting in Beta. 💻🌐🎉

For remote hosts, we support macOS remotes (both Intel x86_64 and ARM aarch64) and Linux on x86_64 or ARM: Ubuntu 20/22/24, Raspbian, Debian 11/12, Fedora 40/41/42, ArchLinux, Alpine, NixOS, SUSE/OpenSUSE as well as RedHat 8.x/9.x, and clones (Rocky Linux, CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux, Amazon Linux, Oracle Linux).

Blog Post: https://zed.dev/blog/remote-development
Docs: https://zed.dev/docs/remote-development

Note: The original version of remote development sent traffic via Zed's servers. As of Zed v0.157, you can no longer use that mode.

### General

- Added file icons for Gleam ([#19887](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19887); thanks [okkdev](https://github.com/okkdev)), Zig, Julia, SCSS, HCL, Nix, and Roc files.
- Added the ability to fold all blocks of code at a target "level." macOS: `cmd-k, cmd-<number>`, Linux: `ctrl-k, ctrl-<number>` ([#19750](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19750)).
- Added indent guides to the project and outline panel ([#18260](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18260), ([#19719](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19719))).
- Added macOS Services menu (fixed global macOS shortcuts) ([#16959](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16959)).
- Added support for detecting images with non-lowercase file extensions ([#19304](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19304)).
- Added a user-visible error message when a manual save fails ([#19311](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19311)).
- Added toolchain selector to the status bar with initial support for Rust and Python ([#19576](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19576)).
- Added ability to cancel language server work in remote development ([#19946](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19946)).
- Improved [re]open for external worktree entries ([#19612](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19612)).

### AI

- Improved Inline Assistant placeholder text. Including focus context panel and navigate history key bindings ([#19447](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19447)).
- Improved prompt for generating context editor summaries ([#19530](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19530); thanks [wolffiex](https://github.com/wolffiex)).
- Moved Git hunk controls to the right of the header ([#19515](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19515)).

### Languages

- Added keybindings for applying hunks in Proposed Changes: `cmd-shift-y` / `ctrl-shift-y` ([#19749](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19749)).
- Added autoclosing of Rust multiline strings ([#19765](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19765)).
- Added `.editorconfig` support ([#19455](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19455)).
- Registered `.postcss` files as CSS ([#19416](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19416)).

### Vim

- Added support for incrementing and decrementing numbers with leading zeros in Vim mode ([#18362](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18362); thanks [ThomAub](https://github.com/ThomAub)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed incorrect checkbox placement in Markdown preview ([#19383](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19383); thanks [zfz7](https://github.com/zfz7)).
- Fixed Markdown preview rendering of empty list items ([#19449](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19449); thanks [mgsloan](https://github.com/mgsloan)).

## v0.158.1 — 2024-10-23

## Enhancements

### General

- Added the ability to click intermediate auto-folded project panel entries ([#18956](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18956)).
- Added a new `editor: format selections` action that allows formatting only the currently selected text via the primary language server ([#18752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18752); thanks [terziele](https://github.com/terziele)).
- Added an `editor: reload file` command ([#18395](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18395); thanks [schpet](https://github.com/schpet)).
- Improved performance on macOS when working with very long lines ([#19215](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19215)).
- Adjusted the divider rule in LSP hovers to be more muted ([#19255](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19255); thanks [dyedgreen](https://github.com/dyedgreen)).
- Switched to using the system locale in the terminal instead of forcing `en_US.UTF-8` ([#18967](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18967); thanks [shish](https://github.com/shish)).
- Improved Supermaven completions by preventing suggestions based on outdated cursor positions ([#18858](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18858); thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).

### Languages

- Improved language auto-detection of TypeScript, JavaScript, and shell scripts. Added shebang detection for ts-node, tsx, bun, Deno JS, Deno TS, dash, and ash ([#19114](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19114)).
- Improved automatic indentation behavior in JSX ([#18816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18816); thanks [schpet](https://github.com/schpet)).

### Vim

- Added basic support for Alacritty's [vi mode](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/master/docs/features.md#vi-mode) to the built-in terminal (which is using Alacritty under the hood). Vi mode can be activated with `ctrl-shift-space`, enabling basic motions to navigate the terminal's scrollback buffer ([#18715](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18715); thanks [NukaCody](https://github.com/NukaCody)).
- Added support for using the insert button to activate vim mode ([#19245](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19245); thanks [axelcarl](https://github.com/axelcarl)).
- Added `:e[dit]`, `:e[dit]!`, which call the `editor: reload file` command ([#18395](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18395); thanks [schpet](https://github.com/schpet)).
- Added `z` keybindings for scrolling ([#18928](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18928); thanks [syndesis](https://github.com/syndesis)).
- Changed `/` in Vim mode to always reset the search options in the search bar back to regex-only. That means using `*` (in normal or visual mode) still works with its options, but the next `/` will reset the search options. That makes it much closer to how `/` behaves in Vim ([#19058](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19058)).
- Improved vim mode's whole word match by using the search bar's "Match whole words" option, instead of wrapping the search term with `\<...\>`. This allows easier toggling of whole-word search, and it also works without enabling the regex mode ([#18725](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18725); thanks [osa1](https://github.com/osa1)).
- Added a `regex` option to `vim::Search` command to allow disabling regex search by default in the keymap ([#19177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/19177); thanks [osa1](https://github.com/osa1)).

Example usage:
```yaml
{
  "context": "VimControl && !menu",
  "bindings": {
    "/": ["vim::Search", { "regex": false }],
  }
}
```

### Languages

- Added runnables for main functions in C ([#18720](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18720); thanks [talal](https://github.com/talal)).

Example task configuration:

```json
[
  {
    "label": "Run ${ZED_STEM}",
    "command": "gcc",
    "args": [
      "$ZED_FILE",
      "-o",
      "${ZED_DIRNAME}/${ZED_STEM}.out",
      "&&",
      "${ZED_DIRNAME}/${ZED_STEM}.out"
    ],
    "tags": ["c-main"]
  }
]
```

### Vim

- Added `regex` and `caseSensitive` arguments to `vim::MoveToNext` and `vim ::MoveToPrev` commands, for toggling regex and case sensitive search ([#18429](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18429); thanks [osa1](https://github.com/osa1)).

Example:

```json
{
  "context": "VimControl && !menu",
  "bindings": {
    "*": ["vim::MoveToNext", { "regex": false, "caseSensitive": false }],
    "#": ["vim::MoveToPrev", { "regex": false, "caseSensitive": false }]
  }
}
```

- Assistant: Fixed copy/cut/paste not working in the assistant panel when selection was empty ([#18403](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18403)).
- Fixed `Reveal in Finder/File Manager`, `Copy Path`, `Copy Relative Path` and `Copy file location` actions not working with multibuffers ([#18626](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18626)).
- Fixed the behavior of `{"terminal": {"blinking": "[on|off|terminal_controlled]"}` to work correctly and to work correctly when custom `cursor_shape` is set ([#18538](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18538)).
  - `terminal.cursor_shape` only controls the *default* shape of the terminal, not the blinking.
  - `terminal.blinking = on` means that it's *always* blinking, regardless of what terminal programs want
  - `terminal.blinking = off` means that it's *never* blinking, regardless of what terminal programs want
  - `terminal.blinking = terminal_controlled (default)` means that it's blinking depending on what terminal programs want. when a terminal program resets the cursor to default, it sets it back to `terminal.cursor_shape` if that is set.
- Fixed the environment not loading if `direnv` mode is set to `direct` and `.envrc` is not allowed ([#18473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18473); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Fixed task indicators not showing up at the starts of folds ([#18526](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18526)).
- Fixed a bug where `go to definition` would scroll the editor even when the definition was already within the viewport ([#18441](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18441); thanks [osa1](https://github.com/osa1)).
- Fixed an bug where some tooltips would not show up ([#18435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18435)).
- Fixed `low_speed_timeout_in_seconds` for Ollama ([#18417](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18417)).
- Fixed a slight gutter flicker when going over 999 lines ([#18021](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18021); thanks [galenelias](https://github.com/galenelias)).
- Fixed `use_on_type_format` setting not working when defined inside `"languages"` in the settings. This change will now change the default behavior for C, C++, and Markdown, by turning language server's `OnTypeFormatting` completions off by default ([#18387](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18387)).
- Fixed the cursor shape in the editor not changing back to default when `{"cursor_shape": "..."}` setting is removed. This does not apply to Vim mode ([#18379](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18379)).
- Fixed sending `alt-enter` in terminal ([#18363](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18363)).
- Fixed overriding the path of a language server binary for all language servers. `{"lsp":{"<lsp-name>":{"binary":{"path": "_"}}}}` will now work for all language servers including those defined by extensions ([#18318](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18318)).
- Removed confusing soft wrap option behavior ([#18412](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18412)).
- Removed automatic reinstallation of language servers ([#18318](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18318)). (It mostly didn't work)
- SSH Remote: Fixed `cmd-O` to correctly open files on the remote host ([#18308](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18308)).
- Linux: Fixed some cases where Linux X11 mouse scrolling didn't work at all ([#18484](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18484); thanks [mgsloan](https://github.com/mgsloan)).
- Linux: Fixed handling of switching between Linux X11 devices used for scrolling ([#18484](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18484); thanks [mgsloan](https://github.com/mgsloan)).
- Linux: Fixed a bug where middle mouse clicks could be interpreted as left or right mouse clicks ([#18504](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18504); thanks [mycroft](https://github.com/mycroft)).
- Linux: Fixed a regression with middle-click pasting ([#18503](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18503); thanks [mycroft](https://github.com/mycroft)).
- Linux: Fixed blur region on Plasma/Wayland ([#18465](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18465); thanks [jansol](https://github.com/jansol)).
- Vim: Fixed cursor position after `:{range}yank` ([#18424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18424)).
- Vim: Fixed register selection in visual yank ([#18418](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18418)).

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Protocol Buffers language support: Renamed "proto" language to "Proto". This is a breaking change and requires users adjust their settings accordingly from `proto` to `Proto` under `file_types` and `languages` ([#18559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18559)).
- To disable finding lsp adapters in your path, you must now specify `{"lsp":{"<lsp-name>":{"binary":{"ignore_system_version": true}}}}` ([#18318](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18318)). Previously this was `{"lsp":{"<lsp-name>":{"binary":{"path_lookup": false}}}}`. Note that this setting still does not apply to extensions.

- SSH remoting: Removed "reveal in finder" option from menu ([#18306](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18306)).

- Fixed a bug where Python import names were highlighted as types ([#17984](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17984); thanks [verhovsky](https://github.com/verhovsky)).
- Fixed running ESLint offline ([#18286](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18286)).
- Fixed a panic when graphemes are included in supermaven completions ([#18279](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18279); thanks [s3bba](https://github.com/s3bba)).

## Breaking Changes

- Zed will now use the node installed on your $PATH (if it is more recent than v18) instead of downloading its own. You can disable the new behavior with `{"node": {"disable_path_lookup": true}}` in your settings. We do not yet use system/project-local node_modules ([#18172](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18172)).


## v0.154.4 — 2024-10-01

## Bug fixes

- Linux: Fixed Ubuntu 20.04 compatibility on x86_64. This regression occurred in Zed Stable [v0.153.6](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/releases/tag/v0.153.6) and Zed Preview [0.154.0-pre](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/releases/tag/v0.154.0-pre) and was unintentional. Glibc requirement on x86_64 linux is glibc >= 2.31 as it was prior to those releases.  Impacted users will have to [reinstall zed](https://zed.dev/linux). ([PR #18442](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18442)).

## v0.154.1 — 2024-09-25

## Enhancements

### General

- Added file icons to the tab switcher. Enable with by adding `"tabs": {"file_icons": true}` to settings
 ([#17115](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17115); thanks [Daste745](https://github.com/Daste745)).
- Added an `editor: rewrap` command for rewrapping text to the maximum line width ([#17909](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17909)).
- Added the ability to copy surrounding code blocks in the assistant panel into the clipboard, or inserting them directly into the editor, without manually selecting. Place cursor anywhere in a code block (marked by triple backticks) and use the `assistant::CopyCode` action (`cmd-k c` / `ctrl-k c`) to copy to the clipboard, or the `assistant::InsertIntoEditor` action (`cmd-<` / `ctrl-<`) to insert into editor ([#17853](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17853); thanks [thataboy](https://github.com/thataboy)).
- Added ability to click on filepaths when using `git diff` inside the built-in terminal ([#17446](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17446); thanks [watsoncj](https://github.com/watsoncj)).
- Added theme styling option to separate terminal background view from terminal background color, for transparent terminal backgrounds ([#17611](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17611); thanks [AlbertMarashi](https://github.com/AlbertMarashi)).
- Added keyboard shortcut to rearrange tabs (left: `ctrl-shift-pageup`, right: `ctrl-shift-pagedown`) like Chrome ([#15583](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15583); thanks [tepek2](https://github.com/tepek2)).
- Added a way to join all panes into one with `pane::JoinAll` action ([#17673](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17673)).
- Added a setting for `cursor_shape`. Can be `bar`, `block`, `underline`, or `hollow`. Default is `bar` ([#17572](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17572); thanks [thataboy](https://github.com/thataboy)).
- Added an `inlay_hints.show_background` setting to allow displaying backgrounds for inlay hints in the editor ([#18010](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18010)).
  - This setting defaults to `false`.
  - If enabled, the inlay hint backgrounds will use the `hint.background` color from the theme.
- Added access to the local shell environment for task context providers, enabling local Rust tool installations to function ([#17964](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17964); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Improved underline appearance ([#17586](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17586); thanks [ncor](https://github.com/ncor)).
- Persisted tab pin state across Zed runs ([#17670](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17670)).
- Changed documentation popovers to render Markdown prose using the UI font instead of the buffer font. Code blocks still using the buffer font ([#17761](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17761)).
- Improved the behavior of `editor: rewrap` when working with a selection that contained comments at different indentation levels ([#18146](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18146)).
- Improved the `auto update: view release notes locally` feature by displaying release notes for each patch version associated with the installed minor version ([#18108](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18108)).
- Improved welcome page design and added additional links ([#17874](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17874)).
- Enabled dark mode for documentation ([#17940](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17940)).
- Changed `ui_font_size` and `buffer_font_size` to require values to be between 6px and 100px (inclusive) ([#17829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17829)).
- Changed `tab_size` setting to require values be between 1 and 16 (inclusive) ([#17882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17882); thanks [ihavecoke](https://github.com/ihavecoke)).

### SSH Remoting

- Added support for booting language servers (in limited circumstances) ([#17655](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17655)).
- Settings files are now opened in a non-remote window ([#18020](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/18020)).
- Show LSP status in status bar ([#17912](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17912)).
- Look up language server binaries in the environment on SSH host ([#17658](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17658)).

### Languages

- Improved C syntax highlighting ([#17541](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17541); thanks [krizej](https://github.com/krizej)).
- Improved C++ syntax highlighting ([#17471](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17471); thanks [VacheDesNeiges](https://github.com/VacheDesNeiges)).
- Changed built-in language support (Rust, Go, C, YAML, ...) to lookup language-server specific settings locally in project directory first before falling back to global value ([#17753](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17753)).
- Changed `rust-analyzer` support to look up `rust-analyzer` binaries by default in `$PATH`. That changes the default value to something users requested ([#17926](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17926)).
- Improved highlighting for property names in CSS ([#17324](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17324)).

### Vim

- Improved edge-case handling for `ctrl-a`/`ctrl-x` ([#17644](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17644); thanks [hekmyr](https://github.com/hekmyr)).
- When using `OpenFile` (`gf` in Vim mode) and the word under the cursor is not an existing file path, we now fall back and additionally check whether a file called `<word-under-cursor>.<language-specific-path-suffixes>` exists. That's similar to Vim's `suffixesadd` option ([#17805](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17805)).

### AI

- Added a new `/delta` command to re-insert changed files that were previously included in a context ([#17903](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17903)).
- Added support for OpenAI o1-mini and o1-preview models ([#17796](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17796)).
- Added support for fill-in-the-middle style inline completions ([#17578](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17578); thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).
- Added support for specifying keep_alive for Ollama AI models via settings ([#17906](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17906)).
- Changed default `low_speed_timeout_in_seconds` option to `600` for OpenAI provider to accommodate recent o1 model release ([#17804](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17804)).

## v0.152.4 — 2024-09-16
