## v0.152.3 — 2024-09-10

## Enhancements

### General

- Added ability to perform project search only in opened files ([#16580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16580); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823)).
- REPL: Added a readonly buffer for viewing large outputs ([#17121](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17121)).

![REPL: Added a readonly buffer for viewing large outputs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4f26e3b8-f33d-4e65-b460-b49596fe81bb)

- REPL: Added button to open full text output in a separate buffer ([#16971](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16971)).

- Improved the Zed CLI `zed` to pass along the environment as it was on the CLI to the opened Zed project. That environment is then used when opening new terminals, spawning tasks, or language servers ([#17075](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17075)). Specifically:
  - If Zed was started via `zed my-folder`, a terminal spawned with `workspace: new terminal` will inherit these environment variables that existed on the CLI
  - Specific language servers that allow looking up the language server binary in the environments `$PATH` (such as `gopls`, `zls`, `rust-analyzer` if configured, ...) will look up the language server binary in the CLI environment too and use that environment when starting the process.
  - Language servers that are _not_ found in the CLI environment (or configured to not be found in there), will be spawned with the CLI environment in case that's set. That means users can do something like `RA_LOG=info zed .` and it will be picked up by the rust-analyzer that was spawned.
  - Check the demo [here](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/455905cc-8b7c-4fc4-b98a-7e027d97cdfa).
- Added multiuser support for up to 100 users on the same machine ([#14143](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14143); thanks [samsonjs](https://github.com/samsonjs)).
- Linux: Added an editor setting to toggle middle-click pasting (enabled by default) ([#16572](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16572); thanks [micahscopes](https://github.com/micahscopes)).
- Linux: Improved GPU detection ([#17022](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17022)).

### Languages

- Added `@variable.parameter` highlight scope for Rust ([#16747](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16747), [#17097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17097); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone)).

![parameters are colored pink](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/68920017-b191-4779-9aa6-856831938480)

- Added `@attribute` highlight scope for Rust ([#16747](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16747), [#17097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17097); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone)).

![attributes are colored yellow](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/558d6ce0-5e4c-4ecb-893c-bc8f88d63829)

- Improved Rust syntax highlighting queries ([#17097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17097); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone)).
- Improved syntax highlighting of Rust methods in completions menu ([#17184](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17184)).
- Improved language server reliability in multi-worktree projects and monorepo. We now notify the language server more reliably about which files have changed ([#17173](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17173)).

### Performance

- Improved editor performance in presence of many runnable indicators in the gutter ([#17250](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17250)).
- Improved outline panel performance ([#17183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17183)).

### AI

- Added a way to accept terminal inline assist suggestions without executing them ([#17299](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17299)).
- Improved Assistant Configuration to make links clickable ([#17011](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17011)).
- Improved UX of tab slash command completions ([#17296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17296)).
- Added support for argument completions for context server prompts. These show up as regular completions to slash commands ([#17085](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17085); thanks [dsp-ant](https://github.com/dsp-ant)).
- Added ability for context servers to provide optional descriptions in `prompts/get` responses, displayed as slash command labels ([#17077](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17077); thanks [dsp-ant](https://github.com/dsp-ant)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed outline panel filter not working for certain Vim bindings ([#17293](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17293); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823)).
- Fixed inlay hints not being enabled for JavaScript when using the vtsls language server ([#17334](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17334); thanks [matubu](https://github.com/matubu)).
- Fixed an issue where the inline assist would be dismissed even when instructed to regenerate the transformation after an error ([#17301](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17301)).
- Fixed a bug where "Paste" wasn't always shown in project panel context menu ([#17262](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17262)).
- Assistant: Fixed `New Context` opening a new file when focused in the editor pane ([#17106](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17106); thanks [ramipellumbi](https://github.com/ramipellumbi)).
- Fixed GPT-4 breakage (incorrect `max_output_tokens` handling) ([#17168](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17168)).
- Fixed a bug where save replaced the existing open file, using the new pane to replace the old pane ([#17123](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17123); thanks [CharlesChen0823](https://github.com/CharlesChen0823)).
- Fixed a bug where inline completions (Copilot or Supermaven) were showing up in Vim's normal mode ([#17154](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17154)).
- Fixed an issue where `workspace::ActivatePaneInDirection` could not activate the center pane (i.e. one couldn't navigate from terminal or assistant panel to the center pane) after loading Zed ([#17140](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17140)).
- Fixed an issue where context servers returning a carriage return character would result in a panic ([#17112](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17112); thanks [dsp-ant](https://github.com/dsp-ant)).
- Fixed a panic opening a file in ~/ with `use_system_prompts: false` ([#17027](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17027)).
- Fixed an issue with dangling disk images during macOS auto-updates by implementing automatic unmounting ([#17019](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17019); thanks [vitallium](https://github.com/vitallium)).
- Fixed an issue where toggling inline completions in a markdown file did not work correctly ([#17104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17104)).
- Fixed Go tests not being able to run in case the package (and the `go.mod`) was in a nested folder ([#17108](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17108); thanks [glaudiston](https://github.com/glaudiston)). Pre-defined Go tasks now run in the package's directory. That means `go test ./package -run MyTest` will run in `./package` and execute `go test -run MyTest`. Also, `go test ./...` will run in the package directory, not at the root of the Zed project, which is a small breaking change. In case one wants to run `go test ./...` from the root, one can spawn a manual task that does this.
- Linux: Fixed the prompt library not closing on Wayland ([#16850](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16850); thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).
- Linux: Fixed copy/paste shortcuts in context menus ([#17103](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17103)).
- Linux: Zed will no longer be marked as the default file browser ([#16940](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16940); thanks [valaphee](https://github.com/valaphee)).
- Linux: ARM binaries now require glibc >= 2.35; was >= 2.29 ([#17643](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/17643)).

## v0.149.3 — 2024-08-20

Introducing Zed AI! Our new hosted service that brings advanced AI-assisted coding directly into Zed.

For more information on Zed AI, read our [in-depth blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/zed-ai) and see the [assistant documentation](https://zed.dev/docs/assistant/assistant) on our revamped website.

## Enhancements

### General

- Added syntax highlighting for tagged template literals in `javascript`, `typescript` and `tsx` languages for `css`, `html`, `js`, `json`, `sql`, `ts`, `yaml` and `yml` ([#15984](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15984); thanks [RobinMalfait](https://github.com/RobinMalfait)).
- Added support for recognizing CUDA files as C++ ([#16098](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16098); thanks [Athishpranav2003](https://github.com/Athishpranav2003)).
- Added an `editor::ScrollCursorCenterTopBottom` action for toggling scroll position with a single key binding ([#16134](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16134)).
- Added an `editor::HandleInput` action to ease typing symbols that are part of keymaps. E.g. if `, o k` key binding is bound, `", ,": ["editor::HandleInput", ","]` would allow to type `,` without timeouts ([#16131](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16131)).
- Improved behavior of `ctrl-a` and `ctrl-e` on macOS ([#15981](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15981)).
- Added fallback to a smallest tree sitter node when hovering over a symbol ([#16062](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16062); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Improved MimeType list in XDG .desktop file ([#15623](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15623); thanks [rudolfkastl](https://github.com/rudolfkastl)).
- Added a popup that is displayed when the keymap is invalid ([#15977](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15977)).
- REPL: Improved visuals of repl stdout/stderr by reducing default line count to 32 ([#16061](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16061)).
- Added `performance.show_in_status_bar: true` setting (macOS-only) to show the time to the first window draw and FPS ([#16422](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16422)).

### AI

- Added support to allow for pasting images into the Assistant Panel to include them as context. Currently works only on macOS, and with Anthropic models. Future support is planned for more models, operating systems, and image clipboard operations ([#15782](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15782)).
- Added a count of the context tokens when hovering token counts in the inline assist ([#16147](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16147)).
- Zed now allows the model to control indentation when performing inline transformation. We're hoping this improves the indentation experience in Python and other indentation-sensitive languages, but it does require more from the model ([#16145](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16145)).
- Added more context when using `assistant: Quote selection` to insert text into the assistant panel ([#16038](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16038)).
- Assistant workflow steps can now be applied and reverted directly from within the assistant panel ([#15936](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15936)).
- Added UI affordances to the assistant panel to show which messages have been cached ([#16395](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16395); thanks [rowillia](https://github.com/rowillia)).
- Migrated cache invalidation to be based on `has_edits_since_in_range` to be smarter and more selective about when to invalidate the cache and when to fetch ([#16395](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16395); thanks [rowillia](https://github.com/rowillia)).
- Added support for 8192 output tokens from Claude Sonnet 3.5 ([#16358](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16358); thanks [rowillia](https://github.com/rowillia)).
- Improved conformance with Anthropic Images in Chat Completions API ([#16270](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16270)).
- Reduced instances of over-generation when inserting docs or annotations above a symbol ([#16333](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16333)).
- Added support for Prompt Caching in Anthropic. For models that support it this can dramatically lower cost while improving performance ([#16274](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16274); thanks [rowillia](https://github.com/rowillia)).
- Workflows can now create new files in folders that didn't exist ([#16251](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16251)).
- Added support for GPT-4o for Copilot Chat ([#16446](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16446); thanks [Hawkbawk](https://github.com/Hawkbawk)).
- Updated inline assist icon in the editor & terminal ([#16363](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16363)).

### Vim

- Vim: Added support for range syntax in command ([#15985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15985)).
- Vim: Prefill command with `:'<,'>` from visual mode ([#15985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15985)).

- Fixed an issue where the markdown preview button would not show up for some markdown files ([#15961](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15961)).
- repl: Fixed scaling of stdout/stderr line heights ([#16308](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16308)).
- Restored the ability to toggle the model selector in the Assistant via a keybinding (Preview only) ([#16319](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16319)).

## v0.148.1 — 2024-08-15

## Bug Fixes

## v0.148.0 — 2024-08-14

## Enhancements

### General

- Added a popup that is displayed when the settings are invalid.
- Added menu items to quickly switch between Supermaven and Copilot inline completions when the provider is not configured (thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).
- Added tool calling capabilities to OpenAI and Ollama models.
- Improved streaming git diffs to be less jumpy during inline assistant generation.
- Templates for prompts driving inline transformation in editors and the terminal can now be overridden in the `~/.config/zed/prompts/templates` directory. This is an advanced feature, and prevents you from getting upstream changes. It's intended for use by Zed developers.
- Added an `editor: go to declaration` editor action (thanks [coszio](https://github.com/coszio)).
- Linux: Changed the fallback color of `title_bar.inactive_background` to a non-transparent value.

### REPL

- Added additional context about available kernel sessions.
- Added `update_display_data` support for REPL.
    - See the [video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d618e457-e314-482e-954a-6384f185629a
)!
- Added logging in debug mode of raw kernel output from REPL.
- Added `ctrl-alt-enter` keybinding for `repl::RunInPlace` (`ctrl-option-enter` on MacOS). This keeps your screen position and cursor in place when running any block.
- Added markdown rendering for Jupyter/REPL outputs. Push Markdown from Deno/Typescript with `Deno.jupyter.md` and in IPython use `IPython.display.Markdown`.

### Languages

- Improved Rust test detection to work for attributes containing `test` substring ([#15580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/discussions/15580); thanks [MayankJikadara](https://github.com/MayankJikadara)).
- VTSLS will now use the local instance if there's one on PATH ([#4978](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4978); thanks [kakoc](https://github.com/kakoc)).
- The ordering of language servers will now respect the order in the `language_servers` setting. The first language server in this list will be used as the primary language server.

### Vim

- Vim: Breaking change to keybindings after the introduction of the `editor: go to declaration` editor action. The new keybindings are the following (and can be found [here](https://zed.dev/docs/vim), alongside the other key bindings) (thanks [coszio](https://github.com/coszio)):
    - `g d` - Go to definition
    - `g D` - Go to declaration
    - `g y` - Go to type definition
    - `g I` - Go to implementation

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the terminal inline assistant would not appear when opening a terminal in the center pane ([#15729](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15729)).
- REPL: Fixed plain text output wrapping around and covering editor text ([#15491](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15491), [#14855](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14855)).
- REPL: Fixed bug in kernelspec launch choosing first available kernel matching the language rather than selected name.
- REPL: Fixed kernels not being shut down completely on close of Editor.
- REPL: Fixed ANSI escape code and carriage return handling in repl outputs ([#15640](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15640), [#14855](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14855)).
- Fixed poor performance when editing in the assistant panel after inserting large files using slash commands.
- Fixed a bug where a closed workspace could be reopened on startup (thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).
- Linux: Fixed Zed flickering when using Intel graphics ([#14101](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14101); thanks [Jaakkonen](https://github.com/Jaakkonen)).
- Linux: Fixed prompts not being navigable by arrow keys ([#15151](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15151); thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).
- Linux: Fixed visual glitches when rendering icons ([#12352](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12352); thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).
- Linux: Fixed last workspace not being restored on startup ([#15642](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15642); thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).

## v0.147.2 — 2024-08-07

## Enhancements

### General

- Added GitHub Copilot Chat support ([#4673](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4673); thanks [Hawkbawk](https://github.com/hawkback)).

![A screenshot showing a conversation between a user and GitHub Copilot Chat within the Zed editor](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/73eaf6a2-792b-4c40-a7fe-f763bd6417d7)

Once you've signed into GitHub Copilot within Zed, Copilot Chat should be available as an option in the model dropdown in the assistant.

![Copilot Chat model option](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ca3a38c-2d42-4fe7-8e65-a839a3ff3207)

- Added double-click to create a new file when clicking on blank space in the project panel ([#15353](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15353); thanks [ssut](https://github.com/ssut)).
- Added support for tab switcher in Assistant panel ([#15475](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15475)).
- Use `ctrl-enter` to summon the inline assistant in the terminal, which lets you generate terminal commands based on your description.
    - Check out the [demo](https://twitter.com/thorstenball/status/1814241447383605329).
- Improved restoring of windows across restarts: the order of the windows is now also restored. That means windows that were in the foreground when Zed was quit will be in the foreground after restart. Supported on MacOS and Linux/X11, not yet on Linux/Wayland ([#15419](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15419)).
    - Check out the video [video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b8162f8-f06d-43df-88d3-c45d8460fb68)!
- Added the ability to select and copy text from diagnostic popovers ([#12695](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12695); thanks [effdotsh](https://github.com/effdotsh)).
- Added support for font fallbacks via three new settings: `ui_font_fallbacks`, `buffer_font_fallbacks`, and `terminal.font_fallbacks` ([#5180](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5180), [#5055](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5055)).
- Changed the project panel to auto fold directories by default.
- Linux/X11: Support for keyboard layout hot plugging ([#15059](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15059); thanks [XDeme1](https://github.com/XDeme1)).
- Unsaved files that are restored when Zed starts are now marked as having a conflict if they have been changed on disk since the last time they were stored ([#15207](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15207)).
- Updated tree-sitter parsers for core languages ([#4565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4565)).
- Improved performance when computing indent guides for buffers with extremely long lines ([#15167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15167)).
- Improved performance of project and buffer search when there are many matches ([#15102](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15102)).
- Added an option to copy the file's absolute path from within the tab context menu ([#13970](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13970); thanks [HarshNarayanJha](https://github.com/HarshNarayanJha)).
- Improved the environment-variable detection when running tasks so that tasks can now access environment variables as if the task had been spawned in a terminal that `cd`ed into a project directory. That means environment variables set by `direnv`/`asdf`/`mise` and other tools are now picked up ([#12125](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12125)).
  - Check out the [video](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8bfcc98f-0f9b-4439-b0d9-298aef1a3efe)!
- Added a button to preview Markdown files in the toolbar. `Option|Alt+Click` will open the preview to the side ([#15215](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15215)).

### Languages

- Rust: Added ability to style doc comments with `comment.doc` ([#15322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15322); thanks [earomc](https://github.com/earomc)).
- Improved the outline panel for Rust to include static items ([#15225](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15225)).
- Added support for language server tracing to the LSP log view.

### Remoting

- remoting alpha: Added support for terminal and tasks to new experimental ssh remoting ([#15321](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/15321)).
- remoting alpha: Removed the ability to specify `gh cs ssh` or `gcloud compute ssh` etc. See https://zed.dev/docs/remote-development for alternatives.

### Vim

- Added support for Vim digraphs ([#11871](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11871); thanks [Benjamin-Davies](https://github.com/Benjamin-Davies)).
- Added support to bind motions in insert mode.
- Added {count} for `>`/`<` in visual mode (thanks [Tobbe](https://github.com/Tobbe)).
- Fixed a hang when repeating an aborted operation ([#15399](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15399); thanks [Alextopher](https://github.com/Alextopher)).

## Bug Fixes

## v0.146.3 — 2024-07-31

## Enhancements

Zed now features a built-in REPL!

![Run Python Block by Block](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/72f43cb3-9dcd-4335-b814-48650a966f8d)

You can run code:

* Line by line
* Block by block (`# %%`)
* Any selection

View the [blog post](https://zed.dev/blog/repl) for more details.

### General

- Added ability to restore all windows that were open when Zed was quit. Previously only the last used workspace was restored. This is now the default behavior. To get back the old behavior, add the following to your settings: `{"restore_on_startup": "last_workspace"}` (Part of [#4985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4985) and [#4683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4683)).
- Added automatic restoring of unsaved buffers. Zed can now be closed even if there are unsaved changes in buffers. One current limitation is that this only works when having projects open, not single files or empty windows with unsaved buffers. The feature can be turned off by setting `{"session": {"restore_unsaved_buffers": false}}` ([#4985](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4985), [#4683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4683)).
- Added support for quickly switching between multiple language model providers in the assistant panel.
- Added the ability to create custom inline assist bindings that pre-fill a prompt from your keymap, e.g.:

```json
[
    {
        "context": "Editor && mode == full",
        "bindings": {
            "ctrl-shift-enter": [
                "assistant::InlineAssist",
                { "prompt": "Build a snake game" }
            ]
        }
    }
]
```

- Added the ability to automatically generate new summaries for assistant conversations or manually edit them.
- Added support for gpt-4o-mini ([#14769](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14769), thanks [versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe)).
- Improved the way git hunks diff can be toggled with mouse. Now, clicking on the diff marker will toggle an actions menu. Inline diffs now can be closed via the mouse, rather than just `esc` ([#12404](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12404)).
- Extended task templates with `shell` and `hide` fields to use custom shells and allow for custom close behavior.
- Allow user to configure multiple formatters for a given language: `format` and `format_on_save` now accept an array of formatting actions to run; `language_server` formatter option now accepts the name of a language server to use (e.g. `{"language_server": {"name": "ruff"}}`); when not specified, a primary language server is used ([#4822](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4822)).
- Improved SublimeText keymap (Mac & Linux). Add key binding for MoveLineUp/Down (`ctrl-shift-up` on Linux and `cmd-ctrl-up` on MacOS) ([#15089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/15089); thanks [unixtensor](https://github.com/unixtensor)).
- Added a button to copy the SHA from a Git blame entry (thanks [Hawkbawk](https://github.com/Hawkbawk)).
- Added `Copy`, `Paste`, `Select All`, & `New Terminal` to the terminal context menu (thanks [versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe)).
- Added the ability to sign out of a Supermaven account ([#12715](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12715); thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).
- Improved Supermaven status messages ([#12715](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12715); thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).
- Added `"command_aliases"` setting to let you abbreviate commands.
- Improved UX of project search.
- Added a hint the first few times you open a multibuffer to explain what is going on.
- Refined the appearance of channel tabs.
- Changed preference for GPUs on macOS so that eGPUs are now preferred over integrated ones (and both of which are preferred over discrete GPUs) on Intel Macs.

### Languages

- Added extension for [Ruff](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/), an extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust. To install Ruff extension, open the command palette, search for `zed: extensions` and then in the search bar of the extensions view type in Ruff. Once installed, you can configure `ruff` to add additional lints and provide formatting via the following setting snippet:

```json
"languages": {
    "Python": {
      "format_on_save": { "language_server": { "name": "ruff" } },
      "formatter": { "language_server": { "name": "ruff" } },
      "language_servers": ["pyright", "ruff"]
    }
}
```

- TypeScript's `tsconfig.json` files are now treated as `JSONC`.
- Added syntax highlighting for the `using` keyword in TypeScript ([#14762](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14762); thanks [versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe)).
- Added syntax highlighting to TypeScript's `infer` keyword ([#14696](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14696); thanks [rimuy](https://github.com/rimuy)).

### Vim

- Added support for count and object motion to the toggle comments action ([#14337](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14337); thanks [hahanein](https://github.com/hahanein)).
- Updated `Y` to yank to end of line (like neovim) ([#14771](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14771), thanks [vbhavsar](https://github.com/vbhavsar)).
- Fixed `jk` binding preventing you from repeating `j` ([#14725](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14725)).
- Fixed `escape` in normal mode to also clear the selected register ([#14311](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14311)).
- Fixed `gv` after `y`, `d`, etc. ([#13760](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13760)).
- Fixed right clicks changing vim mode ([#14625](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14625), thanks [Congyuwang](https://github.com/Congyuwang)).
- Fixed `assistant: quote selection` not working correctly when making visual-line-mode selections in Vim mode.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed multiline details provided by vtsls breaking rendering in autocompletions (thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Fixed a bug where diagnostic popups would flicker when moving the cursor within the boundaries of the symbol (thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Fixed a bug where the inline_assistant would overwrite tabs with spaces in some cases ([#14885](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14885); thanks [arturhoo](https://github.com/arturhoo)).
- Fixed a bug where Supermaven truncated lines when accepting inline suggestions ([#13039](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13039); thanks [kevmo314](https://github.com/kevmo314)).
- Fixed rare cases where a code action triggered by diagnostic may not be available for use.
- Fixed multi-key shortcuts not working across completion menu changes ([#11009](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11009)).
- Fixed multi-key shortcuts discarding earlier input ([#14445](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14445)).
- Fixed key maps so user-defined mappings take precedence over builtin multi-key mappings ([#13543](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13543)).
- Fixed a bug where overridden shortcuts would still show in the Command Palette.
- Fixed outline panel's filter not accepting spaces.
- Fixed a bug where backslashes would not appear in snippets ([#14721](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14721); thanks [lnay](https://github.com/lnay)).
- Fixed a bug that caused focus to be lost when renames and inline assists were scrolled offscreen.
- Fixed syntax highlights being offset from syntax in diagnostics popovers.
- Fixed worktree ordering in workspace serialization (thanks [eth0net](https://github.com/eth0net)).
- Fixed an issue where the shared screen tab's icon would not render as dimmed when the tab was inactive.
- Fixed ESLint language server adding comments on save if the `source.organizeImports` code action was used on save. Zed now filters out code actions sent to the language servers by checking whether they are supported first ([#13633](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13633)).
- Linux: Fixed typing shortcuts like `ctrl-/` on some systems.
- Linux: Fixed a panic that occurred when GPU was temporarily unavailable ([#12766](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12766), [#14022](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14022)).
- Linux: Fixed auto-update into custom tarball locations ([#14291](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14291); thanks [ArrayBolt3](https://github.com/ArrayBolt3)).
- Linux: Use local time zone in chat and Git blame ([#14610](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14610); thanks [apricotbucket28](https://github.com/apricotbucket28)).

## v0.145.1 — 2024-07-24

## Enhancements

Remote Development (alpha) for everyone 🖥️🌐 

![screenshot_2024-07-17_at_15 32 45](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b0e6a1f3-23cd-4ab0-b3a4-9999e637261b)

Edit files or run commands on your server over SSH, whether working solo or using Zed's collaboration tools to tackle tasks together.

Learn more about remove dev and its current limitations here: https://zed.dev/docs/remote-development

### General

- Added support for following into the assistant panel.
- Added a `/symbols` slash command in the assistant panel, which automatically inserted the active file's symbols into the assistant.
- Added function signature popovers ([#4879](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4879), [#5155](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5155); thanks [tomoikey](https://github.com/tomoikey)).
  - To disable, add `"show_signature_help_after_completion": false` to `settings.json`.
- Added support for gpt-4o-mini ([#14769](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14769), thanks [versecafe](https://github.com/versecafe)).
- Added a setting to add file icons to buffer tabs ([#12138](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12138)).
  - These icons can be added by using `"tabs": { "file_icons": true }`.
- Added the ability to select and copy text from information popovers ([#5236](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5236); thanks [effdotsh](https://github.com/effdotsh)).
- Added banners for built-in Zed features when corresponding keywords are used in the extension search.
- Added default content for the user's `keymap.json` file ([#14248](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14248)).
- CLI: Ability to open URIs from the command line ([#14104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14104); thanks [korewaChino](https://github.com/korewaChino)).
- Improved relevance of extension search results ([#14588](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14588)).
- Improved Linux manual installation docs with better desktop icons ([#14435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14435), thanks [p5](https://github.com/p5)).
- Linux: Added a fallback Open picker for when XDG is not working ([#14524](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14524)).
- Linux: Allow `zed.dev/channel` (`zed://`) URIs to open on Linux ([#14104](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14104); thanks [korewaChino](https://github.com/korewaChino)).
- Linux: Added a representation of the current focus state to Zed's window style ([#14202](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14202)).
- Added a new setting `use_system_path_prompts` (default true) that can be disabled to use Zed's builtin keyboard-driven prompts ([#14524](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14524)).
- Remoting: Allow add/remove folders to projects ([#14532](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14532)).
- Added toggle hunk diff and expand all hunk diffs key bindings (thanks [Sensational-Code](https://github.com/Sensational-Code)).
- Improved the One Light color theme (thanks [effdotsh](https://github.com/effdotsh)).
- Set `TERM_PROGRAM` and `TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION` environment variables in the integrated terminal ([#4571](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4571); thanks [ldm0](https://github.com/ldm0)).

### Languages

- Added runnable tasks for Flutter (thanks [agent3bood](https://github.com/agent3bood)).
- Added Flutter tasks to Dart extension.
- Improved accuracy of completion lists for Rust functions and modules.
- Added support for pyright workspace configuration, as described in https://microsoft.github.io/pyright/#/settings (thanks [FilipeBisinella](https://github.com/FilipeBisinella)).
- Improved experience in projects using Yarn. Run `yarn dlx @yarnpkg/sdks base` in the root of your project in order to elevate your experience ([#10107](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10107)).

### Vim

- Added :bd/:bn/:bp ([#14457](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14457)).
- Added `-`/`+` to go to beginning of line above/below ([#14183](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14183); thanks [ika-musuko](https://github.com/ika-musuko)).
- `ctrl-m` now is equivalent to `enter` in editor.
- Improved visual feedback when changing cursor shape (thanks [omertuc](https://github.com/omertuc)).
- Fixed ctrl-d/ctrl-u getting to top/bottom of buffer ([#13250](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13250)).
- Fixed renaming sometimes not working in vim mode ([#14292](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14292), [#11882](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11882), thanks Congyuwang).
- Fixed `c <motion>` omitting trailing multibyte characters ([#13909](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13909)).
- Fixed inline assistant sometimes not working ([#11559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11559)).
- (Breaking) Removed non-standard builtin binding from `-` to open the project panel. You can re-add it to your keymap file with: `{"context":"VimControl", "bindings":{ "-": "pane::RevealInProjectPanel"}}` (thanks [ika-musuko](https://github.com/ika-musuko)).
- (BREAKING) Improved vim keymap contexts. This should be a no-op for most people, but may cause problems if you rely on `VimWaiting` or `VimOperator` being true in your map. See [the docs](https://zed.dev/docs/vim#custom-key-bindings) for more.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed tab navigation in Sublime Text keymap (unintentionally reversed directions).
- Fixed respecting user preference for JS/TS on_type formatting ([#13733](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13733), [#14499](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14499); thanks [matubu](https://github.com/matubu)).
- Linux: Fixed command palette opening from the application menu ([#14459](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14459)).
- Significantly improved performance of applying large quantities of concurrent edits, for example when running "Replace all" ([#14567](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14567)).
- Fixed "View Dependency Licenses" (or `zed: open licenses`) crashing on Linux ARM machines. ([#14302](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14302)).
- remoting: Fix extension installation ([#14538](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14538)).
- Added "Center the cursor in the visible area." to match MacOS `ctrl-l`; Added `ctrl-m` for JetBrain on Linux for the same ([#5247](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5247)).
- Improved Linux default keybindings ([#14600](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14600)).
- Fixed `Cmd-\` did not toggle left dock when using Atom base keymap on macOS ([#14098](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14098), thanks [audionerd](https://github.com/audionerd)).
- Fixed position of scrollbar in project panel with non-default `ui_font_size` values.
- Fixed terminal colors not respecting the theme ([#11418](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/discussions/11418); thanks [zakj](https://github.com/zakj)).
- Fixed large diagnostic popovers not overflowing when necessary (thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Fixed [nushell](https://github.com/nushell/nushell) not picking up `direnv` environments by directly interfacing with it using `direnv export` ([#8633](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8633); thanks [WeetHet](https://github.com/WeetHet)).
- Fixed some bugs with call notifications and with window positioning when reopening Zed (thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee)).
- Fixed line wrap for CJK characters (thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee)).
- Fixed insertion of extra characters for some keystrokes if `terminal.option_as_meta` is enabled ([#7728](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7728); thanks [denisw](https://github.com/denisw)).
- Fixed untitled buffers displaying a soft-wrap wrap-guide at `preferred_line_length` by default. ([#12473](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12473)).
- Fixed losing output of a spawned task ([#13683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13683); thanks [hron](https://github.com/hron)).
- Go: Fixed running single tests by changing the quoted expression in the `go test` command to work again in `bash`, `zsh`, etc. ([#14818](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14818)).
- Fixed a bug where tooltips would sometimes continuously display when the button was selected.

## Enhancements

### General

- Improved contrast between some items in the One Dark theme.
- Added support for filtering in the outline panel ([#13984](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13984)).
- Added dynamic [un]registration for LSP formatting capabilities ([#12661](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12661)).
- Improved `prettier` detection to pick up its installation from transitive dependencies ([#12731](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12731)).
- Improved Zed logic for sending `textDocument/didSave` request ([#14286](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14286)).

### Languages

- Added support for setting `classAttributes` in the configuration for `tailwindcss-language-server`. Example: 
```
{
  "lsp": { 
    "tailwindcss-language-server": { 
      "settings": { 
        "classAttributes": [ "class", "className", "ngClass", "styles" ] 
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### Vim

- Fixed vim undo and redo commands not taking counts ([#13950](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13950), thanks [mattfbacon](https://github.com/mattfbacon)).

## v0.143.6 — 2024-07-10

## Linux Support

Linux when? [Linux now](https://zed.dev/linux). 🎉🐧

For the last 6 months, our team and our open source community have been working hard to bring Zed to Linux.

As of today, we've released our first, official, stable build of Zed on Linux!

## Enhancements

### AI

- Added new `assistant: insert into editor` Action. Default keybinding: `cmd-<` on macOS, `ctrl-<` on Linux ([#13467](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13467)).

### General 

- Changed the default fonts to IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono. If you'd like to go back to using Zed Sans/Zed mono you need to [download](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed-fonts/releases/tag/1.2.0) them and install them ([#13596](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13596)).
- Default to a light theme during the day (#9627)
- Add keyboard shortcuts for scrolling in terminal ([#4917](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4917), [#12231](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12231)).
- Changed the default key bindings for pageup/pageup on Mac and Linux so that it moves the cursor (`editor::MovePageDown`). Previous scroll only behavior (`editor::PageDown`) is now available via `cmd-pagedown` on MacOS and `alt-pagedown` on Linux ([#13389](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13389))
- Added updated window controls on Linux ([#13751](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13751))
- Added recognizing *.markdown files as Markdown ([#13608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13608)).
- Added duplicate line shortcut to Sublime Text shortcuts ([#13640](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13640))
- Added `shift shift` as a default binding to open the command palette in the JetBrains keymap ([#13556](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13556)).

### Performance

- Improve editor's performance with large undo histories ([#13656](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13656))
- Improved performance of "replace all" in buffer search and project search ([#13654](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13654)).
- Improved power consumption on Intel Macs by preferring integrated GPUs over the discrete GPUs. ([#5124](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5124)).

### Vim

- vim: Support for macros (`q` and `@`) to record and replay ([#1506](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/1506), [#4448](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4448)).
- vim: Fix undo after repeated insert/replace mode (#13573).
- vim: Fix 'r' repeating too much (#13566).
- vim: Fixed `:` in empty diagnostics view ([#13624](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13624))
- vim: Fixed `g/` outside of an editor ([#13624](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13624)).
- vim: Add vim bindings for outline panel ([#13763](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13763)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed some responses being dropped from OpenAI-compatible providers ([#13741](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13741) thanks [@AdjectiveAllison](https://github.com/AdjectiveAllison)).
- Improved project panel ergonomics ([#13704](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13704))
- Fixed focusing the terminal when re-spawning a task ([#13674](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13674)). See video: [focus-task-fix.webm](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/39293/93afd332-8f22-47f5-914d-5bc040e24029)
- Fix auto-rename ranges with special characters ([#13551](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13551)).
- Fixed Rust tests not working when crates Cargo.toml is not at the root of a worktree ([#13658](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13658)).
- Fixed Vue extension not picking up user-provided initialization options ([13580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13580)).
- Fixed delay when changing scrolling direction ([#13867](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13867)).
- Fixed transparent themes ([#14010](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14010)).
- Code maintenance in the `editor` crate ([#13565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13565), thanks [@Peiffap](https://github.com/Peiffap)).
- A new programming language, that is popular with Zed developers, [recently had to work around a missing LSP notification](https://gleam.run/news/auto-imports-and-tolerant-expressions/#import-cycles-diagnostics). This has been fixed ([#14012](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/14012)).

## Breaking Changes

## v0.141.2 — 2024-06-26

## Breaking changes

### SETTINGS DEPRECATION NOTICE

In your settings.json the following keys will need to be renamed:
  - `language_overrides` -> `languages`
  - `copilot` -> `inline_completions`
  - `show_copilot_suggestions` -> `show_inline_completions`

Previously, we were supporting the old keys as an alias for the new keys, but this let to unintended/confusing failure modes.
As a result we have deprecated the old keys.

See: [Settings Deprecation Notice 2024-06-17](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13171) for more information.

## Enhancements

### General

- Added an outline panel to show a "map" of the active editor. Toggle the outline panel via `outline panel: toggle focus`.

Pair the outline panel with the search multi-buffer to get a better overview of your search results!

![outline panel](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/19867440/18f9e7d3-dcc0-4bbc-aca2-4110d0ad1816)

- Added support for dropping files from the finder onto the project panel ([#7386](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7386)).
- Added a 'selection and movement' tool to the Editor's toolbar, as well as controls to toggle it and a setting to remove it (`"toolbar": {"selections_menu": true/false }`).
- Changed the behavior of the `+` menu in the tab bar to use standard actions and keybindings. Replaced `New Center Terminal` with `New Terminal`, and `New Search`, with the usual `Deploy Search`. Also added item-creating actions to this menu.
- Improved performance of project panel in large worktrees ([#13202](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13202)).
- Improved the look of code action and run indicators in the gutter ([#12803](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12803)).
- Improved the style of disclosure controls throughout the UI.

### AI

- Improved the behavior of inline assist so that it no longer closes when an editor loses focus (e.g., from switching tabs) and then gains focus again. Instead, it only closes when you move the cursor outside of it, e.g., by clicking somewhere else in its parent editor.

### Languages

- VTSLS is now a default language server for TypeScript, TSX, and JavaScript.

If you would like to continue using `typescript-language-server`, use the following setting in your `settings.json`:

```json
"JavaScript": {
  "language_servers": ["!vtsls", "typescript-language-server", "..."]
},
```

- Added a more detailed message in place of the generic `checking...` messages when Rust-analyzer is running.
- Added a rate limit for language server status messages, to reduce noisiness of those updates.
- Added a `cancel language server work` action which will cancel long-running language server tasks.

- Added the ability to cancel a cargo check by clicking on the status bar item.

### Vim

- Added pending keys to the mode indicator in Vim mode.
    - See it in action [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/4fc4ffd9-2ba7-4e2c-b2c3-cd19b40cb640).
- Added support for register selection `"a`-`"z`, `"0`-`"9`, `"-`. `"_` and `"%` ([#11511](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11511)).
- Added support for multicursor registers ([#11687](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11687)).
- Added support for the `"/` register.
- Added `gv` to restore previous visual selection ([#12888](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12888)).
- Added support for `ctrl-r X` to paste in insert mode ([#4308](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4308)).
- Fixed `home` and `end` in visual mode ([#13068](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13068)).
- Fixed inserting a 0 in insert mode with a count ([#9383](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9383)).
- Fixed `gi` when the insert ended at the end of a line ([#12162](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12162)).
- Fixed `gl` when the first match is at the end of a line.
- Fixed behavior of `dw` at the end of a soft wrapped line.
- Fixed ci" on keyboards where typing a " requires the IME ([#12523](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12523)).
- Fixed an issue where held-down modifier keys (such as Shift) would interrupt continuous key events, affecting navigation and selection behavior ([#12566](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12566)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed some syntax highlighting bug in Python ([#12578](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12578)).

![Before](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/87859239/0b8ab26b-149b-477e-af08-8cd9f2b1c117)

![After](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/87859239/a319a5ea-54b7-4681-951d-130ea26aa390)

- Fixed auxiliary details in completions returned by VTSLS
([#13043](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/13043)).
- Fixed a bug where the selected tab was not always shown when cycling between tabs with `ctrl-tab`.
- Fixed a bug where the command palette was not scrolling down to the last element.
- Fixed a bug where "Find all references" editor had cursor placed on the first line of the first excerpt in the multibuffer instead of having it on the first reference.
- Fixed a possible hang when opening a worktree in a .git directory.
- Fixed snippet completions sometimes being treated as plain text completions when using VTSLS ([#12920](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12920)).
- Fixed the Hide Copilot context menu item to modify the appropriate setting.
- Fixed a panic when editing C code ([#13128](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/13128)).

Interact with any model from the [Ollama Library](https://ollama.com/library)

- Added support for snippets via simple-completion-language-server ([#4611](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4611)). To begin using snippets, install the snippets extension from the extension store:

![snippets](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/19867440/9995037e-890e-4afd-9bf2-08f4c3895ace)

Place your snippet files in `~/.config/zed/snippets`. For instance, in your `~/.config/zed/snippets/snippets.json` file, you may have:

```json
{
  "my snippet": {
    "prefix": "log",
    "body": ["console.log(\"$1\")"],
    "description": "Expand `log` to `console.log()`"
  }
}
```

For more configuration information, see the [`simple-completion-language-server` instructions](https://github.com/zed-industries/simple-completion-language-server/tree/main). 

- Added the ability to search inside of selections ([#8617](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8617)).
- Improved the performance of the project panel in large directories
- Added the `editor: toggle tab bar` action.
- Improved performance when handling large responses from language servers.

### AI

- Added search for saved assistant history.
- Added `/now` command to the Assistant for getting the current date and time.
- Improved the handling of JSON response bodies in the `/fetch` command in the Assistant.

### Languages

- Added runnable tests for TSX files. Runnable tests can be customized via `tsx-test` tag.
- Added support for linked editing ranges LSP request. Editing opening tags in HTML/TSX files (with vtsls) performs the same edit on the closing tag as well (and vice versa) ([#4535](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4535)).
- Added auto-completion support for `package.json` files ([#12792](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/12792)).
- Added support for looking up the `rust-analyzer` binary in `$PATH`. This allows using such tools as `asdf` and nix to configure per-folder rust installations. To enable this behavior, use the `path_lookup` key when configuring the `rust-analyzer` `binary`: `{"lsp": {"rust-analyzer": {"binary": {"path_lookup": true }}}}`.
- Added `inl` to cpp config ([#12605](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12605)).

### Vim

- Allowed scrolling the currently-open information overlay using `ctrl-{u,d,e,y}` etc ([#11883](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11883)).
- Added `g/` for project search.
- Added `gu`/`gU`/`g~` for changing case ([#12565](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12565)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed some runnables in JavaScript/Typescript.
- Fixed an issue where the IME pre-edit could desynchronize from the editor on macOS ([#11829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/12651)).
- Fixed runnable for package.json, so it will work in any directory.
- Fixed a bug that caused titles generate by the LLM to be longer than one line.
- Fixed an issue where file icons were displayed in the project panel during a rename even when `project_panel.file_icons` was set to `false` ([#12905](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12905)).
- Fixed a panic when opening the diagnostics view.
- Fixed a crash that could happen when using certain cursor-motion bindings with a pending mouse selection.
- Fixed a panic when worktree paths are incorrectly relative.
- Fixed a panic when going to next search result when there are none.
- Fixed the wrong icon being used in the assistant setup instructions.
- Fixed `tailwindcss-language-server` not being activated inside Ruby strings (inside `.erb`) ([#12728](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12728)).
    - Check the video [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/643343b4-d64f-4c4e-98a1-d10df0b24e31). 
- Fixed `tailwind-language-server` not working in attributes inside of `*.astro` files ([#12402](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12402)).
    - Check the video [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/05677a2d-831d-4e05-a1a2-4d1730ce2a46).
- Fixed folder expansion when all items are closed ([#12729](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/12729)).
- Vim: Fixed indent via `<` and `>` not being repeatable with `.` ([#12351](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12351)).
- Vim: Fixed `f`/`t` etc. for keys that require IME ([#12522](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12522)).

## Breaking changes

- Renamed the `workspace::Restart` action to `workspace::Reload` to avoid accidentally restarting Zed when trying to restart language servers ([#12609](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12609)).

### AI

- Improved the UX for selecting a model in the assistant panel. You can now switch models using just the keyboard by pressing `alt-m`. Also, when switching models via the UI, settings will now be updated automatically.

### Languages

- Added support for using [vtsls](https://github.com/yioneko/vtsls) language server for TypeScript/JavaScript. To enable vtsls, adjust the `language_servers` field of the language in your `settings.json` file:

```json
"TypeScript": {
  "language_servers": ["!typescript-language-server", "vtsls", ".."],
}
```

- Improved performance and reliability of completions in large TypeScript projects ([#5166](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5166)).
- Added completions for `tsconfig.json` config file.
- Improved Vue highlighting ([#8989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8989)).
- Added runnable tasks for Elixir tests (modules, `describe`, and `test` blocks).

### Vim

- Implemented `>` and `<` with motions and text objects ([#9697](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9697)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed file drag and drop not working for the terminal.
- Fixed a crash caused by bad file descriptor lifetime handling.
- Fixed crash on macOS when using certain input sources.
- Fixed TSX shorthand property syntax highlighting ([#12510](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12510)).
- Fixed JavaScript shorthand property syntax highlighting ([#12509](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12509)).
- Fixed a bug where "rerun last task" in task modal was not working ([#12580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12580)).
- Fixed an issue in vim mode where using `find` (`f`) to search for the letter `g` caused a delay while the editor awaited further input ([#12483](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12483)).
- Fixed the alignment for the inline assistant.
- Fixed TypeScript shorthand property highlight ([#5239](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5239)).
- Fixed some bugs with running tests in Elixir.
- Fixed VTSLS being enabled by default and duplicating completions with typescript-language-server

## Breaking Changes

- Rebound "picker::UseSelectedQuery" from `opt-E` to `F2` ([#12580](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12580)).

## v0.138.4 — 2024-06-05

## Enhancements

### General

![indent_guides](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/19867440/b8cf0ec4-995a-4b7b-a133-e65f02a3ecbc)

Also added the `editor::ExpandExcerptsUp` and `editor::ExpandExcerptsDown` actions, which can both take a `lines` parameter. Also added an `expand_excerpt_lines` setting which controls the default number of lines that the indicators and actions use.

### Project Panel

### AI

- Improved clarity for inline transformations by always including the active assistant context.
- Removed an over-eager system prompt from the assistant that was causing misbehavior. Going forward, our intent is to always let you observe and edit text before we send it.

### Tasks

    - Check out the [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/5518/4cd05fa5-4255-412b-8583-68e22f86561e).

## v0.137.2 — 2024-05-29

## Enhancements

### General

- Added the ability to format unsaved buffers with Prettier. This requires setting a Prettier parser in the user settings. Example for JSON:  `{ "languages": { "JSON": { "prettier": { "allowed": true, "parser": "json" } } } }` ([#4529](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4529)).
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/d24e490b-2e2c-4a5d-95a8-fc8675523780).
- Changed the behavior of `workspace::CloseActiveItem`: when you're using macOS and there are no open tabs, it now closes the window ([#5322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5322)). This can be controlled with a new setting, `when_closing_with_no_tabs`, to disable it on macOS, or enable it on other platforms.
- Improved file finder search sorting ([#11970](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11970)).
- Improved editing of file names in the project panel. Now, the file icon is shown as soon as the file extension is typed, even before the rename is confirmed.
- Added a `proxy` setting ([#5032](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5032), [#6701](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/6701), [#8650](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8650), [#9424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9424), [#9422](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9422), [#11890](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11890)).
- Added a `Duplicate` action to the project panel ([#5304](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5304)).
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/f0fa6a4b-f066-47df-84f0-257a049800d1)
- Added the ability to create directories in `open->file` dialog on macOS.

![Create directories in `open->file` dialog on macOS](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/939a2a88-16b2-4a91-a344-f73c5615d831)

- Added a `New Window` item to the dock menu ([#11651](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11651)).

- Standardized CLI application startup to match non-CLI application startup behavior: both now open an empty file or show the welcome page if no previous workspace exists and no path is provided.
- Added glob support for `file_types` configuration ([#10765](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10765)).

`file_types` can now be written like this:

```json
"file_types": {
  "Dockerfile": [
    "Dockerfile",
    "Dockerfile.*",
  ]
}
```

- Added `Cut`, `Copy`, and `Paste` actions to the editor context menu ([#4280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4280)).
- Changed middle mouse down to trigger columnar selection, creating a rectangle of multicursors over a dragged region ([#11990](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11990)).
- Improved performance of editing the assistant panel and untitled buffers with many edits.
- Added font feature values. Now you can set font features like `"cv01": 7`.
- Changed context menus in editors to no longer scale with `buffer_font_size`.
- Added support for all `OpenType` font features to macOS.
- Changed the default ESLint configuration to include the following in order to silence warnings/errors: `{"codeAction": { "disableRuleComment": { "enable": true, "location": "separateLine", }, "showDocumentation": { "enable": true } }}`

### AI

- Added `editor::AcceptInlineCompletion` action (bound to Tab by default). To prevent accepting inline completions with tab, add `{"context": "Editor && inline_completions", "bindings": {"tab": "editor::Tab"}}` ([#6788](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/6788)).
    
### Tasks

- Added coloration to task icons in terminal based off status ([#11968](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11968)).

![Task icon coloration](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/147033096/32578358-3da8-4082-9212-637dcd346576)

### Languages

- Added support for autoclosing of HTML tags in local projects ([#5267](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5267)). This feature is enabled by default, but can be disabled with the following snippet in your `settings.json`:

```json
"lsp": {
  "vscode-html-language-server": {
    "settings": {
      "html": { "tagAutoclosing": false }
    }
  }
}
```

- Added built-in Go runnables and tasks that allow users to run Go test functions, test packages, or run `main` functions.
    - Check out the demos [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/a6271d80-faf4-466a-bf63-efbec8fe6c35) and [here](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/92f2b616-7501-463d-b613-1ec1084ae0cd).
- Added `gopls` support when opening `go.mod` or `go.work` files.
- Added test runnable detection for PHP (PHPUnit & Pest).
- Added task for running selected PHP code.
- Added `describe`, `test`, and `it` functions to buffer symbols to support Pest runnable in PHP.
- Added `yield` keyword to PHP keyword mapping.
- Added GraphQL icon for `.gql` and `.graphqls` files.
- Added ability to pass `initialization_options` to Ruby language servers (solargraph and ruby-lsp).
- Added ability to configure own build of `tailwindcss-language-server` in Zed settings. Example: `{"lsp":{"tailwindcss-language-server":{"binary":{"arguments":["/absolute/path/to/tailwindcss-language-server/bin/tailwindcss-language-server", "--stdio" ]}}}}`
- Fixed documentation not showing up for completion items coming from `tailwindcss-language-server` ([#10532](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10532)).

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed `$ZED_SELECTED_TEXT` variable in Tasks ignoring whether visual-line-mode in Vim was used.
- Fixed language servers (such as `gopls`) not starting up correctly when opening a single file in Zed ([#11361](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11361), [#8764](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8764)).
- Fixed Zed's internal Node runtime not being put in `$PATH` correctly when running language servers and other commands with `node` ([#11890](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11890)).
- Fixed `gopls` not working correctly when the `go.mod` file was in a subfolder and not the root folder of the project opened in Zed ([#10224](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10224)).
- Fixed backtick characters not getting autoclosed in Golang files ([#12025](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/12025)).
- Fixed keybinding for rename in project panel context menu to be `F2` ([#11608](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11608)).
- Fixed a bug where lsp completion requests were sometimes being made twice.
- Fixed default Prettier not respecting Zed's `hard_tabs` settings.
- Fixed multiple save modals appearing for the same file being closed ([#10192](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10192)).
- Fixed a theme-specific bug with highlighting of variable in Python files ([#11666](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11666)).

## v0.136.2 — 2024-05-22

## Enhancements

### General

- Added support for hiding the tab bar (part of [#6424](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/6424), [#4963](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4963)). Turn off the tab bar by adding the following to your `settings.json`:

```json
"tab_bar": {
    "show": false
}
```

- Added support for opening subfolders of git repositories and treating them as part of a repository (show git status in project panel, show git diff in gutter, git blame works, ...) ([#4672](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4672)).
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/afc1cdc3-372c-404e-99ea-15708589251c)
- Added "Open permalink" option to right-click menu of git blame entries in gutter.
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/656c177c-79f0-4a40-8838-7e963d099479)
- Added a `pane: alternate file` command, to navigate back and forth between two buffers, and bound it to `ctrl-6` in Vim mode.
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/261929/2d10494e-5668-4988-b7b4-417c922d6c61)
- Added the `current_line_highlight` setting that defines how to highlight the current line in the editor ([#5222](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5222)).
- Added `--foreground` to the CLI to allow running Zed on the current PTY.
- Improved the behavioral consistency of `editor: go to diagnostic` and `editor: go to prev diagnostic`.
- Improved responsiveness of the main thread under high system load.
- Changed UI elements within the editor to scale based on `buffer_font_size` (e.g., code action indicators, task run indicators, etc.).

### AI

- Added support for interacting with Claude in the assistant panel ([#8914](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8914)). You can enable it by adding the following to your `settings.json`:

```json
"assistant": {
    "version": "1",
    "provider": {
        "name": "anthropic"
    }
}
```

- Added a new ambient context feature that allows showing the model up to three buffers (along with their diagnostics) that the user interacted with recently.
- Added the ability to use the inline assistant within the assistant panel.
- Added [`GPT-4o`](https://openai.com/index/hello-gpt-4o/) support to the assistant and made it the default.
- Added a `low_speed_timeout_in_seconds` setting to the Assistant's OpenAI provider ([#9913](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9913)).
    
### Tasks

- Improved tasks modal by highlighting a distinction between a task template and concrete task instance and surfacing available keybindings more prominently. Task templates are now always available in the modal, even if there's already a history entry with the same label.

### Vim

- Added support for the changelist. `g;` and `g,` to go to the previous/next change.
- Added support for the `'.` mark.
- Added support for `gi` to resume the previous insert.
- Added support for buffer-local marks (`'a-'z`) and some builtin marks `'<`,`'>`,`'[`,`']`, `'{`, `'}` and `^`. Global marks (`'A-'Z`), and other builtin marks (`'0-'9`, `'(`, `')`, `''`, `'.`, `'"`) are not yet implemented ([#5122](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/5122)).
- Added support for pasting with a count ([#10842](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10842)).

### Languages

- Added ability to configure settings for `tailwindcss-language-server`, namely the `includeLanguages` and `experimental` objects.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed icon in inline git blame entry not changing with the buffer font size ([#11311](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11311)).
    - See the [before](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/4a288cae-a52b-4bee-8681-f1d9ba3b57f3) and [after](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/f7a6a608-8ecc-4642-adbd-80858dea75e9).
- Fixed rendering issues that could arise when having large amounts of text displayed on a large display. Fixed by dynamically increasing the size of the buffers used on the GPU ([#11615](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11615)).
    - See the [before](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/464463be-b61c-4149-a417-01701699decb) and [after](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/4feacf5a-d862-4a6b-90b8-317ac74e9851).
- Fixed the size of the completions menu changing based on the size of the aside ([#11722](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11722)).
    - See the [before](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/30776250/c67e6fef-20f2-4dc5-92b3-09bb73f874a7) and [after](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/30776250/7467b8ee-6e66-42d7-a8cc-2df11df58c5e).
- Fixed a bug where all run buttons would show up as pressed when clicking on a single run button.
- Fixed a bug where Vim bindings were not available when mouse context menu was open.
- Fixed the `go to definition` before by not selecting the target range when the target range has more than one line ([#11347](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11347)).
- Fixed `ctrl-space` not being forwarded correctly in the terminal view ([#10502](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10502)).
- Fixed a bug where SHELL was outdated if Zed was launched via Finder or Raycast or other desktop launchers ([#8794](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8794)).
- Fixed a panic caused by missing bounds check in completion handler.
- Fixed a bug where autosave `after_delay` would auto-format the buffer ([#9787](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/9787)).
- Fixed a bug where the last character of a line could be hidden under the scrollbar ([#7098](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7098)).
- Fixed completions inside snippets breaking the jump-to-next-tabstop behaviour when using Go/`gopls` ([#10185](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10185)).
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/35384e5e-45c6-46ab-870d-b48e56d8786b)
- Fixed scrollbar markers for folded code.
- Fixed a bug where the code actions button and the test run button could not be triggered when the editor was not focused.
    - See the [before](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/5518/546450fc-ad2c-45d0-8bdb-7b15cfebe235) and [after](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/5518/efc4f863-9db1-4846-83ae-c99ae4dcb3ed).
- Vim: Fixed a bug where highlights would appear which were only cancellable by opening then closing the toolbar. Buffer search toolbar now opens on `n` and `gn` so that the highlights can be cleared.
- Vim: Fixed a bug where `e`/`E` was blocked by hint text ([#7046](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7046)).

## Breaking Changes

- Removed built-in support for Ruby, in favor of making it available as an extension.
- Changed the default key binding for `picker::UseSelectedQuery` to `alt-e`.
- Changed the default `format_on_save` behavior for Markdown files to be `off`.


## v0.135.2 — 2024-05-15

## Enhancements

### General

- Added `editor::ToggleHunkDiff` (`cmd-'`) and `editor::ExpandAllHunkDiffs` (`cmd-"`) actions to browse git hunk diffs in Zed.
- Added an `editor: convert to opposite case` command.
- Added a `stop_at_soft_wraps` setting for `Editor::move_to_{beginning|end}_of_line`. When `true`, it causes movement to the either end of the line (via, for example Home or End), to go to the logical end, as opposed to the nearest soft wrap point in the respective direction ([#10888](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10888)).
- Changed the branch picker to always show the current branch as the default selected entry.
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/18b50656-f6ac-4138-b4e0-9024072e1555)
- Changed inline git blame information to not show up on empty lines.
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/e506cf1f-81b1-407b-8dc7-1666b31ae142)

### Tasks

- Added buttons to the gutter to run tests in Rust files.

### Vim

- Added `shift-k` to show the hover tooltip.


### Languages

- Added syntax highlighting to regular expressions inside of Go.
- Added ESLint as a default language server for Svelte.
- Added brackets and missing operators to syntax highlighting in Python code ([#4341](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/4341)).
- Added support for function call completion when using `typescript-language-server`. This will result in parameters being added, which can then be changed and navigated with `<tab>`. For this to work with `typescript-language-server`, the documentation for a given completion item needs to be resolved, meaning that if one types very quickly and accepts completion before `typescript-language-server` could respond with the documentation, no full function completion is used.
    - Check it out: [video](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/1185253/c23ebe12-5902-4b50-888c-d9b8cd32965d)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed terminals always using the global shell even when local settings specified a different shell ([#7599](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7599)).
- Fixed false-positive hunks appearing in files with `\r\n` endings ([#11452](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11452)).
- Fixed a bug where the Collab panel context menu could not be dismissed with `Escape` key ([#11413](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/11413)).
- Fixed Copilot suggestions preventing completions from appearing on completion trigger inputs ([#8766](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8766)).
- Fixed `alt-shift-left` and `alt-shift-right` in the Textmate default keybindings ([#10242](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/10242)).
- Restored the ability to confirm a prompt by pressing "Enter" when deleting/trashing files.
- Fixed detection of JSDoc to only do syntax highlighting in block comments ([#7826](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7826)).
- Vim: Fixed last character of reversed mouse selections ([#8492](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/8492)).
